sanskrit: jayatyavirato vyāptaviśvaḥ kālo vināyakaḥprabandhavākyārthatvenātra sūcitamityupadiśanti pūjyapādāḥnityānāṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca navatantrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥtasmāttu nirapekṣaṃ me tantraṃ tāsāṃ vada prabhogopyaṃ sarvaprayatnena gopanaṃ tantracoditamkādikālītiśaktī staḥ purā tattanmate mayāśṛṇu tatsarvatantrāṇāṃ rājānaṃ sarvasiddhidamtantraṃ maduktaṃ bhuvane navanāthairakalpayatavasāneṣu kalpānāṃ sā taiḥ sārddhaṃ vrajecca māmnityoddhārastṛtīye syāt lalitārcā tayordvayoḥkāmeśvarī saptamake parato bhagamālinīekādaśe vahnivāsinyatha vajreśvarī matākulasundaryyato'nyasmin nityānityā tu ṣoḍaśesarvamaṅgalanityā'to jvālāmālinisaṃjñikātrayoviṃśe tu vārāhīdhyānāni tadanantaresaptaviṃśe śvāsarūpā aṣṭāviṃśe tu lokatāp. 4) ekatriṃśe tadūrddhaṃ ca homāḥ kāmyā mahodayāḥcatustriṃśe tu nāmāni pañcatriṃśe'sya vāsanāpratyadhyāyaṃ śataślokāḥ syādevaṃ tantrasaṃgrahaḥasaṃśayaḥ saṃśayacchinnirapekṣo gururmataḥsmerapūrvābhibhāṣitvaṃ svacchatā'jihmavṛttitāasaṃśayastatvabodhe tacchaktipratipādanātevaṃvidho gururjñeyastvitaraḥ śiṣyaduḥkhadaḥtatvavigrahāḥ ṣaṭ triṃśatsaṅkhyāviśiṣṭatvāt || 9 || 10 || 11 || 12 || 13vittāpahāraśarīrakleśabuddhivyāmohādibhirityarthaḥ || 19 || 20 || 21
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 5) alubdhaḥ sthiragātraśca prekṣākārī jitendriyaḥevaṃvidho bhavecchiṣyastvitaro duḥkhakṛdguroḥprasīda nātha ! deveti tatheti ca kṛtādarammukhāvalokī seveta kuryyādādiṣṭamādarātkāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ mānaṃ prahasanaṃ stutimṛṇadānaṃ tathā'dānaṃ vastūnāṃ krayavikrayamyato guruḥ śivaḥ sākṣāttaṃ stuvan praṇaman bhajetduḥkhakṛt guroḥ akīrtyanarthacittadehakleśādyaiḥ || 22 || 23kuṭilāni paridevanaṃ pralāpaḥ | bhūṣṇuḥ jijīviṣuḥ | bhajet seveta || 25p. 6) yathā gurau tathā svātmanyevaṃ bhaktikramaḥ priye !viśeṣapūjāṃ yogibhyo bhojanaṃ tatpadārcanamekadeśe nityasevā dūrasthe yojanakramāttato'dūragate sevā tadājñāparipālanamchāyāṃ kalatramanyacca yattasyeṣṭaṃ tu pūjayetpūjāmadhye samāyāte pūjye natvā sthitiṃ vadetvarteta so'pi taccheṣaṃ kuryānniścalamānasaḥkṛtyamevaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ maunaṃ tairna samācaretp. 7) na kadāpi bhavetsiddhirmantrairvā devapūjanaiḥtāṃ ca tatpaṭale samyak jñātvā bhaktisamanvitaḥtathāpyatrocyate kiñcidabhicārādisiddhayecaturo yojayedādyān bindusargau tu sarvagaugaṇayedyatra ṣaṣṭhaṃ vā'pyaṣṭamaṃ dvādaśaṃ tu vārāśiṣvanyatra ṛkṣeṣu saptapañcatṛtīyagaiḥp. 8) yataste tattvavijñānarahitāstena coditamkoṣṭhāni ṣoḍaśā'tra syusteṣu varṇān kramāllikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prathamaprathame tvādyaṃ dvitīyaprathame tathātattakoṣṭheṣu vilikhet tattatpañcamamakṣaramprāguktāṃśakādyamanugraheṣvavekṣaṇīyamityarthaḥ || 40 || 41 || 42p. 9) svanāmādyakṣaraṃ yatra koṣṭhe sandṛśyate tataḥsiddhasiddho japātsiddhyet dviguṇātsiddhasādhyakaḥvyākulakramāṇi dṛśyanta iti prathamaproktakramaśabdasyārthaḥ || 46sādhyasiddhe'tisaṃkleśāt sādhyasādhyo'tiduḥkhakṛtsusiddhasiddho'dhyayanāt phalaṃ dadyādyathepsitamsusiddhe tu prasiddhastu pūrvajanmakṛtaśramaḥabhicāre riporevaṃ yadi svātmavipattayearisiddhaḥ sutaṃ hanyādarisādhyaḥ svayoṣitamaryariḥ svātmahā mantraḥ samprāptyaiva suniścitamtridhā kṛtvā svarairbhindyāt tadanyadviparītakamsvayaṃ ṛṇī cettanmantraṃ tyajet pūrva ṛṇī yataḥpūrvajanmakṛtābhyāse pāpādasyāphalāptikṛtmantraḥ samprāptimātreṇa prāktanaḥ siddhaye bhavetlakṣmīmadādanādṛtya mantre bhogamavāptavāntasmādṛṇaviśuddhistu kāryā sarvaistu sarvataḥsphāṭikaiśca pravālaiśca mauktikairhemanirmitaiḥsarvataḥ mantreṣu vidyāsu cetyarthaḥ || 56 || 57 || 58 || 59 || 60 || 61ślokairakṣamālādikamupadiśati | tatra kucandanaiḥ raktacandanaiḥ || 63ādikṣāntairakṣaraiḥ syādakṣamālā yathārthataḥevaṃ sarvaguṇopeto jāyate sarvasiddhimānaṅgulīparvasaṃsparśādapi vā gaṇayejjapamvidyāṃ japecchataṃ tena tatpāpānmucyate dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naimittikātikramaṇe sahasraṃ prajapettadāvimukhaḥ paranindāsu devatādarśaneṣu cadayānvitaḥ sarvajane prekṣākārī gataspṛhaḥyaḥ sa sarvaguṇopeto vidyāsiddhimavāpnuyātna tasya sidabhiḥ kutrāpi kadācicca kathañcananindāsu vimukhaḥ | darśaneṣu vaidikavaiṣṇavaśaivādiṣu || 69 || 70 || 71ekāntaraṃ tu grathanaṃ vidarbhodvyantarīkṛtaḥanyathā sa guruḥ śiṣyaṃ nihantyevācirāt dhruvamdvayaṃ yojayedeṣo'nyaḥ | evaṃ traividhyamitiparihāraprakārantu vakṣye yogeṣu tattvataḥgarvitastvavidhiprāptaḥ śatravo vairikoṣṭhagāḥnirjitā karmabāhulyādahasāḥ satvavarjitāḥakālaviniyogena prabodhaḥ svāpagā japātruddhā visandhikāḥ prāptaduḥkhā vairisamanvitāḥapūrṇenopadiṣṭā ye hīnavīryāstu te matāḥrugṇā pralapanairjāpādanyamantraiḥ sahāvilāḥpañcaviṃśatiruddiṣṭā doṣāṃstān śamayedguruḥubhayaṃ bodhayan śiṣyaṃ saṃrakṣedgururātmavānādimāntyavihīnāstu varṇāḥ syuḥ śaradabhnavatyadahaṅkāravijñānānmatsamojāyate naraḥtādātmyasiddhiṃ tāṃ viddhi sarvamantrārthavigrahāmteṣāṃ ca tatra tatrāpi vidyayā vidhimācarettena tanmayatāsiddhiḥ sarvatra bhavati dhruvamādyantākṣaraddvayātmikām || 83 || 84 || 85vā'cyarūpaṃ sarvadevatātmatāṃ ceti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nidhane vidyayā dāho vidyayā'nyat samācaretyoginaṃ vidyayā siddhaṃ pūrvataśca nimantritamvidyayā visṛjenmantrī svavidyāsiddhaye śive !svajanmadivasaṃ nāthavyāptivāsarameva caṣaṭparvāṇi viśiṣṭāni sadarśaṃ saptaparvakamgurostu jīvite nityavyāpte tatputrakādikamtadabhāve tatkulīnaṃ tadbhaktaṃ vā samarcayettatprakārasya tatraiva sphuṭataraṃ vakṣyamāṇatvādiha na prapañcitamprātaḥ prabodhasamaye japātsudivasaṃ bhavetvidyāvatārasaṃsidhyai svīkṛtānekavigraha !sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave cidghanāya teparatantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇeprakāśānāṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇesadā me cittarūpeṇa vidhehi bhavadāsanamsatyarūpāṇām || 96 || 97 || 98 || 99deśakālākāraistvanmayatāṃ me vidhe hīti śivamp. 19) asyā niḥphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamiti ṣoḍaśanityātantre śrīkādimate prathamaṃ paṭalamvidyāvatārasopānabhūtāṃstatpūjanaṃ tathānāmabhedādahaṃ loke kalpayan divyarūpataḥjñānaḥ satyaḥ pūrṇa iti śrīmukhāste samīritāḥnivasanti tatastebhyaḥ samutpannāstrayastathāte bhūmāveva satataṃ nivasanti madātmakāḥakalpayat kādiśaktistvadananyā kṛte yugeprasannavadanāḥ smerā varābhayakarānvitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devī śrīcakrasaṃsthāstu devyākārāstadājñayāsvamaṇḍaleṣu nāthāntāḥ śaktyantā devi ! maṇḍalenavānāṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca pūjanesaptākṣaryā tayā devi ! pūjayennāmapūrvakamśṛṇu devi ! mahāsiddhikarī sarvapriyaṃkarīprāṇo'pi marutā yuktaḥ sa nabhaḥ syāt tṛtīyakamvyāptaṃ marutsakhaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ nabho'gniḥ saptamākṣaramsarvāsāmapi śaktīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca nāmabhiḥśaktitantrādbahirbhūtatantreṣu namasā sthitiḥtāni saptākṣarīyogātpratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaramteṣāṃ navānāṃ nāmāni maṇḍalīkaraṇaṃ priye !tena śuddhena śuddhiḥ syādvidyāyāmanyathā'nyathādevatānāmityuktiḥ puṃviṣayā || 12 || 13 || 14 || 15nāmānyupadiśati | tatra | ṣoḍaśākṣaram nāmeti śeṣaḥ || 17saṃbandhataḥ | āptiḥ prāmāṇyam | anvayaḥ santatiḥdinākṣarāṇyapi tathā amāyo'nantyameva caprasiddhaṃ bāhyato yacca trīṇi nāmāni sādhake !pūjāślokastutīḥ kuryāt pāramparyaprasiddhayepūrṇāyāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇāni nāmānyālikhya pūjayetpūjayettatra tatrāpi vadan saptākṣarīṃ śive !upacārāstatastāṃstaiḥ pūjayet śṛṇu tānyapikuryāt || 20 || 21tāmbūlaṃ namanaṃ stotraṃ svātmaneti samīritāḥphalakāyāṃ sthale vāpi suśuddhe susame sthirepañcāṅgulāntarālāni tato deveśi ! jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatsarvamadhye prathamaṃ dvitīyantu purogateevaṃ navanavopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ saptaparvasuteṣu nāmārṇanavakamālikhyābhyarcayet kramātsvātmanā svātmasamarpaṇāt || 23 || 24 || 25likhedityarthaḥ || 27 || 28 || 29 || 30p. 25) ṣoḍaśīkṛtya teṣvevaṃ likhennāmāni tāni vaisthānāni maṇḍalīkṛtya tatra cā'lekhane matesa deśikavaraḥ siddhaḥ tasmādvidyāptiruttamāvyādhiśastrādipīḍā vā cittabhrāntirjale mṛtiḥtasmāduktakrameṇaiva kuryāt sarvārthasiddhayebhaktiyuktān guṇāṃścāpi kramādvarṇeṣu saṅkareanyathā cedvadennāśaṃ saśiṣyo gururāpnuyātsarvānarthanivāraṇādīnāmupalakṣaṇam || 31 || 32 || 33 || 34 || 35proktasamācāraśuddhavatvādi || 37sā tu tattvavidā kāryā sampradāyānurodhināmuhūrte kārayed vidvān pūrṇāyāṃ vā śubhodayeprokteṣu pañcasvanyeṣu sarvadā vā śubhodayegurvanujñāmṛte mohāllobhād vā kurute yaditasmāt pūrṇābhiṣekeṇa prāptānujñaḥ samācaret| lobhaḥ vittecchā | nirayaṃ kleśasthānam || 39 || 40 || 41 || 42p. 27) abhiṣicyātha toyena kvathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥnityātattvāptikālotthavidyayā'bhyarcya tāḥ kramātevaṃ dinatrayaṃ kṛtvā tato nityakramaṃ bhajettrirātraṃ pūjayeddevīṃ yoginīyogibhiḥ samamgurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pratyakṣāya śivātmane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na cettacchaktisaṅkrāntiḥ kathamasya bhaviṣyatisuvarṇaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vāso bhavanaṃ vā'nyadīpsitamsvavyāpārantadanumatameva kuryādityarthaḥ || 44 || 45 || 46 || 47 || 48 || 49sarvadāsau tadā'yattastena siddhirbhaviṣyatipañcaṣaṭkūṭavidyābhyāṃ śodhitaṃ bahuvāsaraiḥādhāre hṛdaye mūrdhni cakraṃ sañcintya madhyataḥtriṃśo vidyāṃ vadet karṇe devyātmā pūrṇamānasaḥśataṃ japettadagrastho nikaṭe tridinaṃ vasettasmāt tadantike taqya pūjādeśādikṛdbhavettatastadā samārabhya tadāyattodhanādibhiḥanugrahādi kurvīta siddhaye nānyathā bhavetkvāthodakaiḥ samāpuryābhiṣicyābhirvadenmanumdvitīyamabhiṣekantu kuryāddevyātmasiddhayetrikoṇāni vidhāyātra madhye kumbhaṃ tu vinyasetdhanādibhirityatrādiśabdena gṛhakṣetrādīnyucyante || 52 || 53 || 54 || 55pūritaṃ khāritoyena kvathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥhiraṇyāni satāmrāṇi vāsobhyāmabhiveṣṭayetśatakratulatābaddhaiḥ mātuluṅgaphalānvitaiḥsārddhaṃ sahasraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśat pañcasaṃkhyāḥ kramoditāḥkālātmanityāmantrāṃśca japitvā pūrvavāsaresahasraṃ prajapetpaścāddhomaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥmuditairyoginīvṛndairekaikaṃ devatātmabhiḥsvakramaṃ tasya kathayettadā prabhṛti so'pi tamsahasraṃ prajapedvidyāmabhiṣekasamanvitamteṣu śaktīḥ samāvāhya sampūjyaivābhiṣecayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ naimittikaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ samācaretādhāre hṛdaye śīrṣe vahnau sūrye niśākarenyasecca mātṛkāsthāne tadā taddehasiddhayekuhūprāptau ripukleśe kuryādevābhiṣecanamkṣudrāṇi krūrakarmāṇi kṛtyāśca ripukalpitāḥśrīcakre | ekaṃ veti pakṣaḥ kāmyaviṣayaḥ || 58 || 59 || 60 || 61 || 62 || 63śrīvidyāṃ nyasedityapyupakvaraḥ sampradāyaḥ || 73saṃkucitatvaduḥkhārttiḥ || 75 || 76 || 77 || 78brūhi me tadbalaṃ yena kleśā naśyantyaśeṣataḥnaśyantyaśeṣato doṣāḥ tasmātsekasamo na hitasmādaśeṣaduḥkhārtiśāntyai syādabhiṣecanamkuryātsadakṣiṇāṃ pūjāṃ guroḥ pratyabdameva vāabhiṣiktastu vidhinā pradadyāddakṣiṇāṃ guroḥgurorguruṃ tadguruṃ ca svāgrato labdhavidyakāttoṣayedanyathā śaktiḥ svīyā tadgāminī bhavetpaṅkairvidadhyātsarvatra gurumaṇḍalakalpanamcittānuvṛttiḥ | svīyā śiṣyagatā | tadgāminī gurugāminī || 80 || 81 || 82dhārayetsarvato lakṣmīṃ rasasyātparameśvarīproktāni tāni sarvāṇi padmāni parikalpayetdevyātmatvaṃ gurorlabdhvā ślokadvādaśakaṃ japetdevīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāṃ pīṭharūpiṇīmkālahallohalollolakalanāśamakāriṇīmparamārthaṃ budhvetyarthaḥravitārkṣyendukandarpaśaṅkarānalaviṣṇubhiḥvande sarveśvarīṃ devīṃ mahāśrīsiddhamātṛkām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ tāṃ vande siddhamātṛkāmbrahmāṇḍādikāṭāhāntaṃ jagadadyāpi dṛśyatemātṛkāyāmekākṣare'pi saṃsiddhe tattathā siddhyatīti || 88 || 89jagatkāraṇatvamastītyupadiśya tanmayatā svātmanaḥ siddheti śeṣaḥjyeṣṭhāṅgabāhuhṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭipādanivāsinīmpraṇamāmi mahādevīṃ paramānandarūpiṇīmkeyaṃ kasmāt kvakeneti sarūpārūpabhāvanāmdevīṃ kulakalollolaprollasantīṃ parāṃ śivāṃparamānandānubhava iti || 94nodghāṭitamvande tāmaṣṭavargotthamahāsiddhyaṣṭakeśvarīṃcaturājñākośabhūtāṃ naumi śrītripurāmahamdevyāstvakhaṇḍarūpāyāḥ stavanaṃ tava tadyataḥtadavagantavyamārādhyacaraṇamukhāt| itaḥ paramasmadvyākhyāmātṛkāyāstādātmyāditi śivamasyā niḥphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamiti ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate dvitīyaṃ paṭalamparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamvārāhyā kurukullāyā ātmano'ṣṭākṣarasya caprocyate sādhusaṅketairlipīnāṃ prāgudīritaiḥtrividhā haṃsabhedena śṛṇu tāśca yathākramampañcatriṃśatpaṭale proktaiḥ || 1tṛtīyā prakṛtiḥ saiva turyā tairantyamāyayāiti tripurasundaryā vidyā samyak samīritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ rogādipīḍāsu tacchāntyai ca yathākramātteṣu teṣūktakāryyeṣu tattat samprāptihetavetithiṣu proktarūpāṇi tatra tāṃ sarvamaṅgalāmevameṣā mahāsiddhikarī pūjājapādinānāthātmakatvaṃ ṣoḍaśanityātmakatvaṃ caiṣāmiti sampradāyaḥpūrṇāmanativistāraṃ maṅgalāṃ brūhi me śivapūjāṃ vakṣyāmi te devi guhyāṃ śṛṇu manoharearcitayā vidhāyātha pīṭhe cakraṃ vidhāya tatekena tatra tāḥ samyaguktarūpamathārcayetvṛttasyāyāmavistāradvaye tvekaturīyataḥpratiṣṭhāpya cakramiti śeṣaḥ | atra cakretrayamantarato muktā tena dvādaśakoṇakammadhyavṛttasya madhye tu yoniṃ kuryyāt samāsrakāmanyā anyeṣu koṇeṣu pūjayeddvādaśa kramātsaptākṣaryyā kevalayā kevalāṃ lalitāṃ yajetproktarūpaṃ dvādaśāsraṃ cakraṃ bhavatītinityāsaptākṣarībhiḥ syurvidyāḥ pūjāsu sarvadātadvidyākṣarasaṃkhyāntu śṛṇu vakṣye yathākramamdvitīyāyāścaturthyāḥ syuścaturdaśabhirakṣaraiḥdvādaśyāśca caturdaśyāḥ pañcadaśyāḥ krameṇa vaimadhyasthāṃ pūjayeditiekādaśyāstu sāṣṭamyāḥ ṣoḍaśyā dvādaśoditāḥsaviṃśatiśatā vidyā japettāstāśca siddhayeāsāṃ pūjājapādyeṣu yantreṣu ca samīritamtena tantroktamakhilaṃ sādhayedvajrarūpiṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: proktadvādaśāracakre pūrvoktakrameṇa ṣoḍaśanityāḥ samarccayeditiābhiryantrapaṭalavakṣyamāṇayantreṣvapi pūjādikaṃ kuryātkoṇātmavajranirmmāṇaprayogāḥ parataḥ śiveyatsādhakārthitāvāptyai surāṅghripasamo bhavetnavaviṃśatibhiḥ pañcaśataṃ koṣṭhāni tena vaiśiṣṭeṣu vakojraṣṭhāni pañcaṣaṣṭyā śatadvayamkoṣṭhairvidhāyādho madhye vāhyārambhāt pradakṣiṇammadhye'vaśiṣṭe khaṇḍārṇacaturvviṃśatimālikhetlalitāṃ sādhyagarbhāntu vilikhenmadhyakoṇataḥsaṃsthāpya kutracit sthāne pūjayedvāñchitāptayemaṅgalānyeva jāyante nāmaṅgalakathā bhavetcaturdiggatatrikoṇacatuṣṭaye'pi sādhyagarbhāṃ samālikhet itiamaṅgalakathā amaṅgalamiti śabdastasminniti śeṣaḥvilikhya madhye lalitāṃ sādhyagarbhāṃ samālikhettenāpi pūrvvavat proktaṃ deśe na syādabhavyakammadhye sādhyākṣaropetāṃ sthāpayettatphalāptayesaṃsthāpya kumbhaṃ tadvarṇabhūruhakvāthapūritamjanmarkṣeṣu viśeṣeṇa samastalayaśāntayesavindukāmālikhya pūrvoktadeśe sthāpanāt pūrvoktaphalasiddhirititatra madhyasādhyākṣaropetāṃ nānyatreti yāvatpūrvoktaphalasamṛddhayep. 353) tathānyadapi deveśi prayogaṃ sarvapāvanamsaṅkocadhvāntamārttaṇḍaṃ santoṣāvdhividhūdayammaunī japet prasūnaiśca pūjayet saurabhānvitaisaurabhādyaistilaiḥ śubhraistaṇḍulairvidhivaddhunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samastaṃ tatkramādekavāraṃ tairabhiṣekataḥbhūtapretapiśācāpa * * *vimucya tatkṣaṇādbhītāḥ prayānti cānyataḥ kṣaṇātabhiṣiktamkaṇṭhamātre majjanāttu prāgjanmādyairvimucyateevaṃ sakalakalyāṇasaṃproktā sarvamaṅgalākṣipraprasādato nityaṃ harṣotpādanato'pi caasyā niphālanā citte tattattvasvātmasāt kṛtamsvarūpānubhavataḥparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamtadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe jvālāmālinyudāhṛtāyantrāṇi viniyogāṃśca phalāni ca śṛṇu kramātkuryādaṅgāni mūlārṇairāditaḥ ṣaṭ karāṅgayoḥṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmproktakramādityarthaḥṣaḍbhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni karanyāsapūrvaṃ nyaseditiśūlavahnī varābhītī dadhānāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥcārusmitalasadvaktrasarojāṃ trīkṣaṇānvitāmcaturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitamṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhyatastryasraṃ vidhāyātra śivāṃ yajetḍākinyādyāśca ṣaṭkoṇe aṣṭāsre ghasmarādikāḥsarvabakṣā sahasrākṣī niḥsaṅgā saṃhṛtipriyātrīkṣaṇānvitāṃ prativaktramiti śeṣaḥ | dhyāyediti śeṣaḥsamatrirekhaṃ tryasrañca yathāmānaṃ kṛtvā tatrārcayetacintyāmaprameyāñca pūrṇarūpāṃ durāsadām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahirdvāreṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet prāgudīritāḥvalihomāvasānāntamiti samyak samīritamtaddaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇañca homaṃ kuryācca goghṛtaiḥhomañca kuryādityarthaḥ | samīritaṃ pūjanamiti śeṣaḥajādighṛtanivṛttyarthaṃ gograhaṇamp. 358) pūjācakre vahirbhūtaṃ caturasre tvakhaṇḍitesarvamadhye tāragarbhe śaktimākhyāsamanvitāmaṣṭakaṃ vahirapyevaṃ vāhye dikṣu nava kramātsamastaṃ vāñchitaṃ pūjādhāraṇaṃ sthāpanaiḥ śivecatuṣṭayaṃ proktayantre vairṇaistatsthānato likhetevaṃ yantrāṇi jāyante daśa teṣāmanukramātyairiṣṭamakhilaṃ prāpnotyayantrāt sādhako dhruvamkuryāditikramānnavagrahāṇāṃ syustattadvāreṣu taddiśirāhuketū sthitau yatra tadrāśyadhipavārakevibhaktyā bhājane samyak prīṇayāmīti saṃlikhetsarveṣvapi ca vāreṣu sarveṣāṃ prītisiddhayeevaṃ yantreṣu daśasu pūjitā nityayā sahadvitīyāntaṃ samyak prīṇayāmīti vākyāntaṃ vilikheditisaumyāḥ saumyagatānāntu phalānyeva vitanvatelikhiteṣvarcciteṣvevaṃ kumāraṃ kanyakāntu vātathāvidhaṃ kumāraṃ vā saṃsthāpyābhyarcya vidyayāprasūnairaruṇaiḥ śubhraiḥ saurabhādyairathāpi vātato devyā samāviṣṭe tasmin saṃpūjya yatnataḥsarvamadhye devyarccanācca proktaphalasiddhiriti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayettāṃ tataḥ pṛcchedabhīṣṭaṃ kathayecca sājanmāntarāṇyatītāni sarvaṃ saṃpūjitā vadetsahasravāraṃ sthiradhīḥ pūrṇātmā vicaret sukhītatra saṃsthāpya gadinam abhyarcyodīritakramātproktā tat sakalaṃ tasya nideśādapayāti casvātmanyudvāsya pūrṇāśayaḥ sukhī vicareditijapan vidyāṃ smaran sādhyāṃ sadya ākṛṣyate'tha sānirastetarasadbhāvā manmathārttābhiyāti sārājāno rājaputrā vā tathānye cāpi kecanavaśagā dāsavadbhūmau tiṣṭhantyāmaraṇād dhruvamtattaccakrasya madhyasthaṃ veṣṭavidyājapānvitamsādhakasyādeśena sa rogo'payātītirājādayaḥ sādhyavargāḥmanaḥṣaṣṭhāni cākarṣenmanasā prāgvadātmanitatastamutthāpya mukhe kṣiptvārghyāmbu vadettataḥśāktaśāmbhavabhedābhyāṃ dvayoraikyātmayāmalātsmara dāhārṇakān saptetyuktvā prāgvadudīkṣaṇātsaṃsthāpya tajjīvakarṇe vidyāṃ vadeditiśāmbhavantu śṛṇu prājñe vedhamadbhutavigrahamsvayaṃ praviśya taddehamekībhūtvā punaḥ svakekṛtanyāsajapārccastu tattanuṃ vahninā dahetiti vedhatrayaṃ proktaṃ tvadbhāvasiddhisūcakamjñānamanyacca sakalaṃ saṃkramettetna tat samaḥlohairviracite paṭṭe phalakāyāṃ śilātaledevīmāvāhya tatraiva pūjayecchaktibhiryutām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māsaṃ maṇḍalamityevaṃ kramādiṣṭamavāpnuyātanyacca sakalantviṣṭamavāpnotyarccanādbhutamsādhayet prathamenaiva yantre,na yatnataḥ śiveitarābhyāmasyetipūjayet proktakālena phalānyuktānyavāpnuyātsahasravāraṃ tannityāvidyāṃ tadvāsitāmbubhiḥpramehaistrividhairghoramūtrakṛcchraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥjīvecca suciraṃ bhūmau nīrogaḥ svasthamānasaḥtale bhūmau tataḥ khātvā tatrāgniṃ jvālayet sadātaccotkṣipya salile na prakṣipeccedvinaśyatitatrākāramehavāriko rogaviśeṣaḥ | svasthamānasaḥ ādhirāhityātyantraṃ | salile na jalāśaye vinaśyati tadā dāhajvareṇa ripurityarthaḥprāpnoti vijayaṃ prokteṣvakhileṣu suniścitamsarvadā jayinaḥ sarve bhavantyetasya vaibhavātvaśe bhavanti manujā dantino vājinaḥ striyaḥmandocce sthāpayet kvāpi suvaddhantviṣṭakāpuṭevādecchāṃ sakalañcānyadaniṣṭaṃ stambhayed dhruvamtatrārcayennityaśastāṃ sandhyāsu bhavane nijepūjanānnityakramataḥ | dinaiḥ prāgvatbhavatyeva maheśāni vicitrā yantraśaktayaḥpīṭhe vā tatra tāṃ devīṃ gurāvuccaṃ gate dinevāsāṃsi ca vicitrāṇi bhūṣaṇānyapyavāpnuyāttadālipto vrajed yatra kutrāpi janasaṃsaditadiṣṭasādhikā yāvajjīvamasyānubhāvataḥyadyattairīritaṃ sarvaṃ kāryyametat susādhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devīsambuddhiḥevamarkādīnāmapyuktaḥ kālaḥ | tathā nityakramataḥsādhyā | asya prayogasyasaṃsthāpya kumbhaṃ vidhinā japitvogre grahe tadāna bhavecca bhavedevaṃ vaśyo yantreṣvaśeṣataḥnivedyañca praṇamyārcya dadyācchivatmavāpnuyātekādaśasthaphaladā nityaśo yajanādapivilikhyābhyarcya tadvidyāvide dadyāt supūjitamsarvamadhye nāmākṣaravinyāsabhedataḥ | etaddaśamaṃ yantrambhavantītinityārcakasya nityānāmekāṃ pūjayituṃ tu vāpaścimāmukhamāsīnaṃ tasmai proktavidhānataḥbhukte ca jaṭharasparśajapādapi suniścitamprokteṣu daśayantreṣu pratyekañca trivāsaramsamṛddho jīvati ciramarogaḥ sumanā bhuvitasmai dadyāditibhāskarasahitāṃ devīṃ | tatra bhāskarārccanasthānaṃ prāgvadititaddineṣu taducceṣu kāleṣu ca tadarcanāttathā tarpaṇahomābhyāṃ japadānādināpi vātattat kṣobhaṃ vilikhyāntaḥ pūjayedvairimardaneuparāge same bhūmau dinaśo jayamāpnuyuḥbhāṇḍe nave pañcagavye khārimāṇe pacecca tatdānaṃ suvarṇapaṭṭasya yantrāṅkitasyauparāge grahaṇe ravicandrayorityanvayaḥ | āpnuyuḥ śatravaḥghṛtena vidyayā hutvā tadbhasmādāya tatra vai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatastadbhasma saṃgṛhya nidadhyāddinaśo'rcayetgadacoragrahāriṣṭakleśā na syuśca tadgṛhebhakṣaṇaṃ sarvakṛtyādi duritārttivibhañjakamsvaratrayaṃ kramād yuñjyāttena tānyekaviṃśatiḥtadantarvṛttamadhyasthaṃ ṣaḍasrañca vidhāya tuvilikhedagramārabhya prādakṣiṇyena pārvatiśiṣṭe sādhyākṣarantvagre likhet pañcadaśasvapibhavanti yantrāṇi tathā taiḥ kukṣyagniḥ pravarttatespṛśan vidyāṃ japellakṣa tadvarṇakṛtasampuṭamtattoyenānnapākābhiṣekato bhavati dhruvamjāyate parameśāni nityānāṃ vaibhavāditiasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtamcirantanapāpāni nāśayitvā jaṭharāgnivṛddhikarāṇi bhavantītiparipūrṇaṃparāmṛṣṭamproktā tatkalpamadhunā śṛṇu sarbārthasiddhidamdhyānaṃ śaktīḥ pūjanañca sādhanaṃ tatphalāni caupāyaiḥ pañcabhistaistaiḥ sādhayedakhilepsitamṣaḍaṅgāni yathāpūrvaṃ mātṛkāṃ vidyayā nyaset| etairhomādibhiḥkulasundarīpaṭaloktakramādityarthaḥnavaratnakirīṭāñca citrapaṭṭāṃśukojjvalāmsarvānandamayīṃ nityāṃ samastepsitadāyinīmdadhānāṃ maṅgalāpadmakarṇikānavayonigāmnavayonāvaṣṭavargayutā vrāhmyādikā yajetnavayoniṃ proktamānena kuryyāditi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hetīśca parito devyāḥ pūjayettadbhujāntikepūjayettattadākārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhisarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥevaṃ saṃsādhitā vidyā viniyogāya kalpateprāgvatsaparyyādikaṃ tat samānamevetyarthaḥdaśāṃśamannājyādibhirhomañca kuryyādityarthaḥyenātimandabhāgyo'pi śrīmān bhoktā sukhī bhavetprāpnoti maṇḍalāddhomāt sitaistaiśca mahāyaśaḥsuvarṇaṃ samavāpnoti nidhiṃ vā ca sudhāntu vādhānyāni vividhānyāśu subhagaḥ sa bhevennaraḥtadaktairapi kahlārairhavanādrājavallabhaḥcaturvidhantu pāṇḍityaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥkanyakāṃ labhate yatnāt samastaguṇasaṃyutāmkṣaudrāktaṃ juhuyāttadvadayatnāddhanadopamaḥprasūnairaruṇaistadvattathā bandhūkasambhavaiḥsitaraktaistu militairāyurārogyamāpnuyāttathā guḍucyā homena pāyasena tilena vāhavanācchriyamāpnoti sā tadanvayagā bhavettatpaṅkamarditairhomāt kahlārairvikacaiḥ śubaiḥniḥsapatno nirātaṅko nirdvandvo nirmalāśayaḥtathaiva karavīrotthaiḥ prasūnairaruṇaiḥ sitaiḥtathaiva campakairhomādrūpājīvā vaśaṃ nayetlabhate'nupamāṃ lakṣmīmapi pāpiṣṭhacetanaḥlakṣmī suṣprāpatvāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ardhendukuṇḍe niyataṃ vidviṣṭā ripavo'mbikemṛtyuvījairnimbatailasiktairhomāttu dantinaḥakṣabījaistu tailāktairhomaḥ sarvavināśavāntathaivākṣatarūdbhūtapañcāṅgahavanādapitaddine syādapasmārī vairī bhavati niścitamtadyonipiśitaistaiśca havanaṃ mṛtyukṛdripoḥjāyante veriṇaḥ kuṣṭharogā dehavilāpakāḥdāhajvareṇa grastaḥ syādarātistaddinairdhruvamgurumukhādavagantavyāni | tailāktaistilasambhavatailārkteḥsnigdhaiḥ samprāptasadvidyairjapahomādi kārayetvidyābhiranyathā siddhaṃ mantramapyāśu nāśayetvittāśayā vā na kadāpyācaredbhūtikāmukaḥanayā vidyayā karmāṇyaśeṣāṇi maheśvariyaiḥ sarvve sarvvadā sarvvasamīhitamavāpnuyuḥsarvvatrokteṣu vidhivat sthāneṣu parameśvarisvarakṣāvidhānavaiparītyenaācarennigraham abhicāryyāṇāṃ tatroktānāmityarthaḥtadvahiḥ ṣaḍdalaṃ padmaṃ tattattrayañca saṃlikhettrikoṇeṣu ca ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaṭpatreṣu samālikhetantarvṛttāntaradvandve bhūtārṇāṃśca kriyocitānmātṛkāṃ vilikhenmāyābinduyuktāṃ kramotkramātparastāttu śatenāpi ṣaṣṭyā kūṭairlikhet pavimtaistu koṣṭhāni jāyante navāśītiśatadvayamtato vajraṃ bhavenmadhye tvekaṣaṣṭyā śatātmakammadhyakoṣṭhe likhedvidyāṃ sādhyākhyākarmmasaṃyutām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūnyamagniyutaṃ paścādrayo vyāptena saṃyutaḥnabho gotrā punaścaiṣā dāhena samayojitāhṛllekhāsahitaiḥ samastākhyā turīyā vidyeti || 4 || āsu catasṛṣu vidyāsup. 43) eṣā kāmeśvarī nityā kāmadaikā daśākṣarādharāyuk sacarā paścāt sthirā paścādrasaḥ smṛtaḥsthirā bhūḥsahitā gotrā sadāhognī rasaḥ sthirāevamuktaprakāreṇaikādaśākṣaretyarthaḥp. 44) tato rasaḥ sthirā paścānmarutā saha yojitāsthirā dharānvitā haṃso vyāptena ca careṇa carasaḥ sthirā tataḥ sāgniḥ śūnyaṃ javiyuto marutrasaḥ sthirā'mbu ca viyat svayutaṃ prāṇa eva cap. 45) sacaraśca javī pūrvavidyātārtīyataḥ kramāthṛdambuyuk kṣmayā dāhaḥ sacaraḥ syājjavī ca hṛtsthirā (tu) 'pi marutā yuktā śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaścaraudāho gotrā carayutā tathā dāhastathā rayaḥrasaḥ sthirā tataḥ prāṇo rasāgnisahito bhavetśūnyayugmaṃ ca gotrā syāt dāhayuktāmbunā caraḥgotrā dāhamarudyuktā tvambu vyāptamato bhavetrasaḥ sthirā'mbvagniyutaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ carānvitamgrāso bhūḥsahito devi ! raso vyāptaṃ tataśca hṛtśūnyaṃ ca kevalaṃ bhadre ! rasaśca sacarā sthirādevīti sambuddhiḥ | raso bhakāraḥ | vyāptaṃ yakāraḥ | hṛt sakāraḥbhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā pañcaikāntaritāḥ sthitāḥtāni kramāt jyā sacaro raso bhūśca nabhoyutāśūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ hṛddāho'mbu marudyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāgvadārabhya vilikhet prādakṣiṇyapraveśataḥṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyāni yantrāṇi sambhavantītisamastābhīṣṭadaṃ sarvvavijayaśrīpradaṃ śubhametadviṣamaṃ mahadvajrayantraṃ proktaphalasiddhi pradamitisaptaviṃśati nakṣatrasamānyetāni cedapiviniyogakramañcaiva susphuṭaṃ parameśvarisvaveśmani vidhāyaitat pīṭhe bhūmitale'pi vātrirātraṃ saptarātraṃ vā saptaviṃśatirātrakamnidhāyābhyarccya gadinamabhiṣiñcettataḥ sukhīteṣāṃ vilekhanadravyāṇyākarṇaya vadāmi tekāśmīramaguruṃ kuṣṭhaṃ elākakkolajātibhiḥjalairnakṣatravṛkṣotthaiḥ śubhairbbā sūkṣmapeṣitaiḥvāde vivāde samare dyūteṣu ca jayī bhavetdevyātmarūpāttenāsya tairbbādhā na bhaved dhruvamsaṃgrāmagamanaṃ varṣāmudyogaṃ vācamāgrahamtattattithiṣu taiḥ prāgvadvāñchitānāpnuyād dhruvamvāreśānapi saṃpūjya tattat phalamavāpnuyātvārarkṣatithisaṃproktayantre tāṃ taiśca daivataiḥrogaśāntiṃ samudyogaphalābhīṣṭānyavāpnuyātsamudyogaphalāni prārabdhakāryyaphalāniṛkṣavṛkṣāṃstathā yonī rnigade parameśvarimātaraśca tathā durgā diśo dhanadakeśavaunakṣatradevatāścāpi śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhiguruḥ sarpāśca pitaraḥ aryyamā bhaga eva caindro niṛtitoyākhyau viśvedevā haristathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ahirbradhnastathā pūṣā proktā nakṣatradevatāḥkhadiraḥ kṛṣṇavaṃśau ca pippalo nāgarohiṇauvakulaḥ saralaḥ sarjo vañjulaḥ panasastathāmadhūkaśceti saṃproktā vṛkṣā mānāṃ kramādamīajāmārjāramūṣāśca mūṣikā vṛṣamāhiṣīgokarṇo vānarī siṃhī turagā siṃhagogajāḥmūhurtaiḥ saṃkhyayāhobhiḥ śāntiḥ syāddviguṇena vāsarveṣāṃ nāmāni gurumukhādavagantavyāṇiced rogiṇo dehatyāga iti sampradāyaḥprokteṣu bhāvayettāni tāvanti maṇipūrakeviśuddhākhye ca catvāri pañcājñāyāmiti kramāttattaccakragatāḥ sarvā bhāvayet sarvasampadenatu sarvatra sarbbāṇi bhāvayenna kadācaproktānyādhārapadmāni kṛtvā tatrārcayecchivāmsaṃpūjya devīmiṣṭāni prāpnuyāt proktavāsaraiḥprokteṣu proktānyeva bhāvanīyāniphalānyavāpnuyādityupadiśatipañcāśanmithunānāñca proktacakre'rddharātrakemithunoktakrame śaktimantravaccakragāmināmtaisteṣāṃ teṣu kāleṣu valiṃ dadyāttatheritaiḥvidhāya tasya madhye tu kṛtvā dīpaṃ ghṛtāplutampratyekaṃ devatānāṃ vā mithunānāmathāpi vākulmāṣapāyasānnena vyañjanaṃ chāgamāṃsayuksādhayet saptabhiḥ pakṣānmāsānmaṇḍalato'pi bāpratyabdaṃ vā gṛhe mantrī jīvedādyāmahodayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smaraṇāt kīrttanāt sarvavāñchitānāpnuyurnarāḥyaistuṣṭiṃ prāpya tānyāśu prayacchantyabhivañchitampañcānāṃ mudgabhinnānnaṃ pañcānāṃ dadhibhaktakampañcānāṃ nārikelasya phalakṣodaṃ guḍānvitammithunārccārato nityaṃ yo'sau syānmāntrikāgraṇīḥsmaraṇānmithunānāṃ kālarūpitvānusandhānātasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtammithunānāṃ dravyāṇi | asau arccakaḥparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamsā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaroditāsaptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā purāevaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadādvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajetsā kurukullāsampradāyaḥtatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajetvalicakrañca tenaiva tanmadhye ca samarccayetkṛtvā tadantaḥ padmañca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamṣaḍaṅgaṃ vālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayet || 8 ||tanmadhye ratnapītamadhyetannāmamantreṇa tadarccayeditipañcaviṃśatyakṣarayā trivārādahīnamabhyarccayeccadhyātvatthaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramātdadhānāṃ cintayedvāṇaṃ cāpapāśatuṇīḥ karaiḥṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatastadājñayā rohe bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajetsūryyasomaṃ tithivāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapisampradāyaḥvyomavāyvagnitoyakṣmārūpiṇīśaktisaṃyutamghrāṇān buddhiṃ tathāśaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayettato vāṇān dhanuḥpāśamaṅkuśañcābhito yajetśaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye sambidāsanamarccayettatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥparīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarccayettatra tatra vainamo'ntairnāmabhiḥ pūrbbaṃ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥtṛtīyenetyarthaḥevaṃ samarccitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaramprasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvaripañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvaritāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīmrayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutamṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyāt hṛdambumarudanvitamtanmantrā yathā hrīḥ śrīḥ ikṣusāgarāya namaḥ ityādayaḥdevī iti śeṣaḥ | īśvarīti devīsambuddhiḥsvatantrapūjākramamupadiśatianayāsyā valiṃ dadyādvidyayā parameśvariasyāstoyeṣu sarbbatra bādho na bhavit smṛteḥdadhānāṃ bahuvarṇābhirvvahurūpābhirāvṛtāmratnapādukayoḥ nyastapadāmbujayugāṃ smaretsugandhibhiḥ sitaiḥ puṣpairannājyābhyāṃ ghṛtena vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japitvā pūjayet sandhyāsvatha tarpaṇahomakamṣoḍaśārṇena valiriti sampradāyaḥ | parameśvarīti debīsambuddhiḥnityahomadravyāṇyupadiśati | tatra vā vikalpeevaṃ saṃsiddhavidyastu nityārccāniratastathāhomena pūjayā yantrabhāvanena ca tān śṛṇusarṣapasnehasaṃsiktairmaricairānayecca tāḥnārīnaranṛpānanyān vaśayed yāvadāyuṣamhavanādvanitāḥ sarbbā mohayet premakautukaiḥvaśayecchatapatraiśca tathā vicakilaiḥ śubhaiḥphalakṣodaiḥ sitayutairhavanāt svarṇamāpnuyātprāguktakālato bittanicayaṃ samavāpnuyātkahlārahomato'bhīṣṭaṃ labhate kumudadvayaiḥraktapuṣpādiṣvanyatamenatatra nityārccānirataḥ puraścaraṇānantaramapi | tān prayogānpadmaiḥ sitairlohitaiśca pūjayedindirāptayejapāvandhūkakusumaistathā dāḍimajairapipunnāgajaiḥ pāṭalaiśca campakotthairyajecchiveproktakāleṣu vittāṭyo dharādhānyāṃśukādimānlabhate proktakālena tathā kālāgurudravaiḥkarpūrairāyuṣaḥ siddhai vaśyastrīdhanasiddhayekandarpasamasaubhāgyo vanitāsu naro bhavetabdamātraṃ tato loke viśrutaḥ syāt sa vaibhavaiḥpūjitaistaistu jagdhaiḥ syānnaroyātyakhilapriyaḥkumudadvayaiḥ raktasitaiḥnavayoniṃ vidhāyātra madhye māyāṃ sasādhyakām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bahirdaleṣvapi tathā likheddvidbikrameṇa vaikrameṇa cābhisaṃveṣṭya tena yantreṇa sādhayetyantraṃ rocanayālikhya bhūrje vā kṣaumakhaṇḍakeyajanataḥ | taiḥ karpūrādibhiḥ | jagdhairbhakṣitaiḥtāpayedrātriṣu dinaiḥ prāguktaiḥ striyamānayettatra devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayettairdinairbhavetgajavājitarakṣāditiyyagajātīrapi dhruvamgaurakeṇa samāvāhya devīṃ tatraiva pūjayetlābhāśca pūjanāttatra paśudāsīdhanādināmputrapautrakalatrājñādhanadhānyādimān bhavetsamastarogaduḥkhārttirahito varddhate sukhīkoṣṭheṣu pañcaviṃśatsu trīṇi koṇeṣu mārjayettanmadhye śaktimāyāsthāmālikhyākhyāṃ tato'bhitaḥvāñchitāṃ vanitāṃ mānakulalajjātilaṅghinīmpaṭṭaśuṇṭhīmāgadhikāmaricārkapayoyutamvidyāṃ trayodaśārṇāntu taddigvaktro dinaiḥ striyamvalālaṃghanīyavacanataḥ | vādvayaṃ vikalpārthaḥavasthābhiśca daśabhirmṛtimeti suniścitammadhūcchiṣṭapratikṛtaiḥ ṛju taṃ tāpayettathākaroti yāvaddehāntaṃ te pratīpā lapanti cajapitvā dhārayet sarvarogaduḥkhārttināśanamtadā striyaḥ śayānasya vairiṇyo dāsasannibhāḥbhūḥ svagarbhagataṃ nāma vilikhyāstriṣu ṣaṭsvapitadyantrasahitāmbaramitiśeṣaḥyantrametattālapatre bhūrjekṣaume'rkapatrake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra sthitā yebhujagāḥ palāyante'tha taddinevidhāya nityaśaḥ pūjāsamete rakṣato gṛheyakṣagandharvabhujagavṛścikādyā na tatra vaisahasravāraṃ salilairāsekaḥ kṣveḍanāśanaḥdehagaṃ parameśāni trividhaṃ bhīṣaṇātmakamtadrūpaṃ phaṇinaṃ vidyājapapūrvvaṃ nakhādināevaṃ sarvvaṃ triprakrāraṃ garalaṃ nāśayedidamtatra tairveṣṭayet sapta bhoginaṃ na brajedvahiḥtaiḥ ṣoḍaśasvaropetaiḥ saṃkhyāṣṭau ca śatadvayambahiḥ vālukāveṣṭhanātbahiḥ prāgvattatastaiḥ syād yantrāṇyaṣṭau maheśvaridvitīyādīni yantrāṇi sapta bhānvādivāsarevārākhyāṃ saptamīyuktāmālikhet sādhayeti tatproktakrameṇa vidhinā śāntimarcanatastathāsampādayedititannāśayanti tatpotamadhau sarbbaṃ tathā śivevāñchiteṣu samasteṣu tairdinaistānyavāpnuyātśatrubhaṅgaṃ vaśaṃ nārīnṛpamarttyādijanmināmdvāviṃśatiṃ tataścaikacatvāriṃśaccatuḥśatampañcapañcāśadanyāni koṣṭhavajra maheśvarimadhye'vaśiṣṭanavakamadhye nāmodarāṃ likhetsakalaprāṇijātaviṣayaḥtrikoṇeṣu ca sādhyāni likhedvajramitīritamvilikhyābhyarccya tadyantraṃ pote rakṣati vāridhauyantreṇānena kālena proktena satataṃ śive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śive iti devīsambuddhiḥākarṣantīṃ svapādānte sāñjaliṃ praṇatiṃ muhuḥsādhyo narotha nārī ca vaśameti suniścitamprotakeśasamākṛṣṭaṃ japet prāgvadbaśī bhavetsvayamevānayettāntu smaran jāpairbbaśaṃ nayetlalitāvigrahā yena vaśinyādiyutā tataḥasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtamiti ṣoḍaśanityātantre śrīkādimate dvāviṃśata paṭalam| yena lalitāvigrahavattvakāraṇena | tataḥ kāraṇāttaddvidhā kathitā pūrvaṃ tadaṅgāni ca pūjanamhomairyantraiśca vakṣyāmi samastābhīṣṭasiddhayedaśabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptasaṃkhyairjātibhiranvitamvidhāya cakraṃ tatraiva svanāmnāvāhya pūjayetpūrvaṃ tṛtīye paṭale | sādhanaṃ vidyāyā iti śeṣaḥnamaḥ ityādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ | anvita kriyāviśeṣaṇametatsarvamadhye samabhyarccya vāmadakṣāgrakoṇataḥādyabījāntyasaprāṇairupetāmatha pūjayetvṛtte caiva mahālakṣmīṃ pañcamīṃ madhyatastathātadagre tāṃ japedvidyāṃ sahasramathavā śatamghṛtena vā tato vidyā siddhā syādaṣṭatastataḥvidyāṃ japellakṣasaṃkhyāṃ taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇamgurubhaktaḥ susantuṣṭaḥ śāntacittaḥ kṣamānvitaḥsidhyatyayatnato devyāḥ prasādādvaibhavādapiākaṇṭhaṃ vanitārūpāṃ jvalatpiṅgaśiroruhāmproktanityabhajanataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśañca muśalaṃ śīramabhayaṃ varadaṃ tathānitthapūjāsu tacchaktīstatsamānāḥ smarecchivegajārūḍhāṃ hayārūḍhāṃ tārkṣyārūḍhāñca śaktibhiḥtatprayogeṣu ca tathā dhyāyettattadavāptayeāvṛtāṃ pañcamīṃ dhyāyan japedvaśyāptaye'niśamtacchaktīḥ parivāraśaktīḥ smarediti nityapūjāsviti pūrvatrānvayaḥ| saheti śeṣaḥ | vakṣyamāṇakrameṇaaruṇākalpāṃ padmarāgādibhiḥ kṛtākalpāmpītaśaktyāvṛtāṃ dhyāyet stambhaneṣu tu sarccadāśaktibhiḥ svasamānābhirantābhiḥ samāyutāmsvātmānaṃ bhāvayanmantrī vrajedakliṣṭavaibhavaḥgavayairbhujagairbhīmairdantibhirmmadamantharaiḥbhūtapretapiśācādyairākule'raṇyasaṅkaṭesmareddevīmuktarūpāṃ nirātaṅko brajet sukhīsaṅkaṭeṣu duranteṣu smṛtvetthaṃ vijayī bhavetpītaśaktyāvṛtāṃ pītavarṇābhiḥ śaktibhirāvṛtāmproktopasaṃhārārthartvātvānna punaruktidoṣaḥcakrañca dakṣiṇairvibhradvāhubhirbhīmavigrahāmpāśaṃ śaṅkhañca dadhatīmanyairnīlāṃ svaśaktibhiḥvairisenāṃ samastāñca nipātya parighairbhuvicarantīṃ śaktivṛndaiśca bhīmārāvairmmadoddhataiḥtaddehaniryyadraktāktaśūlāṃ devīṃ vicintayetsaptarātraprayogeṇa vairiṇaṃ mārayej jvarātkadalīketusaṅkulaṃ kadalīnibhagajapatākāsaṅkulaṃ deśamiti śeṣaḥekāgracittaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ripudehaṃ smaret pherukaṅkakravyādakukkuraiḥprāgvattāvaddinairvārihataṃ smṛ (śru)tvā samuttaretutpāṭayantīṃ saṃcintya japan śatrūn yamaṃ nayetkrodhaṃ saṃśayedvāde vivāde samare'pi cavṛtāṃ tārkṣyagaṇoddāmapakṣamārutamūrcchitāmvārihataṃ jale mṛtaṃ ripumiti śeṣaḥsaṃcintya japan śatruṃ mārayediti sampradāyārthaḥsampradāyārthaḥsenāmityanenānvayaḥ | kṣaṇāt smṛtimātreṇatathaivāṣṭabhujaiḥ khadgān dadhānāṃ śaktibhirvṛtāmvikīryya keśānaruṇavāravāṇadharo hayaiḥśaktivṛndaistriśūlāgraprotapattyaśvavāraṇaiḥdhyāyannarāteḥ pṛtanā nāśayet svairvalairnṛpaḥprāguktairmmaṇḍalādyaistu vāsaraiḥ parameśvariiṣṭamanyacca sakalaṃ stambhayet sādhakaḥ kṣaṇātśeṣaḥ | tathaiva japādinā | kṣaṇāt prāgvathayavṛndasahito hayārūḍho nṛpaḥ śatrusenāṃ svavalairnāśayeditiprāgvatnihantukāmaḥ sarvāṃstu ripuṃ kuryyādvaśe dhruvamyamakaṇṭakakāle vā kṛṣṇapuṣpaistathāvidhāmśyāmāñca saurabhādyaistaiḥ puṣpairabhyarccya vāsaraiḥsukhaṃ jīvati bhūmau sa śatavarṣāṇi viśrutaḥśeṣaḥ | aruṇaiḥ aruṇavarṇaiḥ madhyarātrataḥ madhyarātreprāguktamaṇḍalādyaiḥpūrvatrānvayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaḥ kuryāccareṇa sahitaṃ priye !śūnyaṃ vyāptaṃ ca hṛdyuktaṃ rayadāhasvavahnibhiḥhaṃsaḥ syāddāhavahnisvairyuktamantyamudīritamkathitā parameśāni ! vanitājanamohinīkāmeśvaryāstṛtīyādivarṇānāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavetekādaśākṣarī nityaklinnā nityā samīritāśeṣaḥ | parameśānīti devīsambuddhiḥ || 30jāyate sādhako nityaṃ kandarpādhikasundaraḥraso dāhena tadyuktaṃ prāṇo dāha vana sva yukjyā ca dāhena tadyuktā nityaklinnāntato dvayamyasyāḥ smaraṇato naśyedgaralaṃ trividhaṃ kṣaṇātvanitāḥ artha prāṇādyupakārikā vaśyā bhavanti || 32 || 33likucarasakarpūrāditato'mbu śūnyaṃ haṃsāgniyuktamambu marudyutamśūnyaṃ nabhaḥśaktiyutaṃ navārṇeyamudīritāyasyāḥ smaraṇato vaśyaṃ jāyate bhuvanatrayampañcamaṃ bhagamālādyaṃ bheruṇḍāyā dvitīyakamvisarjanīyasahitaṃ maḥ iti || 39 || viśvaghasmarā pralaye viśvagrāsakarīduḥkhasaṅghātatāriṇī avivekatāriṇītyarthaḥaṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ paścādetadādyamitīritamkāntārasāgarakrūraduḥkhasaṅghātatāriṇīambu syānmarutā yuktaṃ gotrā kṣmāsaṃyutā tataḥantyārṇau vahnivāsinyā dūtī nityā samīritāśrīkārī śivatāvāptikāriṇī sarvasiddhidāhaṃso dharāsvasaṃyuktaḥ tejaścarasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: haridrāmilitairannaistilairmmāṣaiḥ sataṇḍulaiḥsakalīkṛtya likhitasādhyavarṇasamanvitaiḥniśācūrṇairghṛtāktaistu homaḥ stambhayate tathāmāṃsaistaddehasambhūtasnehāktairhavanāddinaiḥdahanairvvāraṇairanyaiḥ prasādaiḥ kaṇṭakādibhiḥśatrubhirbbā prayogāmī na bhavantyeva bhaṅgurāḥghṛtāktairghṛtapariplutaiḥ | tathā maṇḍalādibhiḥdhyāyan riporaṣṭame tu rāśau chāgaghṛtāplutaiḥtībradāhajvaragrastaṃ visaṃjñaṃ vikṛtāṅgakamsarūpavatsāruṇagoghṛtāktairaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥjapāprasūnaiḥ pālāśaiḥ karavīrasamudbhavaiḥaśokajaiḥ kusumbhātthairanyaiḥ puṣpaiśca lohitaiḥanyairapi ca tatsaktaparairaṅgaiḥ suniścitamviśeṣyaṃ | taddinaiḥ prāgvat vikṛtāṅgakaṃ asvādhīnāṅgamchatracāmarādibhiḥ paricchadaiḥmadhyarātre hunet sādhyadiṅmukho maricaistathābhavet kīrttīndirāyuktaściraṃ jīvati bhutalebhaumākṣarāṇi tadbāhye daśāgrādabhito likhetmantrākṣarāṇi ṛtuśastadvahirvṛttayugmakamtatkoṇeṣvantarāleṣu mantrārṇān bhūdaśānvitānproktairdinaiḥ prāgvanmaṇḍalādibhiḥ apivā apicetyarthaḥvilomamātṛkāṃ tatra nyasya bhūmipuraṃ vahiḥpūjayannakhilaṃ lokaṃ stambhayedarivāhinīmprāpnotīticaturasrañca saṃlikhya mantrārṇān ṣaṭ ṣaḍālikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturasre ca vilikhet pratilomānulomakamstambhaḥ syāt pūrbbamuktānāṃ vidhānāt parameśvaripūjayannarātigatyādikaṃ stambhayatītiaṣṭāsraṃ tadvahirbbṛtte iti kṛtvātra vinyasettrayaṃ trayaṃ sam1ālikhya vahiḥ śiṣṭantu pārthivaiḥsthāpayet kvāpi tatraiva nityaśaśca valiṃ kṣipetpūrvoktaphalaṃ prāpnotītikramāttrikoṇavṛttāntarālān ṣaṭkoṇasaṃyutānvilikhellipiśaḥ sarvvāṃ mātṛkāṃ śaktisaṃyutāmmāyāmadhyagataṃ devi dhārayet sarbbasiddhayegajavājikharoṣṭrādirogaśāntyai ca dhārayetrekhāgre sarvvataḥ śūlāstanmadhyāgre ca pārśvayoḥparito vilikhenmantravarṇān bhaumasamanvitāngṛhapaṭṭanayorlohadṛśadoriṣṭasiddhidamproktakramasandhāraṇāt proktaphalasiddhiritisthāpayedbhittimadhye ca bhūmau ca kramataḥ śiveyāvatphalāpti kurvīta niyataṃ sandhyayordvayoḥtaistu koṣṭhāni jāyante pañcaviṃśaiḥ śatadvayamaṣṭāviṃśati koṣṭhāni tataḥ śiṣṭeṣu dikṣvapimadhye triṣu tu koṣṭheṣu sādhyasādhakakarmma camantrārṇānagramārabhya vilikhedabhitaḥ śivepūjayannabhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnotītiyatraitat sthāpitaṃ lohaśilādilikhitaṃ śivebhūtapretapiśācādikopajāścāpyupaplavāḥvāstumarmmādiduḥkhādi śamayed gehagañca tat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtyābhicārakṣudrādi pīḍā na bhavati dhruvamprāṇapratiṣṭhādipuraḥsaramabhyarcya sthāpanāt proktaphalasiddhirititairvvajrarūpakoṣṭhāni ekaviṃśaśatambhavetagrādabhita evānyānyakṣarāṇi samālikhetsthāpitaṃ lohaśilādilikhitaṃ pūjitantu vāanyāni kleśakārīṇi yāni tāni vināśayetvilikhya madhye kumbhantu kṣīradrukkāthapūritamspṛśañjalaṃ japedvidyāṃ sahasratrayamātmavāntaiḥ kleśairmuktadehastu sukhī jīvati bhūtalesaikaviṃśaśate vāpi kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya secayetdvyaṅgule dvyaṅgule kuryyādekādaśa tataḥ kramātekādaśa tatasteṣu prāṅmadhyāttu pradakṣiṇamrekhāgrāṇi ca śūlāni kṛtvā sādhyañca madhyataḥanyatamaṃyantre ityarthaḥnāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyayā siddhayā'nayāasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamtrayoviṃśaṃ paṭalam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamkathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe vāñchitārthasuradrumānprayogeṣu samasteṣu vāhyābhyantarataḥ kramātdhyāyeddevīḥ samastāśca lohitākāramaṇḍanāḥvidveṣoccāṭanidhananigraheṣvasitāḥ smaretsarvvatra svasamākāravarṇaśaktibhirāvṛtāḥvasanabhūṣaṇamālyānulepanādiviṣayaḥekadbyādisamārabdhairvvarṇākāraistu śaktayaḥko vā śṛṇoti sākalyāt tataḥ kiñcidvadāmi te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āpyāḥ sattvaguṇāḥ sarvvāḥ sitākārāḥ samīritāḥāgneyā rājasāḥ sarvvā lohitākārasaṃyutāḥdhyānabhedeṣukiñcidvadāmītivāyurūpā dhūmravarṇā sarvā dveṣādikārakāḥāsāṃ mukhabhujādehavidhānaṃ śṛṇu pārvatiṣoḍaśāsyāḥ pañcaviṃśadvadanā api kāścanacatuḥṣaṣṭimukhāstadvadekāśītiśatānanāḥvāyunabhasorājasaguṇātmakatvabhastīti sampradāyaḥprastauti | tatra pārvatītisambuddhiḥtathāpi darśitaṃ kiñcidvaktre bhujadvayaṃ dvayamvasanti nānārūpāśca bhaveyustatra vāñchayālalitāṅgitvarūpeṇa sarvāsāmātmavigrahāḥtāttadvarṇāyudhākāravāhanaiśca susaṃyutāḥiti tāsāṃ dhyānabhedāḥ sthūlāḥ proktā maheśvarisampradāyārthaḥnityānāmyena te sādhakāḥ sarvve vāṅchitaṃ prāpnuyuḥ kṣaṇātvibhāvya tejonicaye tatra siddhiñca cintayetpūjātarpaṇahomādirahitaṃ bhāvanena vainirvvātadīpasaṅkāśamātmanātmasamīkṣaṇātparivāratvena sthitāśca dhyeyā bhavantītiprāpnotītiproktakrameṇa deveśi satataṃ sādhyasādhakaiḥsādhayet pararūpantu sādhyaṃ sādhanasiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyānayoḥ karmmaṇā siddhiṃ vividhāṃ phalayogataḥśṛṇu vakṣye maheśāni krameṇa tava sāmpratampāṣāṅkuśau caturbbāhau ṣaḍbhuje cāpasāyakauparadhyānamitivacanācca tadeva prāpyamiti yāvatdvisaṃkhyacatuḥsaṃkhyabhujādikrameṇasukhapāṇyāyudhānāntu rūpasaṃkhyādivāñchayātathā tasyāgrato bhūtvā pālayati tamādarātdaṃṣṭrogrā bhīmanayanavadanāḥ krūrakarmmasuśubhetareṣu tāḥ sarvvāḥ prayogeṣu tu sarvvadāvirājamānāstāḥ sarvvā divyāṃśukadharā apirūpasaṃkhyādītyatrādiśabdaḥ proktaviṣayasaṃkhyetaraviṣayaḥityasya tathā ityanenānvayaḥ | āvirbhūyetyarthaḥdaṃṣṭrogrā ityuttarārddhenāśubhakarmmasu dhyānamnavaratnamayaiḥ sarvvāstavakaiścopaśobhitāḥviśeṣaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattatkarmmasu siddhidamvyāghratārkṣyasamārūḍhā dhyeyā rakṣāsu sarvvadāpiśācacoravyālādidurgame'raṇyavartmaniekaikaśaḥ samastā vā sukhī bhavati niścitamuccāṭaneṣu sarvvāstā bhīmā dhyeyāḥ sudāruṇāḥsarvaprayogasādhāraṇāni | maheśvarīti devīsambuddhiḥsvasvaparivārasahitā vā | niścitamityantenāmoghaphalatvamucyatebhīmā vigrahādibhiriti | sudāruṇāḥ karmmaṇīti śeṣaḥvidveṣaṇeṣu sarvāstā ghorapraharaṇākulāḥcintayet sakalāḥ sarvvakṣudrakarmmasu sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti vāhanabhedena phalabhedāḥ samīritāḥdvinetrāstvekavadanā daṃṣṭrogrā bhīmavigrahāḥbhīmarāvābhirabhito veṣṭitā raṇamurddhanipalāyanotsagahanāt pādayoḥ patanena vātatra kauśikaḥ divābhītaḥ | ghorapraharaṇākulā ghorāyudhaniviḍāḥvāhanaviśeṣamupadiśati || kṣudrakarmasu vaśyākarṣaṇādiṣuvibhāvya vā jaya yuddhe prāpnotyuktakrameṇa vaivāmaiḥ kodaṇḍanivahamanyaiḥ khaḍgañca vibhratīḥvamadrudhiradhārāñca vijayaṃ proktamāpnuyātcaturaṅgaripoḥ senāṃ chindatīstaravāribhiḥpattyaśvebharathāṭopavādyaniḥśanasaṅkuleathavā navabhirhastairgadā vāmaistathetaraiḥtadbhinnacaturaṅgāṃñca senāṃ vijayamāpnuyātvijayī bhavati proktakramāddvāre raṇāṅgaṇedhyātvā vā vijayī bhūyāt samare romaharṣaṇedhyātvā vijayamāpnoti niyataṃ samare nṛpaḥvijayaṃ samare śaśvadaśnute śaṅkaropamaḥsmṛtvā vijayamāpnoti nṛpaḥ proktakramād dhruvamcintayan samare mīme vijayī syāt suniścitamsmaran pravijayaṃ yuddhe prāpnoti dhyānavaibhavātprāgvat pramathitārātipṛtanāñcintayan japettaithaikādaśabhirbhedairāyudhairnighnatīrvvalamtathā smaraṇasaṃyuktaiḥ pūjayettāstadā'grahetathaiva daśarūpaistairvāraiḥ praharaṇairyutāḥpraharantīstathārātīn smṛtvā jayamavāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praharantīḥ smared yuddhe jayī bhavati niścitamtathāvidhaiḥ praharaṇaiḥ smaran yuddhe jayī bhavetsmṛtvā vijayamāpnoti samare tāśca ṣoḍaśatathā tairhetinivahairvyākulakramahastakaiḥevasuddāmasamarasaṃkaṭādiṣu cintayantaddhetibhiḥ pūrvoktaikādaśavidhadvandvahetibhiḥdevo vā rākṣaso yakṣaḥ kinnaro vā bhujaṅgamaḥna kadācit smarannityaṃ bhaṅgamāpnoti niścitamdvividhairvairibhirjātaiḥ kṛcchre rājabhaye'thavāpiśācaḍākinīvṛndabrahmarākṣasapīḍanesmarannitthaṃ yajet sarvā vipado dhyānavaibhavātsapādukāḥ samāgatya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥgāyantībhiśca nṛtyeṣu vanamālābhiranvitāḥnāsādhyamasti bhuvane dhyānādāsāṃ maheśvariitthamabhīṣṭamukhakarāyudhādirūpataḥ | bhaṅgaṃ parājayammaheśvarīti sambuddhiḥsmerānanāśca gāyantīḥ smṛtvā viśvaṃ vaśaṃ nayetsaṅgītāsaktamahilāvṛndasaṃkulamadhyagāḥnānābhogasamopetāṃ prakhyātanijavaibhavāmtathā saṅgitasaṃsaktaśaktivṛndasamanvitāḥevaṃ tattrividhadhyānāt saubhāgyamatulaṃ yaśaḥproktakramālaṅkṛtahayagajarathārūḍhadhyānāt | atulaṃ nirupamampādukāsaktacaraṇā āgacchanti svaśaktibhiḥnidhiṃ saṃprāpya bhuvane bhogī syād yāvadāyuṣamevaṃ campakapunnāganameruvakuleṣvapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājato dhanito'nyasmād yenāsau syāt sukhī ciramprāpnotyanargharatnāni bahūni dhyānavaibhavātsmaran kanakamāpnoti varṇotkṛṣṭamasaṃkhyakamyāvadāyuṣaṃ yāvajjīvamanantarapūrvoktaprakāreṇasyāttāvaddhanamityarthaḥpūrvoktadhyānaprakāreṇatathā prāgvat dhyānaprakāreṇarūpayauvanaśīlāḍhyāḥ premanighnāstvananyagāḥnṛpatiṃ kurute vaśyaṃ manovākkāyakarmmabhiḥvaśīkaroti bhuvane prāṇinaścā viśeṣataḥvāñchitaṃ samavāpnoti muktaḥ syānnigaḍāditaḥvāñchitāni likhitvā tāḥ paṭeṣu navasu sphuṭamrathadantihayānāntu tiraskaraṇikāyutānvajrālikhitaniśānabherīpaṇavamarddalānśeṣaḥ | premanighnāḥ premaparavaśāḥkṛtavandhanaviśeṣādiviṣayaḥvajrādabhimukhaṃ vairī dhāvatyāśu parājitaḥiti dhyānānyaśeṣeṇa kathitāni tavānagheatastacchṛṇu vakṣyāmi sarvābhīṣṭābhikārakāḥtanmadhye sādhyarūpañca nijavāñchānurūpakamtathā suṣumnāntastacca cintayedvā gamāgamamsādhakaśca tathā siddhastayorevāśusiddhikṛtiti sambuddhiḥsūkṣmarūpadhyānaprayogeṣvanadhikāratvamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamvarṇaistajjanitairmmantrairyantraiḥ kālātmatāṃ kramātyajjñānopāstibhedābhyāṃ mantrāḥ sidhyanti varṇinaḥteṣu tattvāni ṣaḍviṃśadvargā nāthanavātmikāḥvāsanāpaṭalavakṣyamāṇāḥ sattvādivihīnāḥmātṛkāyā navātmakā vargāsta eva navātmakā nāthāḥ syuritimātṝṇāntu svaraireko vargaḥ pūrvavaduttaramṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ tatsaṃkhyābdaistu pūrṇatāpūrṇakālasamāvṛttiryugakalpādināmabhāktasya turyyāṃśaturyyāṃśahānyā tretādisambhavaḥyugakalpādiamabhāk yugakalpādisaṃjñā bhavatitān dinākṣarasaṃyuktānmadhyayonau samālikhetvāmordhvadakṣapārśveṣu pañca pañca samīritāḥvyañjaneṣu tu sarvvatra suśliṣṭāḥ svena saṃyutāḥrekaścaturyugo bhavatītinigrahe vāstuvinyāse garbhanyāseṣṭasiddhikṛtekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇapañcāśatparivṛttitaḥsavisarjanīyamitareṣu savindukaṃ likheditipadacchedaḥ | āgamānāṃ sandhirdivyatvādasmābhirna vicāraṇīyaḥevaṃ yugādimārabhya kālātmārṇaiḥ pravarttateteṣu paryyāyanityārṇavarṇānālikhya bāhyataḥnityāḥ ṣoḍhaśa deveśi pūjayennityamarccakaḥṣaṭṣaḍāvṛttayaḥ sambhavantītiadhamā māsamātreṇa māsādūrddhvamayogyatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaṭtriṃśattattvavarṇāstaddvitīyā marutā kramāttripurāḥ sarvvasiddhānāmākarāḥ kathitāḥ kramātproktakāle ṣoḍaśa nityāḥ samarccayeditiyatra tatra gadālakṣmīgrahadurbhikṣaśātravāḥabhīpsitāni sidhyanti tasya yo'rccati nityaśaḥtāsāṃ saṃkhyā samākhyātā tadāvṛttistadāptikṛtvakṣyamāṇasaṃkhyā vidyāḥ sambhavantītietadgranthitajāpena mantrāḥ sidhyanti varṇinaḥcatvāri ceti vijñeyāstattvāvṛttirudīritāḥdviśataṃ ṣaṇavatyaśca niḥśeṣaṃ samudīritāḥtā vidyāstattvarūpiṇyaḥ śeṣāstvante dviśaḥ smṛtāḥṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāvṛttiḥ niḥśeṣaṃ samastavyāptiḥviśeṣato vidhātavyaṃ jayārogyādisiddhayetatprakāraḥ prayogānāṃ paṭale sādhu vakṣyateghaṭikākramayogena bhajante parivarttanamvṛttaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadasrañca tadvadaṣṭādaśāsrakammaṇḍalīkaraṇamcaturasramatha tryasramiti bhedā nava kramāttena dvāsaptatirbhedāsteṣu nityārṇabhedataḥeteṣvādyasya vṛttasya vinyāsenānyadunnayetevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryyādekaikāṅgulato vahiḥṣaṭtriṃśadbhistatasteṣu nyasedarṇān tathāditaḥbāhyābhyantaḥparāvṛttau tathā vyākīrṇamityapicakraṃ saptatriṃśadbhirvṛttaiḥ | prāgvat ṣoḍaśāraiśca kuryātyojayedvāhyakoṣṭhasthaiḥ prāguktavidhinā kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yutaṃ tyai iti | antyārṇau vahnivāsinyāḥ nama ityarthaḥsamastāpattāriṇī avivekāpannāśakarīhṛdā rayeṇa dāhena vahniḥ syādaṣṭamaṃ priye !dyutirnādayutā nityā tvaritā dvādaśākṣarīviṣaduḥkhapraśamanī sarvābhīṣṭāptikāriṇīprāṇo dvitīyaḥ svayuto vanahṛcchaktibhiḥ paraḥyasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyaterepha īkāraiḥ strī ityaṣṭamaṃ bījam | priye ! iti devī sambuddhiḥdvayornāśakarī51 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa japārādhanādivaiguṇyenāpītyarthaḥvidyayā kulasundaryā yojitaḥ sampradāyataḥpratilomādibhī rūpairdvāsaptatibhirāhatānigrahānugrahau cāsya jāyate svecchayā'niśamhṛcca dāhakṣmāsvayutaṃ vajreśī pañcamaṃ tataḥdvāsaptatirbhedāḥ sambhavanti, teṣvādyā pradhānā seyamitiyogabalādityarthaḥbhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramātdyutirdāhacarasvena asyā ādyamanantaramsamare vijayaṃ khaḍgapādukāñjanasiddhidānidhānavilasiddhānnasādhanī kāmadoditāaṣṭamaṃ bījam vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramātsaptadaśamityarthaḥsvena yuktā bhavennityāvijayaikākṣarī matāvidhatte smaraṇādeva vijayā viśvavaibhavāekākṣaryā'nayā siddho jāyate khecaraḥ kṣaṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāsre ṣoḍaśārāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvṛttamanyavatkṛtvā daleṣu kramaśo vāgdevyaṣṭakamālikhetvidhāya pūjayennityaṃ pustapūjoktasiddhayena kadācicchriyo hānirbhaviṣyati ca tatkuleśloke anyat sarvaṃ pūrvamevāsmābhirvyākhyātamtatra devīṃ samāvāhya saṃpūjya vidhivanniśisaṃpūjya śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya śaktyā tamabhiṣecayetkuryyāt karṣasuvarṇasya mudrikāṃ gāśca dakṣiṇāmpārthivastasya vandyo vā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥvarṣatrayābhiṣekeṇa siddhirvaidyādharī bhavetubhayaṃ mātṛkācakrārcanaṃ pustakārcanañcapañcavarṣābhiṣekeṇa pañcatvaṃ nādhigacchatisaptavarṣābhiṣekeṇa divākarasamo bhavetnavavarṣābhiṣekeṇa devīsārūpyamāpnuyātāvṛttīrjapahomārccātarpaṇaiḥ sādhu sādhayettathotpāteṣu sarvveṣu tathā rogādyupadraveāhlādakaratvādinā | devīsārūpyaṃ parāhantātmatām || 48 || oṃ ||tathā kṛtyāsamutpattāvitthaṃ sarvvārthsiddhidametaccakrāravinyāsarūpā bhūmiśca dṛśyatesarvve manorathāḥ siddhā bhajanaṃ sampradāyataḥkṛṣṇapakṣeṣu śukleṣu kevaloktakramaṃ bhajetamuṃ jñātvā vidhātavyamanyathānarthamāvahetpunaruktidoṣo na bhavatītyarthaḥnityakarmma kāmyakarmma veti śeṣaḥ | anyathā tatprakārākaraṇekālena prāptamanyatra sarvatra samudīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rogaśatrujaye prokte parāvṛttakrameṇa vaiuccāṭaneṣu vyākīrṇaṃ teṣu śāntyai kramaṃ yajettasminnarikṛtāḥ pīḍāḥ kṛtyādyā naiva sammukhāḥyatrāsau nivasatyeṣa tatkṣetraṃ tattapovanamsampradāyāccapratiṣṭhite yantrarāje tat syājjanapadaṃ mahatuccāṭitā punardevi mayāpi ca na rakṣvatevilikhya bhūmau nikhaned grāmarāṣṭrapurādiṣukarṇikāmadhyage veraṃ kuryyāt sānnidhyasiddhayepuṇyakṣetramjanapadaviśeṣaṇam | sa deśo janapadaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥpunaralpasāmarthyādyairityarthaḥkhātvāvaṭaṃ punasteṣu pāṣāṇairghaṭitaṃ dṛḍhampāṣāṇena tadācchādya pīṭhaṃ kṛtvopari sthiramtrisandhyamevaṃ kurvvīta nānyathā siddhidāyakamhotṛṇāṃ dakṣiṇā vastrabhūbhūṣādāsagodhanaiḥjapatarpaṇahomairvvā sekaiḥ saṃsādhayet sthiraḥtasmāttadābhirupāyaiḥ sādhayet sarvamīpsitammucyate nigaḍaiḥ kṛcchrairvairirodhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥlabhante tanayān vandhyā api sarvaguṇānvitānproktagrāmādi rakṣāsiddhiḥ | etatsamaṃ cakrāntaraṃ na vidyata itihotṛṇāmuktāni dravyāṇi dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāditipañcavidhasādhanaiḥguṇarūpādisampannāṃ bhāryyāṃ vindantyayatnataḥlabhante putrapautrādyairedhante sampadanvitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triśatairbhumiśasyāḍhyaścaturbhistu śatairdhanīsaptabhistu śatairasya na muñcatyanvayaṃ ramānavabhistu śataireṣa kandarpo vanitājaneāsāntu vidyānityānāmañgāni śṛṇu sundariuktānyanyāni durlabhānyabhīṣṭāni sidhyantītivinyasya mātṛkāyuktāṃ japedvidyāntamekaśaḥpāśāṅkuśekṣukodaṇḍaprasūnaviśikhāḥ smaretcaturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā dvāradvayavibhūṣitamtattannityāvidyoktanyāsajātapuraḥsaraṃ japediti ca sampradāyaḥmūladevatāsadṛśāḥ varṇādibhiriti śeṣaḥaṅgāvṛttiṃ madhyayonāvantare tvāyudhāvṛtimbahirdaleṣvapi tathā yajedvarṇairvilomataḥbrāhmyādiśakīstadvāhye caturasradvaye yajetsaptākṣaryyā kevalayā proktarūpāṃ smaran dhiyātanmadhyārṇaṃ svarairbhinnaṃ likhitvāsriṣu māyayāvātādyarṇaṃ hṛdantaṃ syāddvādaśa dvādaśa kramāttābhistādātmyaṃ darśayatītyārādhyapādamukhādavagato'rthaḥstutvā dvādaśabhiḥ ślokaistaiḥ svānte tāḥ samudvasettadaiva devatācakrasāmyamasya bhaviṣyatitatraiva devīmāvāhya pūjayet sarvasiddhayecaṇḍī sunetreti pañcākṣaravākyajanitasaṃkhyāni cakrāṇi bhavantītitatrājñāsiddhayo loke prakāśante mahādbhutāḥsundarīṃ yuvatīṃ tatra saṃsthāpyābhyarccayet kramaiḥpūrṇe tu divase tena devī tuṣṭeṣṭadā bhavettuṣṭābhīṣṭapradā bhavediti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyadvā śastramakhilaṃ mahācakrasya madhyagamdattvā taiḥ samare śatrūn hatvā vijayamāpnuyātjapanto vāramekantu vidyā nityātmikāstu tāḥtaiṃstairdevatātmabhiḥ yuddhe sarvaśatrūn hatvā vijayaṃ prāpnotītilabhante lalitā yābhiḥ sampradāyavatau bhavetkṛtaṃ janmāntare samyak sampradāyāya kalpatetenākṣarāṇāṃ siddhatvānmantrāḥ sidhyantyaśeṣataḥsādhakasya kālāntare putrapautrādiṣu vā satsampradāyā bhavantītinṛpāṇāmaṅganānāñca vallabho jāyate śivaḥasyā niphālanāccitte tattattva svātmasāt kṛtampañcaviṃśatipaṭalam| duṣkaraṃ karttumaśakyaṃ | śivaḥ paripūrṇāhantātmāparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭammantrāṇāṃ vaibhavaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu devi yathābidhitataḥ padāni vākyāni mantrarūpāṇi kānicitamṛteśvaridevyāstu varṇaistairmmithunairapisamuddiṣṭakrameṇaiva sarvvametadaśeṣataḥmūlādhāre samutpannaḥ parākhyo nādasambhavaḥpaśyantyākhyāmavāpnoti tathaivorddhvaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥsaṃkhyātairmantreḥ prayogānityatrānvayaḥsañjāyata ititathā tayorddhvanunnaḥ sa viśuddhau kaṇṭhadeśataḥjihvāmūlāgrapṛṣṭhasthastathā nāsāgrataḥ kramātsamutpannānyakṣarāṇi kramādādikṣakābadhiteṣu svarāḥ svatantrāḥ syustairvyajyādvyañjanaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavatītisaṃyogenaiva jāyante tadrūpāṇi tu saṃkhyayātairvvākyāni ca mantrāśca vedabhāśānyabhedataḥśabdavyākaraṇādīnāṃ niyamādiyutāstathātribhirityādirūpāṇāṃ saṃkhyā karttuṃ na śakyateevaṃ śabdasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ kasyāpi nāsti hilalitācakranavake pratyekaṃ śaktayaḥ priyekoṭyaḥ syustatkramāttāsāṃ vidyā vakṣyāmi tāḥ kramāt| śaktiḥ sāmarthyaṃ asya pūrvaślokenānvayaḥ | diśā upāyenakramāt yathā kramamdvitīyāni ca tānyeva krameṇa syurathāditaḥkṣāntaiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadarṇaistaiḥ samāyairuktasaṃkhyakāḥtābhistatkoṭisaṃkhyākā vidyāstricaturarṇakāḥpuruṣārthāstu sidhyanti taduktaṃ mātṛkāyudhaiḥsamānatve'pi dehādervyāpāre guruśiṣyayoḥpratyakṣaṃ yaistu dṛṣṭāntairāśu te darśayāmyahamga aḥ ityādīni a ā kṣa aḥ ityantāni bhavantītiprāguktāni phalānyāpnotītisā jarārogamaraṇakleśairna spṛśyate'nyathāātmanaścedarūpasya saṃskāro naiva yujyatevuddheścedātmanā sāmyāt kasya syād guruvīkṣaṇamsekekṣaṇopadeśaistu guruṇā kriyate tu yatyadavāpya tyajatyāśu saṃśayākhyaṃ mahāmalamsaṃskāraḥ kriyate samyag guruṇā tattvavedināvīkṣaṇādātmano vuddherayathārthanikṛntanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dustarāṃ tāṃ dhiyā svātmavimarśena vināśayetvināśo nityaśuddhātmasvarūpālambha ityubheśasyānāṃ bījarūpasya bahnisparśāt prarohitātathāsyājñānajanmādi kāraṇaṃ yattathaiva tatdṛśyate tatprarohaśca puṣpādi ca tathā bhavetsusādhyaṃ sadguruprāptamaghānāṃ saṅgavarjjitamrahitaṃ te vadāmyadya mantravidyāstvanantakāḥsādhakānāñca siddhānāṃ netareṣāṃ kathañcanasadvāsanāṃ sādhvasādhucintāvirahitaṃ sadāpravṛttirgurūktirūpa svānubhūtisvarūpiṇī bhavatītiubhayātmakamātmasvarūpaṃ nādasya tasya taiḥparāhantāmayaṃ sarvasvarūpasvātmavigrahamprakāśarūpamātmatve vastu tadbhāsate paramvati mandi ntrīdhehisa dāsataḥ rva sathāvasamantrāṇāṃ paratattvārthavācakatvādabhedatābhavantītitathaiva ca parāyāśca gāyatryāścoktarūpataḥpraṇavasya ca tadrūpayogāt syāttattadātmatāhaṃsarūpāṃ prāṇaśaktiṃ tadvailāmyasamudbhavamitare bhaktimantaścet kālāttajjñānamāpnuyuḥbhaktibhede ca kathaya yayāpnotyakhilaṃ dhruvamyadanvayāt phalāvāptiryadviyoge śramo vṛthātatsāmarasyarūpaparamārthajñānaṃ dadātītisamyak phalamayīṃ siddhamalabhyāmalpapuṇyataḥvidyānuṣṭhānayoḥ sthairyyaṃ dhiyaḥ saṃśayanāśataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yayā vihīnā niyatamihāmutra ca duḥkhinaḥādhivyādhimahādāvaprāvṛṣañcāmṛteśvarīmṣaḍvidhāṃ japahomārccātarpaṇadhyānayantrakaiḥjyākaṃ dāhavanasvaiḥ syāttṛtīyā sāmṛteśvarīśeṣaḥjapahomārccatarpaṇadhyānayantrarkaiḥ saheti śeṣaḥaṅgāni tāsāmādyāyā dīrghasvaraniyojanātsaṃyojyāmṛtasaṃsthānānnyasedanyattu tadgatampūrvaprastutāmṛteśvarī vidyā itthamuktetyarthaḥgalanāsākṣikarṇabhrūśaṅkhamūrddhasu vai kramātśukle pūrṇāntamitare mūrddhādipratilomataḥnityaśo mṛtagasthānasamārambhāvasānakamnyāsenāmṛtarūpī syāt sādhakaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥyāsāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa kleśā naśyantyaśeṣataḥabhṛtairārdradehāstāstvamalābharaṇānvitāḥdadhānāḥ smeravadanā muktābharaṇabhūṣitāḥbhavatītitābhiḥ ṣaṣṭiśatārṇātmaśaktibhiḥ parivāritāḥśaktītidvyakṣaraṃ proktasaptākṣaryyā ca saṃyutamvāhyāt praveśagatyaiva prādakṣiṇyāt sugandhibhiḥpūjayedbahirāsāntu vidadhyādvaliyugmakamhomañca taistarpaṇantu jalaiḥ karpūravāsitaiḥsādhāraṇamkurukullāsaptākṣaryyā ca | taiḥ pāyasādibhiścaturbhiḥevaṃ japādisaṃsiddhavidyo mantrī yadā jalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaikaśaḥ śatādevaṃ tattoyaṃ dundhasannibhamśatārṇānālikhenmadhye tadādyaṃ madhyato likhetdugdhasannibham rasādibhiḥteṣāmanvonyasambhedālekhanāt syuranantakāḥkoṣṭānyutpādya susamānyekaṣaṣṭyā śatatrayamśeṣaṃ vajraṃ bhavet koṣṭhairekāśītiśatena vaiteṣu tāstā likhedvidyāṃ ṣaṭsādhyākhyāsamāyutāmvilikhedamṛtārṇāṃstu kramāt ṣaṣṭiśataṃ priyevāhyādimadhyamāntantu likhedanyāstu pañca vaiyantrāṇi teṣāṃ sarvatra gadādiparirakṣaṇamyasmin deśe tvidaṃ yantraṣakaṃṭke tvevaṃ supūjitamsadā na sambhavantyevaṃ bhavantyeva ca sampadaḥsaikaviṃśacchataṃ koṣṭhānyabhito mārjayet kramātmadhye taddinajāṃ vidyāṃ ālikhyākhyāsamanvitāmprāgvadagratrikoṇāttu vilikhedudayākṣarātkṛtvā proktāni phalānyavāpnuyāditighaṭikākramayogena gandhapuṣpādibhistathāśīghraṃ śamaṃ prayāntyeva kleśāstatra prapūjanātsitairvvā saurabhopetairmaṇḍalācchriyamāpnuyātsamastavāñchitaṃ varṣādavāpnotyeva niścitamnīrogo nirgatādhiśca nivṛttinītisaṃyutaḥmadhye sādhyasamopete vajrayantre divāniśamproktakāleṣu proktakālāvadhipūjanāt proktaphalasiddhiritinityābhaktaiḥ samīcīnaiḥ snigdhaiḥ saṃprāptadakṣiṇaiḥtathā trilohāśmatale kṛtvā vajraṃ suvistṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhye sādhyaṃ samālikhya tat khanedbhavanādiṣuniḥsapatnā nirupamā nītiyuktā nirantarāḥtāsāṃ vidyāṃ śṛṇu prājñe yābhiḥ syāt siddhavigrahaḥproktakramataḥ | tatra pradeśe | nirantarāḥ santanyamānāḥsamīritā viṣoḍhābhiḥ svaravarjamaśeṣataḥlalitāśaktipūjoktavījadvayasamanvitampratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇābhirvidyābhistābhirambikeyanmayaṃ viśvamakhilaṃ dṛśyate sacarācaramasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtampaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 26 || O/ ||yāvat | vidyāyāḥ lalitāvidyāyāḥ yanmayaṃ vidyāmayamṣaḍviṃśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 26 || oṃ tatsat ||mātṛkābhūtanāthādyaiḥ śrīcakreṇa ca śaktibhiḥekaśvāsaṃ samārabhya tatsaṃkhyābhiḥ krameṇa vaiviśeṣāṃścāntarādvāhyāttattatsiddhyupapādakānsa tu pañcavidho bhūtabhedādudbhavadeśataḥprāṇāgnīlāmbukhātmānaḥ pavanāḥ syuryathākramankramāccaturṣu bhūteṣu vyoma sarvvātmakaṃ bhavetvāmadakṣau tayostasya praveśo nirgamastathāpṛthivī salilaṃ candro raviranyattrayaṃ bhavetvāhyābhyantarān viśeṣān vacyītyuktaṃ bhavatītimātṛkāñca tathā vidyā svaravyañjanabhedataḥśarīre'pi ghaṭerūrddhaṃ candrādho ravirīritaḥśuklakṛṣṇau tathā prakṣāviti candrā daśāntarāḥekādaśavidhau candrabhāskarau samyagīritau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rāhuḥ śūnyañca sarvvatra nāśāya bhavati kṣaṇātsaṃgrahaścānyadakhilaṃ candre sidhyatyayatnataḥcandrasūryābhyāṃ | cakāraḥ samāhāresāmānyaṃ phalamupadiśati | tatra bhāskarāḥ śūnyarūpavidhurāḥniścitya bhavatītyuktamanyathā cettadanyathāśūnye garbhavipattiḥ syādityādyūhya vadeddṛḍhamśubāni tatra sarvvāṇi naśyanti parameśvaritatsthāne sthāpayitvā taṃ tatkarṇe kathayenmanumanyathā śūnyarāhostu nāśāya guruśiṣyayoḥśūnyanabhorāhuṣu naśyanti aśubhāni bhavantītyarthaḥtāsāṃ ṣaṣṭyā dinaṃ pūrṇaṃ taddinaṃ syāt punaḥ punaḥṣaṭśatañca tatasteṣāṃ svarūpaṃ śṛṇu sundariprāṇāgnīlāmbukhāni syurnavatyānyatra saṃkramaḥdinamevaṃ brajedādau darśapratipadaṃ pratisundarīti devīsambuddhiḥetatkramaviparyyāsādabhavyāni bhavanti hiubhayatrobhayātmānaḥ śubhāśubhaparīkṣaṇetatra sārddhacatuṣkeṇa bhūtāni syuriti kramāttattadarṇabhavāḥ śvāsāḥ ṣaṣṭyā triśatamīritambhavantītikarmmaṇāmiti śeṣaḥproktasaṃkhyaśvāsātmakāni ca bhūtvā bhūtāni samudyantītisaptāvṛttyā tataḥ śeṣāḥ prāṇāgnīlāmbukhākṣaraiḥyayā vihitayā mantrī sadā darśanavān bhavetpañcabhūtātmakavarṇātmikā bhavatīti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rayo'gninā yuto jyā'mbu marudyuktā rasā marutvyaktaṃ vakṣyamāṇānyatra prastauti || 59ambumarudyuktā vakārākārayuktā jvā iti | rasāmarut lā itip. 56) gotrā careṇa sahitā ambu pūrvākṣaraṃ tathāhaṃsaśca marutā dāhaḥ prāṇaśca marutā yutaḥcareṇāmbu ca gotrā hṛtsāgni jyāmburasā svayukdāhenānena te dviḥ syāt haṃso dāhamarutsvayuksapta dāhāstato'syāḥ syuraṣṭamādyāstu pañca vaitvaritāntyañca bheruṇḍā aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathāvedhākarṣaṇasantāpavaśyāveśakarī bhavetyā siddhidhanadhānyātmanidhilābhāya kalpateambu paścādrayaḥ sāgnirmarutā'mburayau tathādāhaśca marutā haṃsastvagniretattrayaṃ punaḥityarthaḥpañcaphalāni copadiśatiātmalābhaḥ svarūpajñānamtejo'gninā punaḥ pañca vātaḥ svena samāyutaḥśūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā śunyaṃ śaktyā nabhoyutametatpūrvamadhaḥ proktacatuṣṭayamataḥ paramraso'gninā punaḥ proktacatuṣkāt trayamantataḥhaṃso'gninā prāktritayaṃ hṛdayaṃ svasamāyutampaścādyuktatrayaṃ vātādharayā ca nabhaḥ priye !vyāptametattrayaṃ paścāddhṛddāhenāmbusaṃyutamdāhena pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca marutā yutamsparśo marutsvasahito hṛddāhenāmbusaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato dinārṇāḥ sandhyāḥ syustataśca ghaṭikārṇakāḥmātṛkāścāpi pañcāśacchrīcakrasthāśca śaktayaḥevaṃ vidyāṃ vāsanāṃ yo bhāvayet parameśvariyogābhyāsaṃ tadaṅgaiśca svecchotkrāntividhānakamāsannamṛtyucihnāni kathayāmi yathākramamsuṣumnā pṛṣṭhavaṃśākhyavīṇādaṇḍasya madhyagātadagrāt pāyugā proktālambuṣākhyā tu nāḍikāatrānyadrahasyaṃ pūjyapādamukhādavagantavyammṛtaśarīre svajīvapraveśanaṃ tasmāt svaśarīre tatpraveśanaṃ vātadvāmadakṣapārśvābhyāṃ saviśvodaravāraṇehastijihvāyaśasvinyau tattadaṅguṣṭhage padoḥgāndhārī ca tathā pūṣā netradvayagate kramātsarasvatī tu yā nāḍī sā tu jihvāgragāminītāsāṃ sandhiṣu tatsandhiṣvevaṃ nāḍyaḥ sthitāstanauapradhānāḥ śirā dehe tvasaṃkhyā yābhireva vaināḍayaḥ suṣirā raktamarutpūrṇāśca sarvvagāḥcitrābhidhānā tanmadhye sthitā sā kuṇḍalī parājihvākarṇākṣināsāṅghri jaṭharāntāḥ pradakṣiṇāt || itiūrūsauvanikāmuṣkameṭranābhiṣu pārśvayoḥśaṅkhayoḥ phālgunāsādimadhyāntāsyakapolataḥparakāyapraveśca svecchotkrāntiśca sidhyatiūrddhādhogamanāsaktau prāṇāpānau sadā tanaudevadatto jṛmbhaṇakṛt ravakṛcca dhanañjayaḥsamānavāyuḥ kāyāgniṃ sandhukṣayati pācitumeṣāṃ daśānāmaṃśāstu marutāṃ syuranantakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvādaśa sambhūyāṣṭatriṃśanmarmāṇi | eṣu marmasuvailomye vikṛtāṅgatvāllokairnāśāya kalpyateyogo yogastu vijñeyastasyāṅgāni tathāṣṭa vaiprāṇāyāmastathā pratyāhārastadanu dhāraṇamkathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe yairmmarttyo matsamo bhavetlobhamohau mānamadau vahnivat sarvanāśakāḥvikṛtāṅgatvāt ahitādibhiḥaṣṭāṅgasvarūpaiḥ | matsamaḥ manmayaḥ śivarūpaḥudyogebhya uparamaṇaṃ yamaḥ yamākhyamaṅgamtathaikādaśarūpaḥ syānniyamaḥ parikīrttitaḥkṣamā dayā tridhāśaucaṃ santoṣo gurusevanamāsanāni manaḥsthairyyakaraṇe sādhakāni vaibāhyapārśvadvayasparśāttat padmāsanamīritamsvastikākārataḥ proktaṃ tadbhadrāsanamīśvarimanovākkāyarūpataḥ | santoṣaḥ pūrṇatāūrvoradhastathorddhe ca dvidhā bhadrāsanaṃ smṛtampādayorjānudeśe vai vīrākhyaṃ yogapaṭṭataḥlāghavo bhūtalatyāga uttame cittanirvṛtiḥsarvvāṅgakampanaṃ proktamabhyāsāt kālasaṃyutāttasmāt samabhyaset prātaḥ sāyañca niyamena vaismarannambu marut paścāddakiṇenāpasārayetsampradāyaḥdvividhaṃ vīrāsanaṃ bhavatītidhārayettaccatuḥṣaṣṭyā recayettatturīyataḥtadvat kāntiprakāśau ca yogasiddhasya lakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāḍīcakrāntaraṃ nītvā sarvvāṅgāni ca cārayetdhārayan vārayedicchāvaśenāṅgāni sarvataḥrasāmbudāhavyāptasvaiḥ sahaṃsairvyāpayettanumturīyataḥ ṣoḍaśamātrābhiḥdehaviṣaye | prakāśa iti svatejaso bahiḥ prakāśanaṃ bījādivatmūlataḥ mūlādhārātvāyumiti śeṣaḥ | icchāvaśena syābhimatāṅgadhāraṇavaśenatrikālajño viśuddhātmā sukhī jīvecciraṃ bhuvisvecchayā dehamadhyasthaḥ kuḍmagṛhagato yathāprāṇānākṛṣya madhyasthasuṣumnārandhratastathāathavottarasaṃproktacūrṇāsvādanato vaśīsvecchotkrāntiriti proktā yogayuktātmanāṃ priyesvadehe tattadbhūtamayīkṛte proktaphalasiddhiritiśarīravyāsaṅgarahitaḥvānavacchinnasvarūpo bhavatītikalau duḥśāṭakaṃ prāyo marttye siddhirapīśvariparipūrṇāṅgasaṃyuktāmagrato vīkṣya yogataḥsvāṃ tanuṃ gopayet sviyaistatastāñca tathā brajetśṛṇu tāni mahādevi yairanyairjāyate guṇaiḥjitendriyatvamakrodhaḥ kṛpayā janagopitāyaiḥ sādhyasādhakau jñātvā dehatyāgamatandritausugatiṃ prāpya siddhyai tu bhavato jātamātrataḥsamāśrayettatastvabdānmṛtistasya suniścitamdṛśau nāsāntikākrāntyā candrake yoṅgayorna cetgulphādhaḥ sphuraṇaṃ nāḍyoḥ pādayoścenna jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niruddhakarṇarandhrasya na cet kuṇḍalinīdhvaniḥmūrddhnigā vihagā līnāḥ parāsuṃ taṃ na ko vadetsadyaḥ parāsumātmānaṃ jānīyāt sarvathā naraḥāgulphorantarāṣṭabhyā paśyannāto vinaśyatitasmin pakṣe prayātyeva yamaṃ santyajya jīvitambhāskaraṃ bhagaṇaiḥ paśyannapi yāti yamālayamprayāti nidhanaṃ chidraṃ paśyan bhānośca maṇḍalesa pakṣādyāti nidhanaṃ sarvairapi surakṣitaḥāstikān satataṃ nindannakāraṇata eva cagurumantraparityāge'pyacirājjāyate mṛtiḥsadādhikṣepaśāpābhyāṃ nyakkurvannāśu naśyatiniṣkāraṇe nirākurvannāśu naśyati mānavaḥdhyāte svadevavairūpye māsato nidhanaṃ bhavetasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtampaṭalamsvadevavairūpyaṃ varṇavigrahaprasādādibhiriti śeṣaḥpaṭalam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 27 || oṃ tatsat ||yanmayaṃ viśvamakhilaṃ vartate sacarācaramvācyavācakayogena mātṛkālokayorapiyadāyattamidaṃ viśvaṃ nityāstatkālavigrahāḥvṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ candrasya ādyayā kalayā tathālokatādātmyaṃ | yanmayaṃ nityātmakalokamayaṃ | varttate pratīyatemātṛkālokayorvyāptirapi ṣaḍviṃśe paṭale mayā tavoktetyaryaḥsakalaviśvakāraṇabhūtaḥ kāla eva nityānāṃ vigraha ityarthaḥtayoranyonyanityātvavyāptiṃ tadvat sthitiṃ tayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: grahāṇāṃ mātṛkārūpaṃ śṛṇu proktaṃ krameṇa vaitasyābhito mahaupārśve pañcāśacchatayojanāḥdarśāntañca pratitithyekaikakrameṇodayaviśrāntipratītirbhavatītimātṛkātmatvamsindhubhiḥ saptabhirdvīpaistatsaṃkhyairdviguṇottaraiḥmadhye vistāramānāttu bahirāvṛtya tat punaḥnūnaṃ paribhramatyeva paścimādhopasavyataḥāvṛtetyasya mahīti pūrvatrānvayaḥtejomayairdvādaśārairyuktaṃ meṣādivigrahaiḥrāśiyuktena kālena proktenoparyyadhastathāpaścimābhimukhamūrddhādhaḥ prādakṣiṇyakramāt paribhramatītilokānāmutpattyādirūpāṃ sthitiṃ kurvantītimadhyasthamerau lalitā sadaivāste mahādyutiḥtadbahiḥ parame vyomni tvetā citrā tu saṃsthitādvitīyādiṣu varṣeṣu kramāttāḥ parivṛttibhiḥcitrā ca bhavatītthaṃ hi bhajante parivarttanamvarṣaṣoḍaśakavarṣaṣoḍaśakenaikāmekāṃ parivṛttiṃ bhajantītikāleṣvapi ca madhyādi paravyomāntamīśvarianyāḥ sarvvāstatra tatra caranti svayameva vaikālato deśataścakrādaikyaṃ saṃjāyate yadāprajāśca sukhino bhūyurarogāḥ kālamṛtyavaḥtadbahiḥ paramavyoma sthitistatra tadantikāevaṃ deśe ca kāle ca tanmayaṃ samudīritampūjayet saviśeṣaṃ tāṃ prajapeccākhilāptayemahāśaktiśca jāyeta trayāṇāmaikyavaibhavāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deśaprāptāntu tanmāsapūrṇāyāṃ pūjayecchivekadācidapi dīrghāyurarogo jñānavān sukhīnityātmakau bhavata ityuktamitideśādīnāmmānyate sarvamantrāśca siddhāḥ syustatra pūjanātśākaśca puṣkaraśceti saptadvīpeṣu bhūruhāḥtattannāmabhirabhyarcya taddvīpaṃ tatra pūjayetevaṃ pūjayiturloke na samosti na cādhikaḥmahāvyoma ca niḥsaumaṃ tatraitaddvayasaṃsthitiḥpratipakṣatattatprāptatithīśca pūjayan proktaphalasiddhibhāgitiproktarūpaprabhāvo bhaveditigrahāṇāṃ tatra saṃvāsapracāraniyatātmanāmna tvanyadavalambāya tayoḥ kutrāpi vidyateprāguktarūpāṃ tattīre kolavaktrāntu pañcamīṃtanmadhye navaratnāni mahādvīpañca tatra vaitanmadhye'saṃkhyarūpābhirvṛtāṃ saṅgītaśaktibhiḥvinodyamānāṃ vilasanmadamantharavīkṣaṇāmśucismitāṃ śaktivṛndagītākarṣaṇananditāmśaktericchetidayāmadāruṇāpāṅgavilokitasusādhakāmvirājamānāndiradānaśvānapi tathāvidhānsvasamānābhirabhito nityābhiḥ sevitāntathātadvinodastatsamīpanivāsī syāt suniścitamnavaratnamayaṃ dvīpaṃ tanmānābdhibhirāvṛtamratnadvīpasya madhysthatṛtīyāṃśe tu maṇḍape
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathā samanvitāṃ dhyāyannaro bhavati matsamaḥsaparivāranityānāṃ tadvinodaḥ saṅgītādiviśeṣavinodaḥnaro nirastasaṃsāramūlājñāno jitendriyaḥapāpaḥ puṇyaśīlaśca satyārjavasamanvitaḥjāyate tasya parito yojanaṃ pāvanaṃ bhavetpāpakarmmakṣayāttena rahitāḥ syuśca tatsamāḥvyomarūpamanādyantaṃ yattaccinmayamāvayoḥsa jīvanmukta eveti proktaṃ tallakṣaṇañca tebhūtapretapiśācādipīḍāśāntyai sukhāptayeproktaṃ pañcatriṃśat paṭale vakṣyata ityarthaḥcorasiṃhadvīpigajagavayādibhayānakesalilādimanaḥ pīḍāsvabdhau potādisaṅkaṭesukhī jīvati nirdvandvo niḥsapatno jitendriyaḥyenāhamapi yuddheṣu devāsurajayī sadākāmeśī purataḥ pātu bhagamālā tvanantaramnityaklinnā ca bheruṇḍā diśaṃ pātu sadā mamamahāvajreśvarī rakṣedanantaradiśaṃ sadāpālayettu diśaṃ cānyāṃ rakṣenmāṃ kulasundarīnityā nīlapatākākhyā vijayā sarvvataśca māmdehendriyamanaḥprāṇān jvālāmālinivigrahākāmāt krodhāttathā lobhānmohānmānānmadādapistaimityācca samudyogādaśubheṣu tu karmmasurakṣantu māṃ sarvvadā tāḥ kurvantvicchāṃ śubheṣu catathā hayasamārūḍhāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadārathārūḍhāśca māṃ pāntu sarvataḥ sarvadā raṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūgatāḥ sarvadā pāntu māñca sarvatra sarvadādrāvayantu svaśaktīnāṃ bhīṣaṇairāyudhairmmamaasaṃkhyāḥ śaktayo devyāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadākadācinnāśubhaṃ paśyenna śṛṇoti ca matsamaḥtena teṣāntu pūjārthaṃ vakṣye taddhāmamaṇḍalamsudhāvyañjanarūpaṃ syāditare tanmayā yataḥśivabhūtaḥteṣāṃ navānāṃ pūjāsu tanmayaṃ navamaṇḍalamkrameṇa śṛṇu deveśi sarvaśreyaskarātmakamtrihastamātre janayennava koṣṭhāni teṣu vaitanmadhye tiryyagūrddhañca sūtradvayanipātanātvātādyaṣṭasvarānmadhye praṇavaṃ nabhasā yutamsvatantrapūjāsu tayoścandrārkayoḥtatrārkamarccayettasya nāmabhirdvādaśoditaiḥsomasyādyaṃ svasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā tena tathārccayetṣoḍaśasvarayuktañca mātṛkāñca svayogataḥdāhavahnisvasahitamarccayettatra maṇḍalenivedya śarkarādugdhapāyasaiścopacārakaiḥtattadvargādivarṇañca svaraistāṃ mātṛkāmapitattadvargākṣarāṇyākhyātryakṣarairālikhedapievaṃ kṛteṣu navasu pūjayecca navagrahāntryakṣarāṇi caturthyantānyarcayettaiśca tānitiketumetaistu sarvatra mantrānuktau ca pūjanamteṣveva teṣāmarccātaste kuryyustadanugrahamsvoccayoḥ sthitapūjāñca maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu pārvati
