sanskrit: rekhābhiraṣṭabhirmmadhye tvekāśītipade likhetmāyāntāśītisaṃkhyātānmadhye dāvagatañca tatpañcabhiśca likhettatra bimbe somaṃ samarcayetraktacandanasindūragairikairekato raveḥdvivṛttāntastiryyagūrddhvāḥ kṛtvā rekhāḥ samāntaramprāṇādikānnabho'ntāṃstu svairupetān svarairyutānsvarairbhāntayutairvahnidaśārṇairgrathitāṃ lipimtanmadhye bhānumāvāhya pūjayet prāgvadīśvarisusamenāvṛte kṛtvā bimbānyuktāni pūjayetviśeṣādeśarahite tatra tatkramatorcayetproktopacārādyairarkañcārccayet | tena proktaphalasiddhibhāgitisarvvātmanā sarvadā ca saivārcyā sarvavigrahāaṣṭāviṃśaṃ paṭalamśeṣaḥ | saiva lalitaiva arccanīyā sarvavigrahā sarvadevatāvigrahā itiparāmṛṣṭam || 28 || oṃ tatsat ||prācyādidigvibhāgañca maṇḍapādestu lakṣaṇammānāni teṣāmagnestu dhyānaṃ jihvāstadarccanamupakramopasaṃhārau phalāni ca yathākramamyadi kuryyād yathādṛṣṭaṃ vipanno nirayaṃ brajettadgatyā dikparijñānaṃ śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhitanmadhyaṃ bindumadhyantu śaṅkuṃ saṃsthāpya tasya vaipūrvāparāhṇayoḥ kṛtvā cihetamabhitastathātayoḥ saṃśleṣasañjātamadhyadakṣottarasthitesūtraṃ dakṣottaraṃ teṣāṃ agraiḥ prāgādi kalpayetvidadhyānnavahastena vistārāyāmasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udumbaravaṭāśvatthaplakṣaiśchadanamālayāvidadhyānmadhyato vedīṃ karamātrasamunnatāmprāgādidikṣu koṇeṣu vahnyādiṣu ca kalpayetpratyagdakṣiṇottarātmakadikcatuṣṭayaṃ kalpayeditinirmmāṇaṃ sakalaṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi tavānaghevidadhyādvṛttakuṇḍāni cararāśicatuṣṭayevidadhyāccaturasrāṇi tataḥ kuṇḍānyanukramātubhayātmasu kurvīta yonikuṇḍāni maṅgalesthireṣvapi trikoṇāni pareṣu tu catuṣṭayeevaṃ navānāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ śṛṇu mānādilakṣaṇamtṛtīyāṃśo bhavedatra tantre sarvatra cāṅguliḥaratnistaddvayena syāddhastastaddvayataḥ śiveṣaṇavatyaṅgulā sā syāttanmānaiḥ kuṇḍakalpanamāṃ navavidhānāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ mānādilakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇvitikṛtvā tatpūrvataḥ paścāddvādaśāṅgulamānataḥprākpratyakcihnamānena tayorevāvalambataḥprasāryya sūtraṃ taccāpi mārjayitvoktamānataḥkuryāddhaṃsapadaṃ koṣṭhānyabhitasteṣu pātayettatsaṃkhyāṅgulamitapuruṣadehonnati samānāni kuṇḍānītitasminnanyāni kuṇḍāni vadāmi tava mānataḥmānanirmmāṇayorvakṣye vidhānaṃ susphuṭaṃ śivecaturasrābhitaḥ sā tu tyājyā bhūranyatastathātatsamānyeva jāyante ṣaṇavatyaṅgulātmanāteṣāṃ śaśāṅkamānena tanmadhyādbhrāmayettathābhavantīti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayena svena yutaṃ rasaśca svena saṃyutaḥvārdāhayuktamambusyādviyadvyāptasvasaṃyutamsthirā rasā vanasvena dāvau haṃso dharāsvayukhaṃsaśca marutā vidyā daśottaraśatākṣarīvārtālī cetivikhyātā stambhanādyakhileṣṭadāvyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥsvayuktā tatastrayamdāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥparamdāvau ṭhakāradvayaṃ ṭhaṭha iti | haṃso dharāsvayuk hu/ itihaṃsaśca marutā yukta iti śeṣaḥ hā itivārāhītyādinā ślokena devyā nāmapañcakaṃ kathayatip. 61) ambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priye !asya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥtṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramāthṛnmāyayā bhuvā hṛtsyāt svena haṃsaḥ samanvitaḥsarvābhīṣṭārthasaṃsiddhyai sulabho'yaṃ suradrumaḥsaptapañcaviṃśārṇo mantraḥ tṛtīya ityarthaḥsamanvitaḥ haṃ iti | kuru kullāntyavarṇau ca svāhā ityarthaḥp. 62) prāṇāgnīlā'mbuśākhābhiḥ śaktisaptākṣarīyutaiḥyeṣāmālokato viśvaṃ vartate sacarācaramambunāgnirvāḥ sa śūnyaṃ prāṇo jalarayānvitaḥprabhāvādityarthaḥ | vartate adyāpi kriyate ityarthaḥrasaḥ kṣmayā rayo yuktaścareṇa parameśvari !pūrvāntyavarṇāvityuktaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇo balermanuḥasyā niḥkālanāt citte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam| prāṇo jalarayānvitaḥ kakāro ṛkāratakārābhyāṃ sahitaḥ kṛt iti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yena dvayaṃ carāṇāṃ syādrāśīnāṃ kramataḥ śivepratyekaṃ paścimaṃ sūtraṃ tanmānenātha sūtrayoḥkuṇḍaṃ trikoṇamuditaṃ caturṣu sthirarāśiṣukramataḥ maṅgalāmaṅgalayoḥ | śive iti sambuddhiḥkuṇḍaṃ kalpayet | etadamaṅgalaprayoge sthirarāśiṣu caturṣūditamitipūrvataḥ paścimadvandvaṃ koṣṭhayormmadhyadeśataḥuttarāgrāvadhi tathā dakṣiṇāgrāvadhi priyevikāśitabrahmasūtrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavetrāśiṣu proktakalyāṇakarmmasūktārthasiddhikṛtmānena parito bhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥkuṇḍamuktaphalasiddhikaramitipātayet pañcasūtrāṇi tat syāt pañcāsrakuṇḍakamtena mānena ca tathā kṛtvā vṛttamatisphuṭamtatra ṣaṭsūtrapātena bhavet kuṇḍaṃ ṣadasrakamtena mānena sambhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥvṛtte vidhāya cihnāni saptasūtrāṇi pātayetmaṅgalakarmmaṇi mithunarāśisthānavahnidik proktaṃ bhaveditikarmaṇi kanyārāśisthānaniṝtidik proktaṃ ṣaḍasrakuṇḍaṃ bhaveditisamastavairināśāya proktaṃ kuṇḍamidaṃ śivevidhāya caturasrantu pūrvakoṇārddhamānataḥteṣu cihneṣu kṛtvāṣṭa sūtrāṇi paritaḥ śivepravakṣyāmi śṛṇu prājñe samuddiṣṭaṃ krameṇa vaisvavāñchitena mānena tadasrāṇi bhavanti hikuṇḍeṣu ca tathā koṭihomādiṣu samīritamkārayet koṭihomantu puruṣairaṣṭabhistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāñca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pūjāpraṇatipūrvakammekhalādikamityatrādiśabdo yonyādiviṣayaḥ | prājñe iti sambuddhiḥkoṭyādimahāsaṃkhyahomaproktakuṇḍeṣu ca vidhānaṃ samīritamitimahiṣīṃ saprajāmaśvadāsadāsīvibhūṣaṇāmtato gurośca tānyeva taiḥ samānamudīritamtathā digvijaye'nyasya parakṛtyādisambhavesurūpaiśca suśīlaiśca nityābhaktaistathāstikaiḥkoṭihomasya kuṇḍasya khātamūrddhantu tasya vaiṣoḍaśanityābhaktaiḥ | āstikaiḥ nityanaimittikādikramabhajanaparaiḥkoṭihomaproktanavahastamānakuṇḍasyavistārotsedhayoḥ kuryyādyonihotrāsanāgrataḥtisṛṇāmapi vistārāḥ pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulāḥyoninirmmāṇamadhunā vāsanāñca śṛṇu priyevitastimātrakāṃ koṣṭhāmaśvatthadalasannibhāmvakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇāṃ yoniṃ kuryyāditinirmāṇaṃ tasyā vāsanāṃ yoninirmāṇasya | priye iti devīsambuddhiḥekāṅgulotsedhayutāṃ mekhalopari sarvataḥyoniḥ kāraṇabhūtasya tattvasya syāt padaṃ mahatphalāni pūrṇānyacirādayatnādvitaratyasautanmekhalopari yonikḷptiṃ vinaiva tatphalasiddhikṛditi sampradāyaḥnābhiṃ kuryyāttu sarvvatra kuṇḍamadhye vidhānataḥcaturbhiraṅgulaiḥ kuryyāt karṇikāṃ dalameva caprāgvanmahati kuṇḍe ca kuryyādūhena tattathāsaumyaṃ nityāsamākāraṃ dhyānamanyacchṛṇu priyetattannityāproktasthūlarūpadhyānaṃ | priye iti devīsambuddhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tridhārūpamatikrūrairaruṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirīkṣaṇaiḥitaraistomaraṃ tālavṛntaṃ sarpiḥsubhājanamkrūreṣu sarvvahomeṣu dhyānavaibhavamīritamjuhuyāccettadā kṣipraṃ tadaghaistaṃ vināśayetjuhuyācca samāpnoti vāñchitaṃ sakalaṃ kṣaṇātdakṣavaktragatā sarvvasiddhidā tu samarccanātvyāttavaktraṃ vistṛtavaktrampratyavāyamupadiśati tatra vā samuccaye | taṃ sādhakamjihvāsaptake ityarthaḥ | kṣaṇāt proktamaṇḍalādikālālaṅghanenarūpādibhiriti yāvat | sarvasiddhidā vāñchitaphaladāyinībahurūpāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ homaḥ sarvvārthasādhakaḥyasyāṃ juhoti tāmādyāṃ samabhyarcyātha saptaśaḥsāmānyato nityahome dravyāṇi śṛṇu sundaritaddvayaṃ ceti saṃproktānyuktānyetāni nityakeabhicāreṣu vānyeṣu krūreṣvanyeṣvapi priyetanmāṃsaistatra tatroktairdravyaiḥ krūreṣu karmasukuryyāditi sampradāyaḥdevīsambuddhiḥpriye iti sambuddhiḥannājyādi samastantu niṣkamātraṃ hunet kramātprasannacittavadanaḥ kuryyāddhomantu sādhakaḥnyastagātro'rghatoyena prokṣayet kuṇḍamadhyakamdarbheṇa vilikhet kuṇḍamadhye rekhācatuṣṭayamtattatpaṭaleprasthamātreṇa ṣaṇavatyāhutīḥ kuryyāditi yāvat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāgādiṣu tu saptāpi madhye vahniṃ tathā smaranjihvānāmabhirekaikaṃ vahneśca dvyakṣarādikamvahniṃ sabhājanaṃ haste gṛhītvāṅgārakañca tatviparibhrāmya kuṇḍantu tanmadhye vinyasettataḥkṛtvā darbhaiḥ paristīryya palāśāśvatthapatrakaiḥjuhuyādekamekantu nāthanityātmabhūtajaiḥsvājñāsthānagatāṃ buddhvā paristaraṇapūrvakampūjāṃ samāpya vicaret sukhī tadrūpavānnaraḥkuryyāditi | krūrakarmasu abhicārādiṣuteṣu taddhomakaraṇaṃ samāpte nityaśastathānityakramaṃ tato nityaṃ tattaddivasavidyayāmaṅgale pūrvamudite pāhi māmityudīrayethomaṃ taṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaparatvataḥitarasya vidhāne tu yāni jñeyāni tāni tuvināśayedarātīṃśca homeḥ pāpāni cātmanaḥtasmāddhomena sakalaṃ sādhayet sarvavāñchitamasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtampaṭalam || 29 || oṃ ||nānavāpyamityetadabhimataviṣayaḥparāmṛṣṭam || 29 || oṃ tatsat ||tāsāṃ cakraṃ tatra pūjākramaṃ samyagvadāmi tesūkṣmahomavidhānāni tatphalāni paraṃ tathāyairvinā bhuvane mantrāḥ sarve syurniṣphalā dhruvampurā tasya vadhāyaiva sarve devāḥ smudyamamāvayostannirāsāya māmetyākathayattadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niścitamdarpaśāntiṃ nacettena viśvamāsīdupadrutamkhātvā tamavanau tasya śarīre sthāpayettathāniyojya teṣāṃ ye pūjāvimukhāstaiḥ kṛtāni tutasmātteṣāmarccanantu pratyahaṃ kurvatāṃ sadātaccakrādividhānantu śṛṇu samyagvadāmi tetairekāśītikoṣṭhāni jātāni syuḥ samāni caḥ | te tavaekīkuryyāttrikoṣṭhāni dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramātdvidhā kuryyāt koṇakoṣṭhānyaṣṭau tatpārśvayoḥ punaḥekamekaṃ bhavecchiṣṭaṃ bahirdvātriṃśadīritamhemābhañca caturvaktraṃ vedādhyayanaśīlinamtripañcāśaddevatāsthānāni bhavantītiāryyakañca vivasvantaṃ mitramanyaṃ mahīdharamvahnyādīśāntamabhitaḥ pūjayet pūrvavat priyeāyāpavatsakau ceti proktāste'ṣṭau tu nāmataḥaṣṭau krameṇa tārādyairnamontairnāmabhistathāsarvvaṃ guhañcāryyamaṇaṃ bhañjakaṃ pilipicchakambahirīśādi parito yajedaṣṭau diśaṃ pratisatyo vṛṣontarikṣaśca pūrvāśākoṣṭhagāḥ kramātgandharvvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgo dakṣiṇakoṣṭhagaḥvaruṇaḥ puṣpadantaścāsurākhyaśoṣarogakāḥvāyurnāgastathā mukhyaḥ somo bhallātakastathākoṣṭheśūttarasaṃstheṣu devatāstāḥ samīritāḥkṛtvā caturddhā teṣveva prāgādiṣu yathākramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇavādibhirnamo'ntaiḥ pūjayeditiprāgādiṣu tathā dakṣe nityārṇāṇudayārṇakamuttare pūjayāmīti vilikhyātra yajecca tānbrīhimudgayavaiḥ kṣaudraghṛtadugdhāplutaiḥ kramātpratyekaṃ tairhuneddravyairmmantraistadvacca pāyasaiḥsasitairdugdhakadalīphalāpūpādisaṃyutam| tān proktān brahmādīnājyāhutīrjuhuyāditisvagehe vāstupūjāyāṃ maṇḍale sarvataḥ kramāttrayādahīnān vividhairmmadhurādyaistu bhojayetevaṃ vidadhato gehe nākalyāṇaṃ kadācanana sarpapīḍā nānyonyakalahānyaśubhāni caarogī vijayī khyātaściraṃ jīvati tadgṛheśrīvidyājāpī gṛhametya nyastagātro devatātmā bhaveditisacivāmātyasenānībhavaneṣu pure tathāna ceduktānyathārūpaphalaiḥ kleśo'niśaṃ bhavettattaddaivatanāmāni māyāgarbhe samālikhetsthāpayedveśmasu kkāpi nityaśaścāpi tatra vaitadveśmamaṅgalaṃ grāmapurakharvaṭakādiṣupratiṣṭhādikamiti śeṣaḥp. 586) tataḥ sūkṣmaiḥ parākhyaiśca homaiḥ siddhiṃ śṛṇu priyevācyavācakarūpañca prapañcaṃ juhuyāttathātadvidhānaṃ vada prājña śambho samyaṅmamādhunātadrūpaṃ tatkriyāṃ sarvaṃ vada me viśadaṃ prabhoprāṇāgnihotravidyeti yattrayyāṃ śrūyate param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jāyate itiprabho iti devasambuddhiḥyadvyayāyāsarahitamananyā pekṣanirvahamsukhāspadaṃ svagaṃ viśvamayaṃ cidvedyavedanātpradarśyate tatastatra varṇayāmi ca kiñcanasarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tadvaddhṛdaye ca prabhākaraḥtattayātmakameva syādādyā nityā trikhaṇḍakamgamāgamābhyāṃ tejobhisteṣāmanyonyajaiḥ śivecittavikalpavidhuraṃ bhāvayedadbhutāñca yatdvābhyāmanyatamaṃ kṛtvā puṭitaṃ juhuyācca taiḥkuṇḍalīmukhamārgāgnau juhuyānniścalāśayaḥvakṣyamāṇakrameṇa juhuyāditicandrabhānupuṭāntaḥsthairvvahnyarṇairjuhuyāttathācandravahnipuṭāntaḥsthairbhānvarṇairjuhuyādapitathā teṣāṃ prātilomyāt ṣoḍaśānāṃ hunedapikṛtvā tadvācyamakhilamartharūpañca taiḥ samamanyāni cāvayoricchāgṛhītāni vapūṃṣi vaimuktiśca tanmayībhāvasthairyyameva samīritammūlādhārasthanirvikalparūpamātmamahāvahnau homaḥ syāditiproktatejastrayatādātmyabhāvasthairyyamtāṃ vadāmi śṛṇu prājñe rahasyaṃ paramādbhutamjīvaśaktiḥ kuṇḍalākhyā prāṇākāreṇa tena sāmāyāśīrṣā nadantī tāmuccarantyaniśaṃ svagepidhāya na śṛṇotyasyā dhvaniṃ tasya tadā mṛtiḥvihāya ṛjutāṃ yāti svecchādaṇḍāhatā satī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niśāndhakāre bhuvanasthitivat svātmanaḥ sthitiḥjñānātmakatvāttādātmyātmakatvāccasa vetti brahma paramaṃ māṃ tvāmapi ca sādhakaḥaspṛṣṭapuṇyapāpaśca śokaharṣātibhūmigaḥnirupādhikasantuṣṭaḥ svecchādhīnecchayā yutaḥsamārimitrakalyāṇaguṇaśīladayānvitaḥitaraḥ pūjane devyā bhajane ca sakautukaḥjanmabhirvvahubhiḥ kliṣṭo mūrkho vidyādhanodbhavaiḥśivaṃ śaktiñca tvāmjīvanneva muktaḥ paramārthataḥ svātmanīnyādyabhāvādityarthaḥnityāsu bhaktirbhuvane prakṣīṇe pāpakarmmaṇinaro bhavanti tāṃ bhaktiṃ prāpya lokeṣu devatāḥanye ca lokapālādyāstadbhaktiprāptasampadaḥna santi devatā vidyāstasmāttā eva sarvvadāparavaśo bhavatītyarthaḥsampradāyārthaḥp. 594) tadvarṇavyāptacakrasthā grahāśca tavadarśitāḥanyāśca devatā yā yāstāstāstanmayavigrahāḥyatsiddhiḥ siddharūpāṇāṃ prāguktānāṃ bhavet sadāprakṣīṇāśeṣapāpānāṃ bhaktiḥ syāttajjñasevināmnityātmakamātṛkāvarṇavyāptacakrasthāḥcakrāntarasthaṣoḍaśanityāmayavigrahāḥpararūpahomasyeti śeṣaḥ | tathā siddhavat| tajjñasevināṃ viditaparamārthanāthasevāditatparāṇāmāmuṣmikāsaṃśayatvaṃ santoṣo nityapūrṇatā

sanskrit: akārpaṇyamadīnatvaṃ paracintānirudyamaḥlābhahānyoḥ prītiroṣābhāvaḥ kalyāṇaśīlatāakalyāṇakathālāpavaimukhyaṃ svecchayā sthitiḥsarvvānukūlyaṃ saṅgītapriyatvaṃ vāñchitāptayaḥsarvvottaratvavāñchā ca lakṣaṇānīritāni tenidhānaṃ parahomantu sthūlasūkṣmañca yanmayamtanmayatvādaikyarūpaṃ sthūlahomamudīritamsarvottaratvavāñchā devatātādātmyasiddhivāñchāvācyārthānāmaśeṣeṇa vedyavettṛvidātmanāsvātmarūpamahāvahnijvālārūpiṣu sarvvadānirvyutthānavilāpastu parahomaḥ samīritaḥhomakarmma samastaṃ tu śubhātmakamudīritamanyeṣvanyāni kāryyāṇi proktāni proktarūpataḥdakṣiṇāsyobhicārantu gade vahnimukho dviṣāmproktavidhānenavidadhyāt paścimāsyastu krūrāṇyanyāni kṛtsnaśaḥvidadhyādupaviśyoktamanyathānarthamāvahetgomayaiḥ parimṛṣṭe tu susame bhūtale śubhemadhye vidadhyāddhomantu proktamevamaśeṣataḥasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtamiti ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate triṃśattamaṃ paṭalamtāṃ diśaṃ prācī parikalpya kuṇḍaṃ nirmāya juhuyāditiproktadiśi | anyathā viparītakaraṇekṛtakoṣṭhanavake | madhye sarvamadhyakoṣṭhamadhyetriṃśat paṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 29 || oṃ tatsat ||

sanskrit: idānīṃ sthūlahomantu kathayāmyarimarddanamvidhānairdveśanidhanaroganigrahacāṭanamtadātmikagrahāṇāñca sthitimaṣṭakavargakamanyathā krūrakarmmāṇi kurvvāṇaṃ nāśayanti hikuryyāttaddevatābhaktimāstikyaṃ varttanaṃ gurumcāṭanam uccāṭanamvidadhyādanyathā śaktyā neṣphalyaṃ vātmanāśanamsthāne kuryyādaniṣṭāni tadvināśāya sādhakaḥkulīrasiṃhamatha tanniṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitātatprayokturnāśanaṃ vā bhavatītisthāneṣu dvādaśasu | tadvināśāya ripuvināśāyanakrakumbhāvṛttarato mīna īśe tu saṃsthitamkāle tu pañca pañca syurghaṭikāḥ kramayogataḥmeṣādirāśigo yāti tathānyairgrahamaṇḍalaiḥmūrddhādicaraṇāntantu tān dvādaśasu lakṣayetīśe koṇe | susthitaṃ kālacakrastharāśicakravanna bhramatītyarthaḥsūryyādhiṣṭhitarāśyādikramayogataḥtattadgrahaparivṛttiproktakālaviśeṣairityarthaḥtān rāśīn | dvādaśasu sthāneṣuśubhāśubhāni sarvvāṇi phalantyevaṃ kṛte dhruvamjñātvā vidadhyāt puttalyāḥ prayāgaṃ sarvatastathābhrūśaṅkhamūrddhamadhyeṣu tatra bhrūśaṅkhamadhyataḥsavyakaṇṭhastanataṭe hṛdi nābhau ca guhyakeaṅghrau sandhau jānuguhye nābhau ceti sitatarekṛte

sanskrit: ṣoḍaśanityānāṃ balimantra ukta ityarthaḥkathayāmi krameṇaiva nityaṃ sarvārthasiddhidamyenātipāpayukto'pi siddhimeti suniścitamāvāhanamanuṃ paścāt samastārcāmanuṃ tathādhyānaṃ saparivārāyā nityapūjāvidhikramaumantrātmayogamarcāyā upacārān japakramamhṛdvanena samāyena tṛtīyaṃ prathamā tvasausampradāyaḥ | samastārcāmanuṃ bījadvayarūpamhṛcchiraśca śikhāvarma netramastraṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamtṛtīyā saiva śaktyādyā devyātmāsanametayāhaṃsahṛdbhyāṃ pañcamī ca sarvamantrāsanaṃ tathādvitīyayā vidyayeti śeṣaḥtṛtīyeti parigaṇanakramaśca saukaryārthaḥtasya śakteśca madhyasthā yā sā ṣaṣṭhī samīritāsaptamyā'vāhanaṃ kuryānnamasoktatrikhaṇḍayāvakṣyamāṇatvāt sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāmupalabdhisthānamityarthaḥmadhyame dāhayogastu vyañjanānte samīritaḥtadādikāḥ sarvaśaktīścakrasthā nāmabhirjapetprāṇorasāśaktiyutaḥ kāmeśvaryakṣaraṃ mahatvyāptaṃ rasākṣmāsvayutaṃ vimalābījamīritampūjānāmamantraiḥ sarvāḥ śaktīḥ pūjayeditilakāra hṛllekhābhiḥ kūṭaṃ klhrī/ itip. 68) haṃsaḥ sahṛdrasāmbuḥ syādvyāptakṣmāsvairyuto manuḥvādeṣu vyavahāreṣu samareṣu ca niścitamsarveśvaryāḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ sadā

sanskrit: karmmasu | tathā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇaviṣanāḍyāṃ viṣasthāne vedhayet kaṇṭakena tuvadarādisamutthairvvā tathāyaḥsārasūcibhiḥvyādhinā pīḍitaṃ kālādavidheyaṃ bhaveddhruvamputtalīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nigrahasiddhayedakṣiṇavāmapārśvavinimayakrameṇa ca viṣasya parivṛttirbhavatītiputtalīnirmāṇavidhānaṃmaṅgalo gurumandārkiguravoṃśakarāśipāḥetāvatyaśca puttalyastvaśakakramayogataḥṣoḍaśa dvādaśa tathā mānamaṅgulisaṃkhyayādvitīye navakenyeṣāmadhyarddhāḥ syustrayodaśacandrārkayorekavidhaḥ proktasaṃkhyākramastathātatra etāvatyaḥ aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyāḥcitāmṛdbhasmalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhīpippalikāyutamgairikañceti kathitaṃ puttalīdravyamīśvarivairidehajaromādyairupetaiḥ puttalīkriyāśīrṣaṃ trayāt kaṭerūrddhvaṃ trayāt pādadvayaṃ tathāvidhāya tantre sarvvatra prayogānācarennaraḥupetairityetaddāruvyatirikteṣu cakrihastamṛtsahiteṣu triṣvanvetiprayogān proktānnāśayoge ca dinajamṛtyau krakacayogakeraktasthūṇe kaṇtakākhye sthūṇe pañcārkasaṃjñakenigrahāya nirīkṣyaivaṃ kuryyāt siddhimavāpnuyātvidadhyāt puttalīḥ samyak catasraḥ proktayogataḥsādhyanakṣatravṛkṣeṇāpyuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ

sanskrit: piṣṭamṛttarujāḥ khātvā syāpayet sikthamambareevaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryyāt karmma samīritamevamuktaprakāreṇavairiyonyasṛjā kṛtvā tayā tu juhuyāttathāśmaśāne nirjane deśe vidadhyādabhicārakamtatrābhito nṛpau rakṣau kārayedātmasiddhayesvarāṣṭrasandhau kurvvīta na kurvvīta svamaṇḍaletadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍayantyeva śanakairbbairibhūbhṛtaḥvakṣyamāṇavidhānakrameṇa kuryāditiityetadviśeṣyamśanakaiḥ kālakrameṇahaimīdalarasāktaistu homācchatruṃ vināśayetripurugro'pi rogārttaḥ prayāti yamasādanamtatpatrāmbuplutairmmāsādarātirbhrāntimāpnuyātvitastimātraistailāktairhavanādvairiṇo mṛtiḥhomādarātestībrārttijvareṇa syānmṛtirdhruvamhaimīdalarasāktaiḥ haimīdalajalāplutaiḥunmattapatrottharasaplutaiḥvitastimātraiḥ dvādaśāṅgulamātraiḥaru.karavījaiḥ | tadghṛtāplutaiḥ aruṣkaratailāplutaiḥarātīnāmathānyonyakalahānnidhanaṃ bhavetvairijanmarkṣavṛkṣāgnau maṇḍalāntaṃ mṛtirjvarātsarṣapāruṣkaraghṛtasaṃsiktairjuhuyānniśiraktasraggandhapuṣpādiyutaḥ śatrūn vināśayethavanādvairiṇo dāhajvaraprāptistribhirddinaiḥ

sanskrit: sauvīrāktaiḥ āranālāplutaiḥraktasragraktagandharaktapuṣparaktāsanādiyutaḥsarpaśīrṣakaiḥ sarpaśiraḥkalpitasrugbhiḥhavanāttattarūdbhūtasamidhāṃ havanādapidrumakuḍyasarpadaṃśānmattadvipādighātanātyakṣarākṣasagandharvvapiśācabrahmarākṣasaiḥnimvapatraiśca kārpāsabījaistajjaiḥ karañjajaiḥnīcayoge hunedagnau ripuvṛkṣasamedhiteuccāṭanaṃ prayātyeva mantraśaktyābhitāḍitaḥarāterdantino vāhā rogairnaśyanti niścitamnimajjanena pāvake pātanena anyaiḥ apasmārādyaiḥ | vā vikalpephalaiśceti śeṣaḥ | sarṣapasreha siktaiḥ sarṣapodbhavatailāplutaiḥripunakṣatravṛkṣakhaṇḍaiḥ | dinaiḥ proktairmaṇḍalādibhiḥprāguktakaṇṭakādyaistu yadaṅgaṃ vedhayecchanaiḥarddhapraharake śīrṣe praharedvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥgranthibhirvvā kaṇṭakādikṣatavṛddhividāruṇaiḥgardabhīmehasalile saṃsthāpya kkāthayecchanaiḥmadhūcchiṣṭena tāṃ kṛtvā tāpayenniśi tāṃ śanaiḥhunejjahuyāt dantino gajāḥ vāhāḥ hayāḥca | praharādinā ityatrādiśabdaḥ chedanādiviṣayaḥ | vā vikalpekaiściddivasaiḥtāṃ tatkaṇṭakaviddhāṅgīṃ khanet pitṛgṛhe niśiprāguktaireva taddavyairaśeṣaiḥ puttalīṃ tathāsamiddhegnau tatsabhidbhistailāktairjuhuyānniśipralayaṃśanakairdehaṃ tyajan yāti yamālayam

sanskrit: navamyaṅgāradivase mātṛgehegrapīṭhakepitṛgehe śmaśāne | niśi madhyarātre | caḥ samāhāreniśi madhyarātre | yāti yamālayaṃ ripuriti śeṣaḥbhūtādyaiḥ śirasi svīye nirghātavadalakṣitampiṣṭvā sādhyarkṣavṛkṣasya śakalairapi saṃyutamtadvakṣontarnidhāyārināma tālasya patragamsahasravāraṃ sādhyasya vadharkṣe'ṣṭamarāśigegṛhītvā jīvahastena tāṃ japet prayajecchucautaddine tāpatṛṣṇārttivihvalena jvareṇa saḥalakṣitaṃ etat kriyāviśeṣaṇamprayāti nidhanaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayogavalataḥ śivevajrīkṣīreṇa vā liptāṃ baddhāṃ prāgvadadhomukhīmjuhuyāttatsamidbhistu tatkṣīrāktairniśāntarāyadyasti tasya rakṣecchā tāṃ taṭākodare khanettathā yadi na kurvīta ciraṃ rogātmako bhavetcaṇḍikāyatane khātvā tadyoniṃ tatpuro valimprayogadivase | sa sādhyaḥ | śive iti sambuddhiḥjvarārttasya | tathā proktaprakāreṇasvagehe valyadhaḥ khātvā taduparyyagnivarddhanāttāṃ tathākṛtarūpāntu rurujaṅghāsthisaṃyutāmrāśau tadaṣṭame māsāt prayātyudyātyatonyataḥviḍālamūṣikācarmmanaddhaṃ sādhyākhyayā yutammātṛgehe nadīpūrttyāṃ vidveṣaḥ syāddvayostadāupasargakaiḥ kleśaiḥjvarādigadasambhava ityanena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niśi madhyarātre | rāśau tadaṣṭame śatroriti śeṣaḥcaṇḍikāyatane | nadīpūrttyāṃ satyāmiti śeṣaḥtadvidyājāpasiddhāstāḥ khanedarigṛhe punaḥevaṃ nikaṭavarttināṃ abhicāra udīritaḥvadāmi te śṛṇu prājñe sudūrasthasya vairiṇaḥyenārirnikaṭa sthāttu prāgeva nidhanaṃ vrajettāḥ prāgudīritakṣīradvayasiktāḥ sasaṃjñakāḥekāmekāṃ hanedvairidiṅmukhastā aśeṣataḥripukulotsādanamproktaputtalīkhananādividhānenasambuddhiḥ | yena prayogena nikaṭasthāt arāteritiśeṣaḥkathaṃ vā māntrikavalī nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ vrajettairmmāntrikaistasya pūrvvaṃ vidveṣe kārayettataḥbhāgyādhikaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ mātṛkasaṅgatamtanme kathaya deveśa yadyupāyantu vidyateabhicāramarātīnāmāśunāśakaraṃ paramripuriti śeṣaḥ | nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ brajet vadhyatāṃ brajedityardaḥrakṣakābhāvātīśvarasambuddhiḥ | upāyaṃ divyatvādupāyāḥśeṣaḥtairavacchinnadarpantu homayedyāmadik kramātarātinigrahaṃ kuryyādevamuktavidhānataḥekatriṃśat paṭalamevaṃ prakāreṇa|| 31 || oṃ tatsat ||

sanskrit: yena marttyopi bhuvane prakhyāto devatāsamaḥprokteṣu navakuṇḍeṣu tattatkarmmasu coditeśuklapratipadārambhāt pūrṇānte paṅkajairhunetmadhuratrayasaṃsiktaiḥ puṣpairapyaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥteṣveva divaseṣvavjaiḥ sitaistaddhavanādghṛtaiḥkuṇḍādiviṣayaḥekonatriṃśapaloktapariṣecanaparistaraṇādividhānenap. 622) teṣvevotpalahomena śriyamāpnoti puṣkalāmsaubhāgyaṃ kīrttimārogyamavāpnotyarccanādapiacalāñca śriyaṃ prāpya sukhī jīvati bhūtaleputradāsīdāsayutaściraṃ jīvati mānavaḥvanitājanasandohavinodī bhuvi jīvatighṛtāktairabdamātreṇa niḥsapatnāṃ labhecchriyamkāntilakṣmījayārogyayuto jīvati bhūtaleindudravāktaiḥ karpūradravāktaiḥ | turviśeṣekṣīrāhārī ciraṃ bhūmau jīvatyakaluṣāśayaḥāyurārogyavijayasampannāṃ śriyamaśnutepuṇyakīrttirnṛpairmmānyo jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhīhavanāttaddinairiṣṭamakhilaṃ samavāpnuyātvāsāṃsi nānāvarṇāni mahārhāṇi labheta saḥtaiḥ savatsasitāgavyapayoktairhavanādapiajākṣīrayutaistaiśca tathāvikṣīrasaṃplutaiḥtathā dvādaśabhirdravyairekaikaiḥ saṅgataistu vāgobhūhiraṇyavāsobhiḥ samṛddho jīvati kṣitauabdādannasamṛddhiḥ syād ghṛtāktairvvā madhuplutaḥ

sanskrit: sampannaśasyāṃ pṛthivīmavāpnoti suniścitamtairiṣṭahṛdyamilitairhavanāttāṃ mahīṃ labhetśriyaṃ sakalakalyāṇanilayāṃ labhate'bdataḥjuhuyādabdamātreṇa labhate gehamuttamamguḍānvitairvvā juhuyācchiyā suciramedhatehavanāllabhate lakṣmīmabdādatimanoharāmtaddinairindirāṭyaḥ syādvidyāhavanavaibhavātghṛtakṣīratilakṣaudraguḍāpūpasamanvitamśālibhistaṇḍulairmmudgairmāaśairgauretaraistilaiḥkṣudrasarpistilairdundhakerondekṣurasāplutaiḥdugdhasiktapanasāsthiparāgakaiḥ kṣīramiśritapanasavījaparāgaiḥlalitāvidyāvaibhavāt homavaibhavāccalalitāvidyābhaktān | trīn dvau trīn vā dvau vā ityarthaḥ | subhojayetmaghādiṣu tathā homaṃ navabhiḥ syānnavasvapimāṣānnaiśca haridrānnairguḍānnaiḥ pāyasaistathātathā mūlādinavake kalibhirjuhuyāttathāśālīcaṇakamudgotthairmāṣapiṣṭatilodbhavaiḥprokteṣu aśvinyādiṣu | kramāt ekaikāplutaiḥ ekaikadravyakramātdravyamekaṃ tadāplutadravyaṃ tatphalañcaārogyamāyuḥ saubhāgyaṃ mānyatāñca labheddhruvamtathāmṛtākhyayogeṣu juhuyādrogaśāntayeuccayogeṣu juhuyādaruṇairutpalaiḥ śubhaiḥparvvatākhye hunedyoge yaddravyaistaddhi parvatamathānyamadbhutaṃ homamākarṇaya vadāmi tepāyasairghṛtasaṃsiktaiḥ sitamiśraistu vidyayā

sanskrit: vijayādiphalasaptakaṃ mūlādinakṣatranavakaproktahomasādhāraṇamtaddravyaṃ parvataṃ sampūrṇaṃ | parameśvarīti sambuddhiḥtattatprokteṣu kāleṣu grahārttiḥ syānna tatkuledūrvāmṛtātilairnityaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sukhī bhavetna tasya kutracit kaścit kadācit kleśasambhavaḥsaurabhyāḍhyaiḥ prasūnaiśca pūjayedvātha taddineyadi syāttasya rogādipīḍā bhavati niścitamrogādītyatrādiśabdo bhūtādiviṣayaḥvidyāṃ japet sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā pūjayecchivāmtasmādukteṣu kāleṣu tathā kurvvan sukhī bhavetmāntrikatvaṃ bhavelloke śokahāsāspadaṃ bhavethavanādabdamātreṇa vāgmī syāt kuṇṭhavāgapimaṇḍalāttasya patraiśca samidbhirapi mūlataḥmūlaiśca lakṣmīsaṃsiddhyai mā tadanvayagā bhavetsvapakṣaparapakṣayoḥkuṇṭhavāgapi mūkopītyarthaḥkhaṇḍarūpaiḥsādhakasya vaṃśagāminīindirāṃ labhate ramyāṃ sarvalokacamatkṛtāmāḍhyaḥ syādaprajaḥ putrānavāpnoti guṇādhikānlabhate sarvaśasyāḍhyāṃ bhuvaṃ bhoktā ca jāyateśataguḥ sādhakastadvattrimadhvaktairlabhettrayamtagarotthairapi tathā lājaiśca kuṭajairapitāvaddinaiḥ maṇḍaladinaiḥmaṇḍaladināvadhi

sanskrit: bhaume | turviśeṣe | uccasaṃsthite makararāśisthite | caḥ samāhārelabhetetyarthaḥ | trayaṃ gobhūmiputravargāṇāmkuṭajairgirimallikāpuṣpaiḥ | apiḥ samuccayeamvarāṇi vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi ca taddinaiḥkeśaraiśca kadamvaiśca kuṇḍai(ndai)rvicakilairapijuhuyāt prathamārambhaṃ pañcamyantaṃ madhuplutaiḥtathājyāktaistu havanāllabhate bhūṣaṇaiḥ śriyamuditairacalāṃ lakṣmīṃ avāpnoti suniścitamprāgvannandādipūrṇāntamekaikairvāpi pañcabhiḥpāṭalatagarajalajakuṭajaiḥ | caḥ samāhāre | taddinaiḥ maṇḍalātmallikāviśeṣaḥ | apyā pūrvatra taddinairityetadākṛṣyateproktānmaṇḍalāt | eṣa phalakālāvadhi prakaraṇasamānaḥtrimadhvaktaistathaikaikaiḥ sarvvairvvā sādhakottamaḥvāsāṃsi labhate citrāṇyanarghāṇi bahūnyapisitāni vāsāṃsi tathā muktādāmāni rūpyakamtathā damanakaiḥ patrairhavanācchriyamaśnutetadvarṇānyeva vāsāṃsi labhate sādhako dhruvamlajjāmānakulatyāgalolāmiṣṭāṃ samānayetpañcabhiḥanarghāṇi varārghāṇilabhate iti yāvatpatraiḥ tamālasyalalitayā | priye iti sambuddhiḥ | tadvarṇāni hutaprasūnavarṇānicampakāśokapunnāganamerukusumaiḥ śubhaiḥtairevājyaplutairhomādvaśayet puruṣānapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathaiva juhuyānnityamāyuṣe tilataṇḍulaiḥtrimadhvaktairhutaiḥ sarvān vaśayedaṅganājanāntathā puṇḍrekṣutoyāktairhutaiḥ syurvaśagā nṛpāḥnityaśo ghṛtahomena śrīmān bhogī ca jāyatesitānvitaiḥ śarkarāyuktaiḥmadhyarātre | tathā prāgvatturviśeṣe | dinairuktairmaṇḍalāt | caḥ samuccayesaṃpūjya devīṃ hṛṣṭātmā saṃskṛte havyavāhaneprasthamātraṃ taṇḍulantu śālijaṃ sitameva cagṛhītvā pāṇinā vidyāṃ japitvā śatavārakehutvā samāpya pūjāntu tathā bhuktvā tu taddinaṃna kadācidramā muñcatyadbhutā mantraśaktayaḥnivedayecca pūjāyāmabdādāḍhyatamo bhavetsādhakakulaṃ | ramā lakṣīḥ | adbhutāḥ aprameyavaibhavāḥtaddinānnantu kahlāraprasūne vikṣipettataḥkāle tāvāddinairlakṣmīṃ bhūmyāḍhyāṃ labhate dhruvamnidhāyādāya maunī tu hunedagnau bhṛgorddinenṛpamānyāṃ sarvahṛdyāṃ nānābhogānvitāṃ śubhāmnidhāya vikace padme karṇikāyāṃ tatastu tatkarṇikārasya puṣpāṇi tathā campakajāni vaica homamupadiśati | tatra nivedayet pāyasamiti śeṣaḥ | caḥ samuccayenirātaṅkī mahārghāñca rājacorāpahārakaiḥkevalaṃ navanītena sitopetena homataḥbandhūkaiḥ kiṃśukaiścūtaistrimadhvaktairhutakriyādadhyannahomādannāḍhyaḥ sādhakaḥ syāttrimāsataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etairmanubhiraṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhirvargasaṃyutaiḥmartyopi pūjyate devaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvatra sarvadāīkārabindūnāmanyonyamuktakramayogāt jmrī/ itiūkārabindubhiḥ lmryū/ itinābhāvādhārake pādadvaye mūlāgrakāvadhiprāṇena dāhabhūsvenānantaraḥ saptamaḥ punaḥaṣṭamo haṃsahṛtprāptavanasvaiḥ samudīritaḥete ekākṣarā mantrā mudrārūpā maheśvari !namaḥ pade ityākṣepapūrvaṃ vidhānātvāsanā gurumukhādevāvagantavyāvyāptaṃ dāho rasātvambu hṛnmarutsvayutaṃ pṛthakśāktāḥ śaivāśca vijñeyāḥ pañcapañca samīritāḥsthalāḥ akṣarātmikāḥ sūkṣmāḥ vāsanātmikā parā ityuktatvāttattraividhyaṃ pañcame paṭale vakṣyati || 26p. 71) haṃsagairdāhavahnisvaiḥ sasvena marutā tathāsarvastambhakarasvteko mudrā ṣaṣṭho'ṅkuśastayoḥsannidhāpanasaṃjñaṃ ca hetimudrā namaskriyākhecarī bījayonyākhyā saktyutthāpanamityapiyābhirviracitābhistu mantrāḥ siddhyanti yatnataḥtannakhe tarjanīgraste trikhaṇḍā lalitāvahākṣaramekamucyate | tatra mudrāṣaṣṭhaḥ krauṃkāraḥ || 28bāṇadhanuḥpāśāṅkuśā ucyante, tena catasromudrāḥ || 30 || 31vekṣyaṇamiti sampradāyaḥ | anyat sugamamvidadhyāt sthāpanī mudrā sarvā saṃsthāpanī matākarau susliṣṭanakharau mudraiṣā sannirodhinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vilikhya navanītena sametaṃ juhuyānniśitathā palāśaparṇeṣu vilikhya daradairhunetcandanaiḥ pānase patre vilikhya juhuyāttathāsūccagate karkaṭarāśigate | tadanvayagāminī sādhakakulagāminīśarkaropetena | kīrtilakṣmīdhanārogyavijayaiḥ saheti śeṣaḥsahakārapuṣpaiḥ | dadhyannahomāt dadhimiśritānnahomāthutairavāpnoti nijaṃ vāñchitaṃ proktakālataḥtairhutaistadavāpnoti taddinaistadvidhānataḥsitairālikhya ca sveṣṭaṃ patre padmasamudbhavenāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyāhomairudīritaiḥdvātriṃśapaṭalam || 32śeṣaḥ | tasya svābhimatasya || 100 || oṃparāmṛṣṭam || 32 || oṃ tatsat ||tasyā yantrāṇi kathyante tadvidyābhedasambhavaiḥsamastavāñchitāvāptikāraṇāni kṛtātmanāmṣoḍaśānāñca tasyāśca pūjākalamacakrakamkoṣṭhavajraṃ vajraliṅgaṃ meru[setu]liṅgaṃ yathāvidhitadeva ca mahākāraṃ koṣṭhayantrāṇi ca kramātkuryyāt sthaṇḍilapūjāyāṃ hastamātre'tisundaramsadā suvihite pūjā śubhānyasmiṃstathānyathāpramṛjya tiryyaṅmadhyasthaṃ sūtraṃ tiryyaṅnipātayetuddiṣṭakramātvakṣyamāṇamānādyalaṅghitaṃ kuryyādityarthaḥanyasmin uktalakṣaṇādirahite tathā pūjā anyathā aśubhāvidhāya taddvayorantānmadhyasūtrāntataḥ kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvyaṣṭāgrataḥ samārambhānnavamaṃ prathamāntarānavamaprathamāgrābhyāṃ tiryyak saptamakāvadhitataścatuṣkaṣaṣṭhāntadvayārambhāttathāṣṭagamcaturmmarmmānuguṇyena tataḥ pañcamakāntayoḥmārjayenmadhyagaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syāccakramuttamamvidhāya ṣaḍbhirvṛttaiśca caturasre tathāṣṭabhiḥdakṣiṇottarato rekhātrayāt sthānadvayāttathādvidhā kuryyācca catvāri padāni parameśvariārambhāt tṛtīyagaṃ tṛtīyasūtramadhyagaṃsambuddhiḥsundaraṃ susamaṃ sarvalakṣaṇaiśca samanvitamnavabhistvekasūtrasthaiḥ syādetadatisundarammarmmabhiścāṣṭadaśabhiryutaṃ cakraṃ sulakṣaṇamtaccaturvviṃśatiyutaṃ cakraṃ sarvvārthasiddhidamśastrādvadhaṃ mahāvyādhiṃ dāridryamayaśo mṛtimcakraṃ tatraiva tāṃ nityamarcayan matsamo bhavetprāgāditiryaksūtrāṇi ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu ca pañcasudraṣṭavyāśastrādvadhamityādiphalapañcakamarccakāya prayacchatītyarthaḥpratidinaṃ arccayan pūjayan matsamaḥ śivasamo bhaveditividadhyāttīṇi sūtrāṇi kuryyāttenātisundaramdvidviprasthamānatoyapūraṇīyā iti sampradāyaḥaṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ vāhye daśacchadasaroruhamaṣṭacchadābjaṃ dviguṇacchadamaṣṭādaśacchadampaścānnāthān pārśvayośca hetīranyāstathārccayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti jñānānmāñca samāpnuyātśriyaṃ jñānāttathāvāñca saṃyāti parameśvaritanmadhye navadhā kṛtvā koṇeṣu prathamaṃ likhetghaṭayorantarā kṛtvā tiryyagrekhāḥ samantataḥparamārthāditiśeṣaḥ | māṃ śivamparameśvarīti devī sambuddhiḥlikhedbinduvisargābhyāṃ mukhe pañcāmṛtāmbujamvidhāya ca ghaṭādhastādvidadhyādviniyogakamvibhṛyādabhiṣiñcecca janmarkṣeṣvāyurāptayeabhiṣiñcedaśeṣārttiśāntyai siddhyai ca sampadātrivarṣamabhiṣekantu kuryyājjanmatraye tathāārogyo vijayī viśvavandyo bhavati mānavaḥvidhāya sthāpayet kṣaudre yajet sarvvāpamṛtyujitūrmmikādau vahet sarvvasampade riṣṭaśāntayesthāpayettatra ye snātā narāḥ syuḥ sukhino'niśamkoṣṭhānyekonapañcāśatteṣu koṇeṣu mārjayetvikṣvekatastrikoṇāni prāgārambhāt praveśataḥvilomenātha madhyasthe tat sasādhyaṃ samālikhetvināśanamaniṣṭānāṃ jayasaubhāgyadāyakamsamabhyarcya taddhāraṇāt proktaphalasiddhibhāgitiyatrādhiṣṭhitataḍāgādiṣusamaste dhārayet kleśe vijayaṃ sukhamāpnuyātsthāpayitvā ghaṭaṃ prāgvat samastābhyudayāya vaidharādhanapaśuprāptyai naranārīnṛpādināmdhārayet siddhavajrantu samasteṣu prasiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yantramanyat samaṃ vetti yo'sau syānmūḍhacetanaḥtaistatra koṣṭhāni tathā navāśītiśatadvayamanyeṣāmadhikatvena vedanāt kiṃ punarityarthaḥṣaṭtriṃśacchiṣṭavajre tu caturbhirdiktrikoṇakamvilikhettaddvitīyārddhebhedāttu vilikhettataḥnavasu vilikhedvidyākūṭatrayamatha triśaḥvāmatraye dvitīyañca likhet sādhye tṛtīyakamphalāni sarvayantrāṇāṃ paṭale'smin śṛṇu priyeproktaṃ tadeṣāmekaikaṃ yojayet sarvameva caphalāni vāñchayāvāpnotyayatnānnāmayojanaiḥsarvañca sarvadā sarvasamīhitaphalāptikṛtsūtraiḥ koṣṭhāni jāyante ṣaṭśataṃ pañcaviṃśatidevīsambuddhiḥ| iha paṭale | sarvaṃ yantraṃśiṣṭe caturbhistryasrañca vidadhyāddikṣu pūrvavatśiṣṭeṣu saptanavati dviśate madhyatastathākoṣṭhāni trīṇi tiryyak ca samīkṛtya tayostathātayoradhorddhaṃ ca tathā dve dve kuryyādathaikadhāekīkṛtya punaścorddhe dve dve tu mārjayettathādaśakhaṇḍāni śiṣṭaistu madhye liṅgo bhavettathāśiṣṭāni koṣṭhavajrāṇi dviśataṃ daśa pañca catasya liṅgasya madhyasthapaṅktyāṃ tārttīyamālikhetsarvatra tārttīyā vidyā lekhanaṃ samudīritamvidyāśeṣaṃ samālikhya prāgvadārambhatastathādviśastatra yajeddevīmāvāhya parivārakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāsādhyamasti bhuvane yantrairetairmayoditaiḥekonaviṃśakoṣṭhāntaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ tathopariteṣu mūlādiparito madhyāntaṃ vinyaset kramātdevīsambuddhiḥliṅgasya madhyakoṣṭhāntaṃ śiṣṭaṃ koṇeṣu saṃlikhetsarvavāhye tadāvaddhaṃ tasyopari samālikhetnityāparyyāyajanite pārśvayordakṣavāmayoḥliṅgāgramadhyādabhitaḥ piṇḍikāyāñca saṃlikhetkṛtvaivaṃ meruliṅgantu yantraṃ tatraiva tāṃ likhetpaṭādau tat samālikhya pūjayennityaśaśca tāmcatuḥśatāni koṣṭhāni bhavanti susamāni vainityaśaiḥ anudinaṃ | tāṃ lalitāṃ prāgvattataścopari ṣaṭsaptetyevamekādaśāvadhitathā kuryyāt pārśvayośca tenādhiṣṭhānapiṇḍikeliṅgamanyāni pārśvasthamārjanādbhavati priyeliṅge prathamabhedotthastanmadhyasthe svavāñchitammahāliṅgābhidhaṃ yantraṃ tatra pūjākhileṣṭadātattatsūtravaśāt kuryyāddaśa triṣu tathā samamśiṣṭamadhyatrikoṇe tu likhedvāñchitamātmanaḥdinanityāñcālikhedititatra sveṣṭamavāpnoti yonicakrānubhāvataḥtatra tiryyak catuḥsūtrapātanādanyatastathāpraveśagatyā vilikhettāścaturvviṃśatiṃ kramāttatra tāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ pūrṇāsviṣṭārthasiddhayecaḥ samuccaye | tathā tathā yathā yathā prayuktaṃ tathā tathetyarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: | tatra vajravajrayantra | pūrṇāsu pañcamīdaśamī pañcadaśīṣudvitīyabhedāḥ vilikhettathā sādhyasamanvitāḥevamūhyaṃ tṛtīyotthavidyābhirapi kalpayetkoṣṭhayantravibhedāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhievāvadhāraṇeteṣvaṅkāni samaṃ kṛtvā paṃktau teṣu samālikhetmanīṣitañca saṃlikhya teṣāṃ madhyasthakoṣṭhataḥvaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣastambhanoccāṭanādikamsthāpanāddhāraṇāccānyairupāyaiḥ sādhakoniśamaśeṣaṃ devi te proktaṃ yantrasiddhyabhidhāgameiti ṣoḍaśanityātantre śrīkādimate trayastriṃśat paṭalam || 33āgame || 100parāmṛṣṭam || 33 || oṃ tatsat ||camatkārakarīṃ vidyāṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sundariaśvārūḍhāmannapūrṇāṃ navātmānaṃ navātmikāmniṣkatrayapradāmiṣṭadāyinīñca mataṅginīmgopālabhedānauṣadhān vadāmyuktakrameṇa vaihaṃsahṛttejasāṃ yogāddyutidāhacarasvakaiḥsakalabhujaṅgamaviṣaharāṇi svecchotkrāntikaraṇāni casamāyairuditā vidyā pañcārṇāmṛtavigrahāmāyayā vā vidadhyācca dhyānaṃ cādyānudīritedhyātvā siddhamanuḥ paścādvidadhyādviniyogakampāyayitvā ca tāṃ brūyāt ślokayeti samāhitaḥdhyānaviśeṣaḥ proktaśca tatraivetyarthaḥdhyānamamṛteśvarīdhyānameveti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācaṣṭe ca trikālasthānarthān pṛṣṭā mahādbhutampālayeti dviruktvā tat pratilomamudīrayetvidyayāṅgāni niyataṃ svātmānaṃ cintayeditisamāsīnaṃ sudhārdrāṅgaṃ maulābindukalāyutamkanyetyarthaḥ | mahādbhutaṃ mahācamatkārabhūtaṃ yathāvyutkrameṇādyakṣaratrayañcoccarediti sampradāyārthaḥnijavigrahaṃ cintayediti vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇasvaikyena bhāvayennityaṃ jayadīrghāyuredhaterasāvahnisvasahitaprāṇāstaistripuṭoditājapedahno mukhe svaikyaṃ bhāvayaṃstrisahasrakamnaranārīnṛpāṇāñca vāllabhyaṃ labhate naraḥpuṣpeṣvaṅkuśapadmāni padmapāśekṣucāpakānśṛṅgārabhūṣāpikavākcāmarādarśapīḍakāḥvyākhyānamudrā | svaikyena svāpṛthaktvenaparivāryya sthitāstābhirvṛtāṃ tāṃ svaikyataḥ smaretvairimohītyakṣarāṇāṃ catuṣkaṃ garuḍeti casvāhānto gadito mantrastārkṣasyākhilarakṣituḥphaṇidaṣṭān piśācādyaiḥ kliṣṭānanyāṃśca rogiṇaḥtāṃ devīṃ | svaikyataḥ apṛthagbhāvenapālayecchatajaptena toyenābhyukṣaṇāt kṣaṇātahitāni ca khādantaṃ smaraṃstārkṣamanuṃ japetgaralaṃ bhujagānāñca samastānāmayatnataḥśūnyāmbu rasadāhognihṛdambumarudanvitaḥṣaḍaṅgaṃ māyayā kṛtvā japedakṣaralakṣakamprāguktaviṣādīni
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurumukhādavagantavyaḥhaṃsaḥ hakāro marutāyuktaḥ ākārasahitaḥsamānayet svagehe tamānāśāt proktakāriṇamprāpnotyayatnādanayā vidyayā siddhayāniśamcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ prasannavadanāmbujāmanyābhyāṃ hemapāśena kaṇṭhe vaddhvā svasādhyakamdāsohamiti bhāṣantaṃ patitaṃ nijapādayoḥsamastaṃ jīvabhuvanamaśvārūḍhākhyavidyayāmāheśvarīti proktvānnapūrṇe svāheti tanmanuḥtayordakṣiṇakarasthahemavetrāhataṃ | smaran uktarūpāṃ devīṃannapūrṇāvidyāsahasravāraṃ niyataṃ na tasya syāddaridratāsmitavaktrāṃ hemapātrāt pāyasaṃ dadhatīṃ karebubhukṣito bhavedeva na kadācicca kutracitābhyāṃ bhajennityaśo yo mantrābhyāṃ yācate varamtiṣṭheccopari sarveṣāṃ sarvathā sarvataḥ sadākṣmāsvayogānnāmataśca navātma navabhiśca taiḥvidyājapavān annapūrṇāyāḥnavātmikā tu te vidyā dvāvetau sarvasiddhidaudevīhṛdayasaṃjñāsau vidyā sarvārthasiddhidāsitakuṣṭhaṃ svarṇapuṣpīmūlaṃ tatpatravāriṇābhumau śayīta tāṃ rātriṃ vijane suśubhe gṛheājñāsthitaṃ (tā) tathā sā taṃ vahedasyābhivāñchitam| navātmikā prāgvat | turviśeṣe | te vidyā devyāstava vidyātṛtīyacaturthākṣarabhūtena caturakṣarī sambhūyeti yāvat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saubhāgyalakṣmīkīrtyāyurārogyavijayāvahāsvāhāntikā tu vidyeyaṃ kathitā dvādaśākṣarīdhyātvā prāgvaddhayārūḍhā devī sādhayatīpsitamsādhyanāmasamopetāmālikhyaitāntu tanmanāḥnānayā sadṛśī vidyā vidyate vanitāvaśena vidyāḥ santi bhuvane hayagaurīmanudvayāt| taṃ sādhakaṃ | asya sādhakasya saubhāgyādiphalaṣaṭkaproktaphalamsvāhetyakṣaradvayaṃ dvādaśākṣarī sambhūyeti yāvatgaurīvidyādvayataḥ adhikāśca sadṛśāśceti yāvatetaddvitīyaṃ tau syātāṃ kākaṇṭheti tataḥ paramkṛtāṅgo māyayā dhyātvā tāṃ devīṃ sarvamaṅgalāmtrisandhyārccāsamopetaṃ sā prītā lakṣadā dinaiḥsvāhāntaṃ dvādaśārṇeyaṃ vidyā niṣkatrayapradācatvāryyakṣarāṇi pañcadaśākṣarā | sambhūyeti yāvatkriyāviśeṣaṇam | sā devī lakṣadā lakṣasvarṇapradā | dinaiḥ prāgvatprāgvannāmataścārthataścajapitvā varṇaśo vidyāṃ phalamuktamavāpnuyātvyomadvayaṃ marudyuktaṃ rayaśca dharayā yutaḥjātipuṣpairniśāmadhye pūjitā maṅgalākṛtiḥmātaṅginyai tathā svāhā punastrīṇīti tanmanuḥgānābhiyogaṃ viśveṣāṃ mānyatāñca prayacchatisvarṇamityarthaḥ | avāpnuyādityasya nityaśa ityanena ca sambandhaḥsarvamaṅgalādevyāḥ proktavigrahāpratilomāni | tanmanuḥ mātaṅgeśvarīvidyāsahasravāraṃ tenāsau siddhā sarvaṃ prayacchati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pralambaveṇīsannaddhasaugandhikasamujjvalāmūrmmikāvīrakaṭakanūpurairmaṇḍitāṅghrikāmstūyamānāñca parito dhyāyeddevīṃ śucismitāmrasācarasvairambu syādvātāgnī tadanantaramvidyāsau rājyalakṣmyāstu ṣoḍaśārṇā samīritāpṛthak pṛthagiti yāvatyāvatrājyaṃ prayacchati prītā sādhakāyāvilambitamkamalāto laye paścāt prasīdadvitayaṃ punaḥvidyā te saptaviṃśārṇā samastābhīṣṭadāniśamdhyānañca vijayārūpaṃ prajapāddinaśastathātulāsthe bhāskare pūjā pūrṇāyāṃ sakaleṣṭadāvijayānityāsamānavigrahāṃsambhūya iti yāvatpūrṇāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmcaṇḍatejaśca saṅkarṣaṇavarṇāḥ syustadanantaramsiddhalakṣmyādividyeyaṃ proktā saptadaśākṣarāprātaḥ sahasravārantu tarpayettaddaśāṃśakamprayacchati jayaṃ yuddhe śriyaṃ sarvātiśāyinīmkaroti mārge kāntāragirikṛcchrebhirakṣatiyuddhamārgādirakṣāsu śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhihakāraḥ | saptadaśākṣarā sambhūya iti yāvathastadviśatasaṃyuktāṃ svasamākāraśaktibhiḥdhyātvaivamarccayediṣṭamavāpnotyakhilaṃ dhruvammārjayedbāhyavīthīṣu pañcapañca tathaikadhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyatyasyaupakarābhrāntyopakrame tau niveśayetmudrāñjalistu vijñeyā prasṛtā mukulāpi vāpāśamudrā tu tenaiva tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogataḥkuṭilā ṛjumadhyasthā mudrāsāvaṅkuśābhidhāsannirodhanaṃ nāma devatāyā ananyacittatvaprārthanam || 34nāmābhimukhyenopacārāṅgīkaraṇaprārthanaparam || 36tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayoragrayogata ityarthaḥtarjanyau ṛjusaṃśliṣṭe mudraiṣoktā namaskṛtaukṛtvā'ṅguṣṭhau kaniṣṭhāsthau ṛjū kuryācca tarjanīetasyā madhyame devi ! tarjanīvatkṛte satitanmantropetaṃ viracayediti sampradāyārthaḥmūlavidyātṛtīyakhaṇḍena kuryāditi sampradāyaḥsarvayoṣitāṃ ca etaddarśanāt hṛdayollāso bhavatītyarthaḥtābhyāmaṅkuśarūpābhyāṃ saṃśliṣṭā'karṣaṇī matāaṅguṣṭau tarjanīśliṣṭau nakhairāveśakāriṇītadagrāśleṣato bhugne madhyame'nāmike ṛjūiyamunmādinī mudrā sarvonmādanakāriṇīeṣā mahāṅkuśā mudrā stambhanā'karṣakāriṇīmaṇibandhe ca badhnīyādañjalī madhyapṛṣṭhayoḥsthairyamityarthaḥdevatābhāvodbodhanakāriṇīsarvonmādakāriṇī sarvayoṣitāmunmādakarī kledanakarītyarthaḥtatra asyāḥ unmādinīmudrāyāḥ | bhugne aṅguṣṭhāgrāśleṣataḥkaniṣṭhā'nāmike kuryādvyatyastekarapṛṣṭhageasyā viracanenaiva sarvāḥ siddhyanti devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyādi vilikhenmantravarṇān ṣoḍaśa nāma catattatprayogānuguṇamiti yāvatsamastābhīṣṭasaṃsiddhyai siddhalakṣmī tu nityaśaḥsarvanārīsamārambhādakarodvivaśaṃ jagattadā tena vinodāya svaṃ ṣoḍhākalpayadvapuḥtairyantrapūjāhavanajapatarpaṇasecanaiḥśṛṇu tān ṣaṭkramānmantrān dhyānārccāviniyogakaiḥpraṇavadvayamadhyasthaḥ siddhagopālakābhidhaḥvidyāyāḥ saptadaśārṇān krameṇa vilikhedititvakṣarādhikyaṃ divyatvātpraṇavadvayamadhyasthaḥ praṇavapuṭitaḥpuṭanānnāmatastasmādvāṇaistaiḥ puṭanādbhavetādyaḥ pañcāṅgako mantrastvitare syuḥ ṣaḍaṅgakāḥaṣṭapatrāvjamadhyasthaṃ pūjayet saptātikramātvāreṣu bhāskarādyeṣu teṣāṃ pūjā krameṇa vaisaptasvanyatamāṃpāyasairnārikelaiśca sasitaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥitīritaiḥ saptabhistaiḥ sarvamiṣṭamavāpnuyātpuṇḍrekṣucāpapuṣpeṣūn dadhānaṃ śaktibhiḥ smarethṛtkaṇṭhājñālepanato devatādarśanaṃ bhavetāragvadhaṃ muṇḍinīṃ ca śākoṭaṃ jambumūlakamnārikelaiḥ dugdhādyaiḥ| śaktibhirgopīveṣadharābhiriti yāvatgurumukhādavagantavyamkoraṇṭaṃ pippalaṃ mūlaṃ triphalaṃ cūrṇayet samam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāvayaṃstanmayo bhūyāddivasaiḥ kaiścidātmavānasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtambhāvanāsthairyyātparāmṛṣṭam || 34 || oṃ tatsat ||yayā tanmayatāsiddhiḥ pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvamnavatvaṃ tasya dehasya randhratvenāvabhāsatekurukullā bhavenmātā puruṣārthāstu sāgarāḥsaṅkalpāḥ kalpataravaḥ svādhārā ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥtena pūrvvābhimukhyaṃ syādanyatte kathitaṃ mithaḥśrīcakraṃ pūjanaṃ teṣāṃ ekīkaraṇamīritamnavadhātvavāsanā pañcame paṭale vyākhyātāūrmmayaḥ puṇyapāpe ca brāhmyādyā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥkarmmendriyārthā doṣāśca jñeyāḥ syuḥ śaktayoṣṭa vaivāyavo daśa saṃproktāḥ sarvasiddhyādiśaktayaḥśītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhecchā guṇāḥ proktāḥ krameṇa vaimano bhavedikṣudhanuḥ pāśo rāga udīritaḥavyaktāhaṅkṛtimahadākārāḥ pratilomataḥsvātmaiva devatā proktā lalitā viśvavigrahāsiddhistvananyacittatvaṃ mudrā vaibhavabhāvanamprayogāstu vikalpānāṃ hetoḥ svātmani nāśanamrāgatattvarūpa iti yāvat tayorvandhakatvaṃ sāmānyātsandhyāsu bhajanaṃ devyā ādimadhyāntamajjanamtāstu viśvavikalpānāṃ hetavaḥ samudīritāḥjapastanmayatārūpabhāvanaṃ samyagīritam[teṣāmanyonyasambhedabhāvanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhiṣekastu vidyā syādātmā sarvvāśrayo mahāndakṣiṇā bhedaśūnyatvaṃ śuśrūṣā sthairyyamucyatenityā pañcadaśaitāḥ syuriti proktāstu vāsanāḥteṣāmanyonyasambhedaprakāraistatprapañcatāntu de rū ṣe pa ṇa vī śe taṃ di mī na ri syā da tetaḥ rtha ka syā thi ścā stu ta taḥ ntre go rva pi ta ṣu saro ma ī yo kā rvi rśa ta naṃ ta phā ndu la nā nni vimudrāparamārtharūpabhedayogaviśeṣaḥ prapañcatātaddvaividhyapratītirāhityāt tadaikyanirṇītiśca kriyata itimantravīryyasusiddhānāmitareṣāṃ viśeṣakṛtvarṇatrayaṃ samārabhya navārṇāvadhi vījakāḥtata ūrddhaṃ gatā mālāstāsu bhedo na vidyatepadairmmantreṣu bhedaḥ syāt teṣāṃ saṃkhyāḥ śṛṇu kramātsaviṃśati saptaśataṃ catvāriṃśadbhiranvitamtryakṣaramantrabhedādinavākṣaramantrabhedāntamiti śeṣaḥtriśata viṃśati tatastrilakṣeṇa samanvitambhedasaṃkhyetthaṃ saptānāṃ tābhiranyāḥ samunnayetetairevonnayenmantrapadabhedānanukramātrekhāścatasraḥ pañcaivamṛjvākārā daśāvadhisaṃkhyābhiḥ | anyā daśākṣarādibhedasaṃkhyāḥtiryyagrekhāstāvatīśca kṛtvā teṣvaṅkamālikhetādye dvidvikramādaṅkān pūrayettatra coditāndvitīyapaṃktau prathame khaṇḍe śeṣāṃstu pūrayet[tṛtīyapaṃktau tu śeṣaistvevameva samālikhettiryyakpaṃktiṣvanabhyastakramamaṅkāstu sarvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvvādhastādvilomā sā madhyasthā vyākulakramāḥlalitābhedajātāni tadyantroktānyaśeṣataḥanyāstu tatra tatraiva draṣṭavyā yatra coditāḥsamyaktvameṣāṃ kena syāt sarveṣāmapyayatnataḥkāni siddhasya cihnāni kā vā siddhirudāhṛtāekādaśa tataścakraṃ pañcāśatkoṣṭhakaṃ bhavet| vā samuccayeprāṇāgnīlāmbukhātmānaḥ paṃktayaḥ pañca kīrttitāḥtasmāttasyātra vinyāso naikadeśaḥ śivātmanaḥni rśa nā ptaḥ mā spa śca vyā śa ma tāṃ rṇā da nāṃ ru vani sa nā ho mā grā śca dā pi tai sā rṇā ma nāṃ ja vanāṃ tā va mā rṇā nye ni nā maṃ syu thā mā kra nāṃ rya bhaunā tā va mā rṇā nye ni nā maṃ syu thā pyā kra nāṃ ryya māni nā nye sa tā śca mā haṃ ṇāṃ vyo rū me pi ṇa ma kradaśadaśorddhvapaṃktyādhaḥpaṃktiparyyantaṃ kramādvilikhedititasmādatīva gopyāni nāmānyetāni sarvadāpadyamekaṃ vadet karṇe śiṣyasyaivoktarūpiṇaḥryyāt yo ne rbhe ku da ja tai tarṇāśeṣarbhāmasaṃ (?)trayoviṃśādiślokadvayeneti yāvatnānāvṛttānabhīṣṭārthānnihnavāya tu deśikaḥgṛhe vā maṇḍape sthitvā pīṭhaṃ dhavalitodaramkucandanaiḥ kuṅkumairvā daradairvopadeśataḥnityaśo mātṛkāṃ japyāt sampradāyānusārataḥtantre'smin vyākulān ślokānvācayennaiva kevalaḥ || itikuryyānmantramabhīṣṭārthagamakaṃ proktayogataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtoyapracurāḥ saumyāḥ sevyāḥ siddhikarā matāḥtaiḥ tathā bhajanāt siddhāḥ phalanti saikyayogataḥpūjāpaṭalasamproktāstrividhāḥ syurupāsakāḥproktayogataḥ vakṣyamāṇa mantravīryyasvarūpānusandhāna yogataḥsiddhāḥ svasvakrūrasaumyamiśrādi svabhāvānuguṇaṃ phalantītiekonyaḥ sarvataḥ siddhavyutpattyarthābhivīkṣaṇameṣāṃ pañcaprakārāṇāmaśeṣeṇeṣṭasiddhidāḥyena jñānānubhūtena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥtadanusandhānena yathoditeneti yāvatguṇatrayamamīṣāñca yat kāraṇamudāhṛtamtanmantravīryyamuddiṣṭaṃ mantrāṇāṃ jīva īritaḥpraṇavāvayavabhūtairapi prāgvadekīkuryāditi sampradāyaḥsadā prayogādbhajanādakāle saṃśayādbhavetdevatādrohataḥ sarvaparivādānavasthayātatsamyaktvaṃ yena bhavet kāryyaṃ tat pūrvamīritamnātiśoko nātiharṣo nātisneho na matsaraḥsvadehamātrayātrecchā paracintāvivarjanamtattanmantravidyānusandhānamityarthaḥbhoktṛtvaṃ śaktito dānamiti siddhasya lakṣaṇamrājñaḥ prasādaḥ sarveṣāṃ mānyatvaṃ puṇyasiddhayaḥārogyamavisaṃvādaḥ sacchiṣyatvaṃ kṛtajñatāpratyakṣāḥ siddhayaḥ proktā manoḥ siddhasya sarvataḥsiddhamantreṇa karttavyāḥ prayogā nānyathā priyeanyonyavairamastyeva guṇabhūtasamanvayātvāyavyānāṃ jalānāñca bhaumānāṃ syāt parasparam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: proktānigamanañcaasiddhamantreṇa na karttavyā iti yāvat | priye iti devīsambuddhiḥstrīdaivatyeṣu saumyānāṃ krūrāṇāṃ syāt parasparamśastrānuyakṣiṇīnāṃ syādaghorāstrasya cakrataḥkathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe yena lokotisīdatitena mantrā devatāśca kruddhā hanyurupāsakamyanniṣṭhānāmamī doṣā na spṛśanti kadācanaśāstrānuyakṣiṇīnāṃ vairamiti | cakrataḥ sudarśaneneti yāvatyāvat | yanniṣṭhānāṃ divyatvānmantravīryaniṣṭhānityarthaḥtadājñayā bhajedekarūpaṃ mantraṃ svasiddhayedāridryāddīrgharogādvā vyasaneṣvatisarjanāttattadvarṇotthasaṃkhyābhirgulikā mantrasiddhidātatpūjā ca tathā siddhilābhāya syānna cānyathā| vā vikalpe | vyasaneṣu stryādiṣu saptastrityarthaḥyāvat | gulikā mantrasiddhidā tattanmantrasiddhidā ityarthaḥdivyatvātlajjātukā śikhiśikhā darbhāḥ pātalabhṛṅgakaukramāddaśānāṃ varṇānāṃ taiḥ kuryāttattadarccanamkṛṣṇaśaṅkhaprasūnañca citrāphāntā iti kramāttaisteṣāmarcanaṃ kuryyādgurupādārccane rataḥrohiṇastulasī potrī sadāmadreti ca kramāttattatkāryyārthasaṃsiddhyai kuryyāt sadgurudakṣiṇāmkuśo vṛhatī drulatā dūrvvā lakṣmīriti kramātteṣāṃ samarccanaṃ kuryyādoṣadhairebhirādarātsiṃhī dundūkayugalamapāmārgāñjaliḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taisteṣāmarccanaṃ kuryyāttattatkāryyārthasiddhayetatra yathāsiddhi prāguktavidhānenetyarthaḥkathitāni mayā tāni śrutāni ca maheśvarasvarūpaṃ kiṃ kathaṃ viśvaṃ kimākārañca dṛśyatemaheśvaretīśvara sambuddhiḥkimākāramiti | eṣa tṛtīyaḥ praśnaḥteṣāṃ janmāni kena syuḥ kā muktiḥ saṃsṛtiśca kākiṃ mūlaṃ saṃsṛterasyāḥ kāni tattvāni kā ca dhīḥkaḥ kālaḥ ke grahāḥ sarvaṃ yathāvanme vada prabhokathyate tat sphuṭaṃ brūhi nātisaṅkocavistaramsaptamaḥ praśnaḥ | saṃsṛtiśca kā ityaṣṭamaḥ praśnaḥprabho itīśvara sambuddhiḥatisaṅkocātivistārābhyāṃ jñātumaśakyatvātteṣāmuktakrameṇaiva kathayāmi tavottaramyadito'nyatra sarvatra proktaṃ nihnavacakrataḥtairmmayoktakramājjitvā durjayāṃ vāsanāṃ śanaiḥguhyaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ gopayet sarvataḥ sadāgopayet abhaktebhya ityarthaḥ | sarvataḥ prakārata iti yāvatdvayorapi ca yajjñānaṃ tajjñānaṃ viddhi me vapuḥlābhādevaṃ vāsanāyā vināśādanyathā tathānityāhṛdayasaṃproktasphuṭopāyena vā bhavetdevatānāmiti yāvat | caitanyātma caitanyasvarūpaṃ vapuriti śeṣaḥdvairūpyamanayoruktaṃ satyāsatyasama(maya)tvataḥyathātmajānato'rtheṣu vyāpāraḥ puṇyasaṃjñakaḥjanmāni nānārūpāṇi yairnityaṃ kleśabhājanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāvat | etadupāyasyādyupaskaratvāt ārādhyamukhādavagantavyamprapañco nāmarūpābhyāṃ prakāśate itipuṇyapāpātmakatvamitisaṃsṛtirmmocanaṃ buddhervvāsanā vandha īritaḥmocanaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ netaraiśca kadācanabandhaḥ ayathātmajñānamanādidurvāsanayaiveti yāvatyadāyattamidaṃ jīvabhuvanaṃ parivarttatejñātṛjñānajñeyamayānyanyathānyāni sarvadākathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe yadāyattā ca viṃśatiḥyāvadāhūtasaṃplavamiti yāvatjanmajarāmaraṇādyāvṛttibhrāntirūpeṇeti yāvattaditarātmakatvena pratītāni anyāni asatyānīti yāvatvastubhedādabhedācca yaduktaṃ sarvataḥ sadāviṣamañca samaṃ viśvaṃ viśvātītamanāmayamsarvatṛṣṇākaraharaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvataḥ sadāsaṃsārarūpamurttīrṇavigrahaṃ susthiraṃ calamatīndriyaṃ cendriyātmānirdeśyaṃ (vaṃ) sarvadaivatamyadityasya vastvitthanenānvayaḥ | sarvvata āgamāditaḥsarvataḥ prakārata iti yāvatyāvatyāvatsadayañcāvivekātma vivekaparamārthakamśokātmakañca niḥśokaṃ sakautukamakautukamamarśarūpamakṣobhyaṃ sarvakṣobhyaṃ sukhāsukhamaspṛṣṭaṣaḍguṇaṃ ṣaṇḍaḥ vanitā puruṣastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agādhamatigambhīramudāraṃ kṛpaṇantathāanicchamicchārūpañca kātaraṃ vīravigrahamsaṅkocarūpaḥ sarveṣāṃ tathā sarvaprakāśakaḥvivekaparamārthasvarūpamparājayarūpamsukharūpaṃ duḥkharūpañcetiaspṛṣṭaṣaḍguṇaṃ krodhādiṣaḍguṇarahitamduravagāhaṃbhāgyemityādinā ślokenāṣṭaguṇāḥvātāditridoṣātmā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiti yāvatsarasaṃ virasaṃ krūraṃ saumyaṃ tairbahubhistu kimubhayaikyādvivekātma jīvo'nyastadvivekavānsāmarthyaṃ svāvibheditvaṃ siddhe prāpyaphalāni catenaiva vihitaṃ sarvaṃ prapañcātmaikyavigrahamsṛṣṭāni bhūtaśaktyātmavigrahāṇīndriyāṇi tutairguṇaiḥbuddhyadhīnamiti yāvat | tena buddheryāyātmyavidā | evāvadhāraṇeprāṇāstatsākṣibhūto hi jīvastattvātmakaḥ paraḥkāla ityakṣaradvandvādyadvācyaṃ tadvapurmmamatathāpi tava yatkiñcidvyākaromi samañjasātena tanmayatārūpakathanaṃ nocitaṃ tataḥkālasya rūpaṃ tat proktaṃ yadanādyantavigrahamnalinyā patranicaye sūcīviddhe'tha tasya vaitattriṃśadguṇitaṃ proktaṃ truṭītyādiśarīravāniti pṛṣṭena tadvaktuṃ śakyate susphuṭaṃ mayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattasya vapuruddiṣṭaṃ nānyāsti gatiratra vaisvarūpaṃ tattasya kālasya svarūpamiti yāvat | atra kālasvarūpakathanebhūtādīni samastāni vikṛtāni vitanvatetaireva teṣāṃ nāśaśca maruteva havirbhujaḥtathāpi me prapañcātmaviveko'bhūnna me'dhunāarūpasya vibhostasya jīvaścettat kathaṃ sthitiḥbhūtādivikārāṇāṃ | deva vibho iti dvayamapīśvarasambuddhiḥkaroti | tatra tathāpi me kathitamapi | adhunāpīti śeṣaḥ | adyāpīti yāvatmukto vā jāyate kintu pare vā sambhavanti kimdeheṣu jīvasaṃprāptiḥ kīdṛśītyādi me vadatathā me sarvasandehāṃśchindhi pūrṇopadeśataḥjananaṃ maraṇañceti dvayaṃ dehaparigrahātavasthā kālaparayostādātmyādeva varttanamanyasya praśnasyeti śeṣaḥdehābhimānamātramevetina vāpūrvvāḥ sambhavanti buddheḥ kṛtyamaśeṣataḥjīvādirūpato buddhirviśeṣayati tatparamjalāgnyostatra cānyatra vyaktāvyaktasthitiḥ sadātādātmyādeva varttanamiti kathitamitibuddheḥ kṛtyamitivyoma sarvagameva syāt kālatādrūpyataḥ sadājīvānāmāgatirdehe mātāpitrostu vīryyataḥtatra prāravdhaviramānmaraṇaṃ nidrayā samamprāgeva tasya dehātmavivekānmanasi svagekālatādrapyataḥ kālātmakatveneti yāvat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anāmike'dhovyatyaste tarjanyāvaṅkuśākṛtīkaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhasaṃśleṣā mahāyonistrikhaṇḍikāvalitāvūrddhayogena ṛjutarjanikau karaumūrtīkaraṇaṃ devatāyā mūrtitvena svadehasya kalpanamityarthaḥkopapratipādikā muṣṭirevetimūrttīkaraṇametasyā racanena samīritamsthūlasūkṣmaparākhyātā stattraividhyaṃ śṛṇu priye !tattvarūpāṇyaṅgulayo bhūtānyaṅguṣṭhataḥ kramāttava māyābahirbhūtastvatprasādādahantvitisvalpabhedāt kopaharṣau prāṇināṃ janayatyataḥpūjākāle darśanīyā mudrāstāḥ sarvadā śive !vidyātmatāpādanam || 60ṣaḍaṅganityātārtīyairekaikaṃ daśavārataḥsvātmapūjopakaraṇānyaśeṣaṃ vidyayā śive !dadhānaṃ kāmarājāṃke yantritāṃ muditāṃ smaretnityārcaneṣu sarvatra proktaṃ naimittikārcanenavāvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ dhyānaṃ devyā samaṃ bhavettatsamaṃ parameśāni ! cakrasthānāmaśeṣataḥnityanaimittikārcanayordhyātavyetyarthaḥ || 62p. 78) tatheśitvaṃ vaśittvaṃ ca prākāmyā bhuktisaṃyutābījadvayādyāḥ siddhyantāḥ saptākṣaryā ca saṃyutāḥvārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā tadanantarametāścāṣṭau taddvayādyāḥ saptākṣaryantagāḥ kramātprādakṣiṇyena tāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayetprathamāvṛtaurūpaṃ rasaṃ tathā gandhaṃ cittaṃ dhairyaṃ smṛtiṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti yāvat | dehe jīvānāmāgatiḥ setipuṣyādiṣu tu māseṣu ṣaṭsu rākopakaṇṭhataḥsiddhastu pūrvato mukto dehendriyamanaḥsthiraḥsugatitvaṃ vyanyaktyeva jīvanmukto yatastvayambuddhervaividhyarūpasya kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vada prabhojāyate tvāśrayavaśāt sa ca karmmabhireva vainopalabhyo bhavet śuṣkamathanavyāpṛtiṃ vinā| ayaṃ siddhaḥitīśvarasambuddhiḥsthalaviśeṣavaśādbuddheḥ kāryaireva prakṛtiviśeṣo bhavatītina kasyāpi bhavedeṣā pratijñā viśvato'niśamtathā sadgurusaṃsevāṃ saṃprāpya svasvarūpakamviśeṣaḥ ko bhavedanyadurlabhaḥ satyavigrahaḥdayārdracittatā rāgadveṣāviṣayacittatākṛtajñatā satyatā ca paracintānivarttanampratijñeti yāvat | viśvataḥ hetoḥ | svasvarūpakaṃ ātmajñānaṃsulabhatvamityādinā ślokena lakṣaṇaṣaṭkamadairghyasūtryamakṣaudryaṃ nātyagādhāśayātmatāvṛthāvinodarāhityaṃ jihmacittairasaṅgatiḥasteyaśaktirāstikyaṃ paralokānucintanampāpānāṃ varjanaṃ puṇyakaraṇe kautukaṃ sadānispṛhatvamalolatvamanākṣepo'jaḍātmatāsaulabhyāditi yāvatdṛṣṭādṛṣṭānupayogitvamuktaṃ | jihmacittaiḥ kapaṭahṛdayaiḥyāvat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parastavaneṣu paranindāsu caguruvidyāgamācārastavanaṃ tatpravarttanamna bhavantītareṣāntu pradviṣantyeva tāṃśca tenirastāśeṣasaṃsāramaurkhyājñānāvivekavānpālayan susmitamukhaḥ pūjāpūjanakautukīpatitānvandhucittājñādurlaṅghyān svacayasthitīnmuhurmuhuśca vimṛśedviramedaśubhātmanaḥstavanaṃevāvadhāraṇe | tān ātmajñānavataḥ | te ātmajñānarahitāḥgamayeddevatāpūjājapayogastavādināgamayedaniśaṃ kālaṃ na vadet paradūṣaṇamtadguṇaistatkṛpādhikyaiḥ puṇyaiśvaryyaiśca satyataḥsantoṣācāranityamaśāntijñānādibhistathānityācintā svātmaśuddhiḥ kṛtyamātmavatāṃ sadāsvātmaśuddhiḥ svavāṅmanaḥkāyānāṃ śuddhiriti yāvatyoniṃ tanmadhyato devīṃ lalitāṃ pṛṣṭhato gurūnkāmeśvaryyādikāstatra tadvahirdvādaśasvapitannāmavidyābhirvā tāḥ pūjayet sārghakalpanamnānyat kṛtyaṃ bhavettasya nityanaimittikādikampūjayet prāgvadubhayaprakārādekayogataḥsiddhānāmapi sarveṣāṃ yenāsau svātmavānabhūtyatparāmarśato bhāvastvāvayoraikyamaśnutenāśiṣyāya na dambhāya pracchrannānayaśīlinena pāpāya na vittāya nādakṣāya ca bhedinesvarūpajñānavān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhedine dvidhābhāvaśīlāyaśaktyā saṃgṛhya vidhivadbhajate sa madaṃśakaḥasyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam|| 36 || oṃtatsat ||madaṃśakaḥ citsvarūpa īśvara iti yāvatṣaṭtriṃśatpaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 36 || oṃ tatsat ||adhyarddhasaptaṣaṣṭiśca vyākhyāgranthāḥ śatatrayamśatānāṃ navakaṃ tvekatriṃśatā ca samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bijadvayasvarādyāśca ākarṣiṇyantakāḥ kramātprathamāvṛtau caturasre || 66 || 67 || 68 || 69 || 70kalāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi | evamanyepi pañcadaśamantrā ūhanīyāḥpaścāddalaṃ samārabhya vāmāvartena sundari ?rekhā ca veginī paścādaṅkuśā mālinīti caprācyādidikṣu svāgryādikoṇeṣvarcyāḥ pradakṣiṇamantaścaturddaśārādau paścimādapradakṣiṇamākarṣiṇyāhlādanikā tataḥ sammohinīti caunmādinī tato jñeyā tataḥ syādarthasādhanīanaṅgakusumāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ityādi || 75trayodaśamantrān yojayet || 77 || 78dvayasarvādikāḥ sarvā śaktisaptākṣarīyutāḥantardaśārayugme tu devī saptākṣarātmikācaturthī śaktirākhyātā tathā maṅgalakāriṇīmṛtyupraśamanī paścāttathā vighnanivāriṇīdaśaitāḥ śaktayaḥ pūjyā dvayasarvādikāḥ kramātproktā sā pañcamī śaktistathā vyādhivināśinīuktaivamānandamayī tathā rakṣāsvarūpiṇīyojanīyāḥdvayasarvādikāścaitāḥ ṣaṣṭhā'varaṇagā yajetvaśinyādīn yajet prāgvat saptākṣaryā namaḥ padepāśamaṅkuśamityetaccatuṣkaṃ tadbhujāntikenāthā/śca pṛṣṭhato devyā jayinīvimalāntarepūjayāmi | evamanyānapi navamantrān yojayet || 84 || 85anyatrānuvidhānāt sarvatra
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yatastasmāttanau tasyā anyāḥ pañcadaśārcayetkāmeśvarīṃ savajreśīṃ tathā ca bhagamālinīmtato nāmāni śaktīnāṃ devīsaptākṣarīyutamdvayaṃ samastāṃ vidyāṃ ca pīṭhadevyabhidhāyutāmpraticakraṃ ca madhyasthāṃ vidyayā navanāmabhiḥnāthānāmarcanasthānamupadiśatiśrīśabdaprayogaḥ sampradāyātdvayametā iti proktā guṇānyoginya ityapidevyā gṛhṇantviti bhavettatraividhyaṃ śṛṇu priyeśrīśabdadvayaprayogaḥ prāgvat sampradāyātpararūpaṃ tvarpaṇena viditaṃ pūjanaṃ śivetatturīyasvarūpaṃ tu bindutrayavadīritamtadbhāvanāṃ śṛṇu prājñe ! mahodayakarīṃ śubhāmmahāśabdaprayogaḥ sampradāyāt || 94pūjayet | evamanyeṣvaṣṭasvapi boddhavyam || 96kucarūpañca taccheṣaiḥ śeṣāṅgāni ca bhāvayetasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamtadātmatvabhāvanām | mahodayakarīṃ akhaṇḍātmasvarūpalābhātsiddhyantyeveti | gurormantrātmakatvaṃ tanmukhādavagantavyammantrātmanaste sāyujyaṃ siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥpādyārghyācamanaṃ snānaṃ vasanābharaṇāni catāmbūlamarcanāstotraṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca namaskriyāmsāyujyaṃ tādātmyamsampradāyaḥṣoḍaśasaṅkhyākān pūjopacārān kuryādityanvayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japetsahasramathavā śataṃ taddinajantu vānyāsatrayaṃ vidhāyātha devyātmā viharetsukhīna tasya kutracit kaścit kadācit kleśasambhavaḥtasyāvayoḥ prasādena tāni syurlakṣaṇaṃ hi tatśṛṇu yairatulā siddhistattaccakreṣu pūjanātsarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ sarvasaubhāgyaparidāyakamstavābhyāṃ kṛtena prasādena sambhavantītitatra yaiḥ nāmabhiḥsarvarakṣākaraṃ sarvasiddhipradamataḥ paramevaṃ navāni nāmāni guṇayogīni pārvati !sampradāyāstadantasthāḥ kulakaulanigarbhikāḥatipūrvarahasyāstu madhyasthāḥ sthūlavigrahāḥśrīmālinī ca siddhāmbā mahātripurasundarīsarvamadhyamityarthaḥ | guṇayogīni anvarthāni | pārvatīti sambuddhiḥvidyāsaptākṣarīmadhyayojitairebhirarcayetsādhakavratacaryāṃ ca siddhicihnānimeva (?) cajyotirūpaṃ ca nāthāṅghrimūrtiṣṭe (?) nyastavigrahāḥsarvadā sarvagāḥ sarvasiddhidā balidānataḥāvarakavadbhāta ityāvaraṇamityupahvaraḥ sampradāyārthaḥpaṭale'bhihito'smābhiḥ || 14tadviśeṣān saṅkocakramarūpān | siddhicihnāni vidyāsiddhicihnāniprasannacetāḥ karpūravāsitā syāvarāṅgavānṣoḍaśākṣaramantreṇa baliṃ dattvā'rcayedgurunnāthaṃ ca tanmayībhūtaṃ dhyātvā'tmānaṃ tadātmakammātṛkādyena tannāmnā namontena samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānmarakataṃ vajraṃ gomedaṃ padmarāgakamindriyāṇyaśvarūpāṇi tatra paścimato yajetpaścimādi tu madhyāntaṃ vilomānnavaratnakamtattvaṃ grahāśca mūrtiśca cakreśvaryantanāmakaḥatra prakaraṇe indriyārthāvadhi namontenaiva tattannāmnā pūjayetnamaḥ | navaratnakamarcayediti || 24cakreśvaryantanāmakāḥkaruṇātoyaparikhaṃ madhyamāṇikyamaṇḍapamrūpiṇīśaktisahitaṃ tataḥ saṃgītiyoginīḥsaptākṣarairupetāstu pūjayet sarvamātaraḥhemādipātre sādhāre sthāpayedarghyamambunājapecca daśavāraṃ tattarpayettena yoginīnamaḥ atrāpi namaḥśabdayojanaṃ sampradāyātśaktiśabdayojanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca prāgvatlohitaṃ tatprabhāvedhāllohitaṃ ca nijaṃ vapuḥādyayā'tha tṛtīyādiṣaṣṭhyantābhiḥ tathāsanamdevī itikarpūram | laghuḥ aguruḥpratitrivāraṃ cābhyarcya japitvā arghyodakena proktakāryāṇi kuryāttato dvitīyayā proktaṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretproktā śikhā tathā samyagadhoṅguṣṭhena muṣṭinātarjanīmadhyamānāmā proktā netratraye (ca) kramātsaśabdaṃ tarjanījyeṣṭhāyogādastramudīritamtataḥ kṛtvā vaśinyādi nyāsaṃ prāguktayogataḥnetratrayāya vauṣaṭ ai/ klī/ sauḥ astrāya phaṭ || 33
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agrasthamadhyacakrasthayonimadhye niveśya tāmproktāḥ saptadaśāthaināmupacāraiḥ samarcayettato devyāḥ svamūrtitvānnityāḥ pañcadaśāpi caārabhya paścimadvāradakṣaśākhāmathārcayettathā brāhmyādikā aṣṭau pūjayet prathamāvṛtaupūrvapaṭalapratipāditavaryakūṭākṣarādiyogataḥ || 35 || 36 || 37pañcopacārāstu gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyāni || 93navasvāvṛttiṣu proktairnavabhirmanubhiḥ kramātṣoḍaśāre tvaṣṭadale tathā taccaturāvṛtaumadhyayoneragramūle pārśvayorbahirarcayetbāhyādīśāntamabhito vāmāvarttena saṃsthitaḥsthūlāḥ puṣpamayāḥ, sūkṣmāḥ mantrātmānaḥ samīritāḥkamalaṃ kairavaṃ raktaṃ kahlārendīvaraṃ tathāmānmathakṣobhajanakaṃ pūjāhomavidhānataḥpūjāṃ prāguktām | ekaikaśaḥ pratyāvaraṇamitiśeṣaḥmadhyasthāvakāśa ityarthaḥ || 46 || 47 || 48 || raktaśabdaḥ kairavaviśeṣaṇam ||tathāvidhaṃ syāttaccāpaṃ sthūlaṃ puṇḍrekṣukāṇḍajamkāmeśvaryyādikāḥ śaktīḥ tathā madhye śivāṃ yajetupacārān vidhāyātha proktayogasamanvitamsmaretsvātmani tāḥ pañcadaśa nityāḥ samarcayetātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa pūjayitvā tato japetsandhyātrayaṃ ṣaṣṭhisaṅkhyamuktaṃ vā proktarūpataḥātmamantrasya saptākṣarīyojanaṃ ca na bhavet sampradāyātkuṇḍe sthaṇḍilamadhye vā samprokṣyārghyāmbunā kuśaiḥmadhye tathā'gnimādhāya kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratyekaṃ saptajihvāsu kuryānnava ghṛtāhutīḥtatastāṃ binduge dhāmni vilīnāṃ paribhāvayetannavyañjanapuṣpāmbudānenoktasvarūpataḥsvamudrayā śakticakraṃ khecaryātmani yojayetjapitvā stotrayugalaṃ devyātmā vicaret sukhīaśaktānāṃ tu vistāre tathā'patsu ca śasyatehetibhirmadhyamādyaṃ syāt dvitīyaṃ navayoniṣupañcamaṃ sarvaduḥkhārtināśanaṃ vāñchitapradamdevyātmā nyāsatrayāditaḥ sukhīkṛtākhilakartavyatvātaśaktādīnāṃ rājavanitādīnām | āpatsu agnipātajvarādiṣuiti pañcaprakārā'rcā proktā sarvārthasiddhidātadābhimukhyacihnāni vighnāni prāktanādyataḥyena martyopi siddhyeta jīvanmuktobhavanmayaḥguruṃ vittena santoṣya raktāgāre kramaṃ bhajetmocāguḍasitopetaṃ payaḥpāyasamarpayetdvāviṃśe kurukullāpaṭale vakṣyate | tatraiva tāṃ śṛṇu ityarthaḥtāni śṛṇviti | yena phalarūpeṇa bhavanmayaḥ devīvigrahaḥsantuṣṭena guruṇā anuśiṣṭa eva kuryāt | kramaṃ nityakramamśarkarāḥ | arpayet nivedayet pratisandhyamiti śeṣaḥhomaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ cendumajjalaiḥkuryāttena bhavet pūrṇaṃ lakṣaṃ pūrṇāntamīśvari !tretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ tadvat dvāpare triguṇaṃ smṛtamtārtīyasaptasaṅkhyā sā tena syādekaviṃśatiḥvanitākṣobhatobhogānna vighnaṃ jāyate yadivarjyāni śṛṇu deveśi ! taddineṣu sadāpi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nidrāśokau tathā'lāpaṃ deśāntaraparibhramamśṛṇu sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nāśakāni castriṣu rāṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca duṣṭāsvapi na yojayetpuraścaraṇajapasaṅkhyāviśeṣānuktāvevāṅgīkaraṇīyamprastauti | tatra taddine puraścaraṇadineṣusarvadā sarvasmin kāle caparanindanāni | duṣṭāsvapi avidheyāsvapiānukūlyasya cihnāni śṛṇu sādhayatastadāgajādrisaudhaśṛṅgeṣu vihāro rājadarśanamutsavaṃ sasurāmāṃsadarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathākṛṣṇavarṇairbhaṭaiḥ svapne prahārastailalepanamrāṣṭrakṣobho vahnivāyujalabhībandhunāśanamanyamantrārcanaśraddhā vighno nityārcane'niśamśraddhāsthairyaṃ sampradāyasiddhinityārcanaṃ bhavetsādhayataḥ sādhanaparasya | tadā prāgukte sarvakālenṛtyagītayordarśanamityanvayaḥ | sparśanaṃ tathā tayoriti śeṣaḥ || 82sa nāpnoti phalānyuktānyanyathā nāśameti casa caturddhā tatoloke tatprakārān śṛṇu priye !grāmagogṛhagaśceti caturdhā tadvyavasthitiḥprāgādi paścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyasetīśe dvayamathomadhye svarātprāgādi vinyasetmanīṣitārthaprāptikarīvidyā satsampradāyavatītitataḥ dvitīya iti uktaprakāreṇa | tadvyavasthitiḥ kūrmavyavasthitiḥtanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣī pādau tatastataḥmukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syātkarayoralpasiddhikṛtpucche mṛtyustu niyataṃ pṛṣṭhe sarvārthadāyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyañjanaṃ deśakūrme * syāt gṛhakūrme svarāstathānityaṃ pūrvamukho yasmāttena tatsiddhirīritātasya kūrmasya karayugaṃ tadanantaraṃ koṣṭhadvayaṃ tasya jaṭharammantrāṇāṃ tena siddhiḥ syātsarveṣāṃ sarvatastadāvijñāya vargaṃ teṣvekamādyaṃ nāmni prakalpayettattatsthāneṣu niyatamanarthaṃ śūnyatā tathāasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamtadavayavāvasthānādhīnā || 97 || yena kūrma vibhāgajñānenaśūnyatā niṣphalatānaimittikaṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca vakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu sundari !anyathā bhajanaṃ cecchan karotyāpatparamparāmtadvidhānamato vakṣye caitrādyaṃ phālgunāvadhipūrvapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ niśi saṃsthāpya vidyayāanyathā bhajanaṃ uktakramaviparyāsabhajanam, etatsarvasādhāraṇamguṇavidhānaṃ tatprakāraṃ ca prastautiasminmāse ca pūrṇāyāṃ vasantotsavapūjanamsaugandhikaiḥ sakāśmīraiḥ pūjāṃ pūrvavadujjvalāmapi vā candrakastūrīcandanaiḥ śiśirodakaiḥphalaistu pūjayeddevīṃ pūrvavat sarvasiddhayeelā kakkolajātībhirupetaiḥ pūjayecchivāmtadvidhānamidaṃ bhadre ! śṛṇu saubhāgyadāyakamyathāśakti vittairgurupūjanaṃ ca kuryāditipūrvavat prāguktādhivāsapūrvakampūrvavat sādhivāsamsādhivāsaṃ pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kārpāsasambhavai raktairnavadhā guṇitaiḥ śubhaiḥnavāṅgulairvā tatsaṅkkhyai saragranthyādisaṃyutamkṛtvā'dhivāsapūrvaṃ tu pūjayettairyathākramamaṣṭottaraśataiḥ sūtraiḥ kuryācchaktyā * ca tārakamvārāhīkurukullādiśaktīnāṃ mūlaśaktivat10 || vā pakṣāntare | raktaiḥ kuṅkumacandanādyaruṇitaiḥkramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāmātmavatsamudīritamparidhānapramāṇena maṇḍapasyaikasūtrataḥkṛtvā pavitratritayaṃ tāni devyai samarpayetna kuryānmānasāṅkaryaṃ yadi kuryādvinaśyatiprasūnairarcayeddevīṃ pūrvoktavidhinā yutamārabhya pūjayeddevīṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥsahasraṃ juhuyānnityaṃ japaṃ caiva samācaret|| paridhāna pramāṇena śaktiyoginīnāṃ mānenatatra pūrvoktavidhinā yutaṃ adhivāsapūrvamamāvāsyānantarapratipattithim | upahāraḥ nivedyamdatvā bhūṣaṇavastrādi dakṣiṇāṃ ca samuddharettena vidvān bhavetsiddho nṛpatiṃ kurute'rcakamrātrau pradīpakairhomaiḥ kuryāt ghṛtasamedhitaiḥśaktīnāmekamekaṃ tu sthāpayettattadagrataḥkṛtvā nivedayenmūlavidyayā saprasūnakamnivedyābhyarcayenmāṣapiṣṭāpūpairyathāvidhisamācaredityarthaḥ | sampūjya nityoktakrameṇakanyakāpūjanaṃ kuryāditipakṣāntaraṃ eṣa gauṇaḥ pakṣaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māṣapiṣṭāpūpaiḥ pūjayedityarthaḥ | yathāvidhi adhivāsapūrvampūjayediṣṭasaṃsiddhyai gavyaṃ dugdhaṃ nivedayetpūjayeddugdhanaivedyasitāpūpādibhiḥ sadācūtasaugandhimadhukaiḥ pūjayedīpsitāptayekuryādvaiśeṣikaṃ puṇyeṣvāgamokteṣu teṣvapiprocyante kāmyarūpāṇi ṣaṭkarmāṇi samarcanaiḥproktāni kāmyakarmāṇi prayoge'nyatsamarcayetajamahiṣyādikṣīravyāvṛttyarthamādiśabdaḥ phalādiviṣayaḥ | sadā sarvadinārcaneṣutatra svarṇarājataiḥ puṣpairiti śeṣaḥāgamokteṣu gurujanmadivasādiṣuṣaṭkarmāṇi tadaṅgatvādanyeṣāṃ na pṛthak sthitiḥpūjādravyairdeśakālaiḥ kathyante sādhvanukramātjayāya dahanāgāre lābhāyānilamaṇḍaledravyaiḥ ṣoḍhā vibhajyāhaḥ kramādrātriṃ ca pūjayettāni pūjāvidhau proktairdevyāstairnavanāmabhiḥcaitrādimāsanāmāni teṣu tairdānapūjanaiḥsaparyāviśeṣeṇaiva vāñchitāptikathanamitivaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣaṇādīnām| deśakālairityatra kālaśabdomuhūrtādivācovrīhimāṣayavakṣaudraghṛtatailapayombaraiḥcaitrādiṣu rutaṃ nādaṃ dadyādvidyāvide'rcayetbilvovaṭaśca mātṝṇāṃ pādapāḥ samudīritāḥteṣu caitrādiṣu yajedājñāsiddhirdṛḍhā bhavetāyuḥ kāntiṃ śriyaṃ bhūmiṃ vijayaṃ śaśvadaśnute
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mocāṃ guḍaṃ nārikelaṃ pūrṇāntaṃ homayedapidarśe tvekamathaivaṃ syāt kṛte lakṣmyā nṛpo bhavetlakṣmyānṛpobhavedityanvayaḥbhaume raktotpalaiḥ saumye vāre tagarasambhavaiḥutpalaiḥ śanivāreṣu pūjayedabdamādarātpāyasaṃ dugdhakadalīnavanītaṃ site ghṛtamgrahapiḍāṃ vijityāśu mukhāni ca samaśnuteunnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanameka dviṣaṭkramonnāmaḥ śriyai kīrtyai ca kalpateratne hemani rūpye ca tāmre dṛṣadi ca kramātupacārāntarāṇyucyantecaturasrot padmadvayamunnataṃ tasmāccaturdaśārādikaṃ samunnatamlakṣmīkāntiyaśaḥputradhanārogyādisiddhayephalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācanakulavittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathāsiddhadravyaiśca (?) saptāhāt khecarīmelanaṃ bhavetkadambajātīpuṣpābhyāṃ siddhadravyaiḥ śivāṃ yajetketakīkusumaiḥ siddhāśceṭakā vāridhestaṭevasūni mālābhūṣādi dadyādasyecchayā'niśamsarvanityārcanaprastārasādhāraṇāni || 54 || sthāpayet pratiṣṭāṃ kuryāt ||mohena avivekāt | ajñānataḥ niṣedhājñānataḥśālmalīkusumaiḥ siddhadravyairmāsaṃ tu nirbhayaḥaśmapātaprahārādyairasya ghnanti dviṣaściramyajeddevīṃ cakragatāṃ siddhadravyasamanvitāmtena siddhyanti vetālāstā nāruhya svecchayā caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyarātre yajeddevīṃ kṛṣṇavastrādibhūṣaṇaḥsādhyayoniṃ tadagre tu baliṃ dadyānnivedayetjāyante bhīṣaṇāḥ kṛtyāstābhyaḥ sādhyaṃ nivedayetdevyā lalāṭanetrāḥ syuḥ prārthanena tirohitāḥdadyāt, ekaika iti śeṣaḥ || 61 || nirbhayaḥ piśācādidarśanāt acakitacittaḥ ||62 || piśācikāḥ piśācikā nāma kāścana bhīmavigrahā devatāḥudyāne nirjane devīṃ cakre sañcintya pūjayetsiddhadravyasamopetairmāyāḥ siddhyanti māsataḥyābhirviśvamayoviśvacārī viśvavinodavāncandracandanakastūrīmṛganābhirmahodayaiḥpūrṇapratītau bhavyāni vikale'bhavyamīritammātṛkāsahitāṃ vidyāṃ trirāvṛttyāmṛtātmakamabdāccaturvidhaṃ tasya pāṇḍityaṃ bhuvi jāyatesiddhamasmatsamīhitam, yathāgataṃ gacchata iti prārthanena || 68indrajālādipradarśanenaāyudhavarṇāvayavādivaikalyasphuraṇe | abhavyaṃ amaṅgalamsa yogī brahmavijjñānī śivayogī tathā'tmavitcampakendīvarairmāsādārogyamupajāyatedantakarṇajvaraśiraḥśūlagulmādikukṣijāḥsarve tayā samaṃ yānti pūjayā parameśvari !sindūraṃ gairikaṃ lākṣā daradaṃ candane'pivādaradenāsya madhyasthāṃ pūjayetparameśvarīmnānārūpakathanaṃ lokoktyanumatyarthamrogāḥ sarvarogā iti śeṣaḥ || 79śrīcakranirmāṇadravyasaptakamupadiśati | tatra candane śītarakte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kusumairmāsamātreṇa nāgakanyāḥ sametyatamyakṣarākṣasagandharvasiddhavidyādharāṅganāḥsiddhyanti pūjanāttatra tathā tatproktakālataḥraktotpalairaśvasiddhyai kumudaiḥ kharasiddhayejambīrairmahiṣāvāptyai lakucairajasiddhayebakulairaṅganāsiddhyai kalhāraiḥ putrasiddhayesaurabhādyaiḥ prasūnaistu nityaṃ saubhāgyasiddhayeetaccakrārcanaṃ lalitānityāyā eva, nānyāsām | taṃ sādhakamyakṣetyādayo devatāviśeṣāḥ || 83 || tatra vīrā manuṣyasiddharūpāḥsyandanāndolikādisiddhaye || 85 || 86 || 87yāvatphalāpti vā kṣīraśarkarāghṛtapāyasaiḥtarpayet kusumaiḥ sārghyaiḥ sarvopaplavaśāntayedugdhairārogyasaṃsiddhyai tribhiraiśvaryasiddhayesarvārthasiddhaye toyai rabhiṣiñcenmaheśvarīmnivasaṃstatra tatpuṣpairjāyate manmatho'paraḥkṛtyāḥ pareritā mantrā vimukhāstān grasanti vaisarvanaivedyānītyarthaḥnityapūjāmantraistatkrameṇa dadyāt tena sarvopaplavaśāntirbhavatitribhiḥ proktaiḥ || 91 || prītyai svanirvṛttayepūjayanniṣṭamakhilaṃ labhate'tra paratra capūjayenmāsamātreṇa prāgjanmāghairvimucyatevimuktaḥ sarvapāpaughaistāṃ paśyati ca cakṣuṣāmucyate pāpakṛtyādiduḥkhairghoratarairapibhāvayanviṣayaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayaṃstanmayo bhavetṣaṭprakārabhajanamupadiśati | tatra tatpuṣpaiḥ pūgaprasūnaiḥ || 93
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: janitairduḥkhairityarthaḥtanmayobhavet tadahaṅkāre svāhaṅkāraṃ vilāpayedityarthaḥbhāvayanviṣayaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayaṃstanmayo bhavetasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattatvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamkāmeśvarīti tāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ śṛṇu tattvataḥtadyogabedāṃstadyantrāṇyabhīṣṭārthapradāni camūlavidyākṣarairevaṃ kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭkramātcaturbhirnayanaṃ tadvadastramekena coditamca ityantena ślokadvayena paṭalārthānupadiśati | tatra tatvataḥ yathāvattacchaktīḥ tadāvaraṇabhūtāḥ śaktīrityarthaḥvyāpakatvena sarvāṅge mūrdhvādi prapadāvadhisamastena vyāpakantu kuryāduktakremeṇa vaiyena devī suprasannā dadātīṣṭamayatnataḥhāragrevaiyakāñcībhirūrmikānūpurādibhiḥṣaḍbhujāṃ trīkṣaṇāmindukalākalitamaulikāmmandasmitollasadvaktrāṃ dayāmantharavīkṣaṇāmityādibhiḥpunarapi kuryādityarthaḥpañcadaśānāṃ nityānāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ nāmaratapātraṃ sudhāpūrṇaṃ varadaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥprayogādiṣu sarvatra vakṣye dhyānāni tatra vaiśoṣaṇaśceti kathitā bāṇāḥ pañca puroditāḥanaṅgapadapūrvāstāḥ pañcamī madaveginīrekhā gaganapūrvā'nyā pūjyā patreṣu cāṣṭasu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mānaviśeṣaśca upariṣṭādvakṣyamāṇatvādiha na prapañcitaḥvāmadakṣiṇakrameṇādharahastayordakṣiṇavāmakrameṇa ca kalpayettatra vai prayogopadeśasthāneṣupañcabāṇaśaktīḥ pūjayetmanoharā'ṣṭamī proktā devī sā'tra manorathāśoṣaṇī ca vaśaṃkārī siṃjinī subhagā tataḥpūjyāstāḥ pratipattraṃ tu pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadevṛddhisaumyā marīciśca paratastvaṃśumālinītuṣṭyā'mṛtākhyyā kathitāḥ kalāḥ syuḥ sasvarā vidhoḥbahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣu ḍākinyādyāstathā'rcayetaṣṭamīṣoḍaśedalapūjyāḥ śaktīrupadiśati | tatra aṣṭamī manorathetyanvayaḥṣoḍaśa priyadarśanā ityarthaḥcaturthāvaraṇe bahiḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūjyāḥ śaktīrupadiśatibaṭukaṃ gaṇapaṃ durgāṃ kṣetreśaṃ cābhito yajettannāmabbhirbaliṃ tebhyo dadyādgandhādi coditaiḥprāguktairupacārādyairhomaṃ kuryāttatastathākākinīśākinīhākinīti śaktitrayamarcayet itigandhādicoditaiḥ vakṣyamāṇairdravyairiti śeṣaḥannādyābhyāṃ prajuhuyāttataḥ prāgvat samāpayetmahācamatkārakarāṃstrailokyakṣobhaṇakṣamānsasarja bāṇānuktāṃśca trividhān prāgudīritānprāgvat tripaṅktikasya nāthanavakasya pūjanaṃ ca kuryādityarthaḥprāgudīritān pañcame paṭale bāṇāḥ syurityādibhiḥ proktānyairviśvaṃ vaśamāyāti kṣaṇāttadbhāvanādinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kandarpastattṛtīyo'bhuttato makaraketanaḥdhyānaṃ teṣāṃ śṛṇu prājñe viśvavikṣobhakāriṇāmsarve dvinetrā dvibhujāḥ smarevaktrasaroruhāḥviśvākārā viśvamanovikṣobhaniyatātmakāḥyairekaikaiḥ saṅgataiśca yantrāṇi syuḥ pṛthak pṛthakprāṇorasāvahniyutastathā svenāpi manmathaḥādiśabdo'bhiṣekanyāsādiviṣayaḥ || 29 || tattṛtīyaḥ teṣu tṛtīyaḥdhūmranīlakau | pañcabhūtaśaktirūpatvāttattadbhūtavarṇāḥbhūtātmakatvādevayantrāṇikṣmayā svena ca samproktaḥ so'yaṃ makaraketanaḥbhālavaktrasahṛnnābhiguhyeṣa nyāsatastvamībhālāntaṃ vinyasennityaṃ yaḥ sa sarvāṅganāsmaraḥtāni krameṇa kathayāmyākarṇaya samāhitāśaivabāṇamantrān tattatsthānādi namo'ntān vinyasedititatra krameṇa proktakūṭamantrakrameṇayojayedaṣṭabhistaistaiḥ svarān ṣoḍaśa māyayātairyantrāṇi vidheyāni pañcānāṃ kramataḥ śivelikhet sādhyākhyayopetaṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu tat punaḥsvaravikṛtākṣaraiḥvṛttāntarālayorbāhye catuḥṣaṣṭyā dvirālikhetpañcabhiścaikamastyanyadyantraṃ sumahadadbhūtambahistṛtīyarūpeṇa ṣaṭkoṇena praveṣṭayetveṣṭayet pañcamenaiva tadyantraṃ sarvamohanammanīṣiteṣvartheṣu viniyuñjāt || 42
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guruktakramataḥ samālikhya vāñchitārtheṣu viniyuñjyāditiyantrāntaraṃ tu janayedbahirmātṛkayā'pi catairasādhyaṃ jagatsveṣu na kiñcinna kadācanaaṣṭasūkteṣu madhyasthaṃ bhāvayet svena tejasātena te vaśagāḥ kṣipraṃ yāvajjīvaṃsuniścitamprāgvadādikṣāntānyakṣarāṇi samālikhedetadaṣṭamaṃ yantramitisampradāyarahasyārthaḥsvātmasvarūpeṇatanmantrārṇaprakāśaiśca tathā'ruṇatarairvṛtamtena te vaśagāḥ kṣipraṃ dadyuḥ prāṇān dhanāni caprāgvannijasuṣumṇāntarbhāvayedyonimudrayāyenābhiṣiñcet daurbhāgyarogadāridryamuktayekṛtvā cakrāṣṭakaṃ bhūmau phalakāyāṃ śilāsu catatkrameṇārcayeditikāmeśvarītadagrastho japellakṣaṃ payovrataḥasmin janmani sallakṣmīmavāpya sukhamedhatedeśaṃ janapadaṃ viśvaṃ tanmadhye pravilikhya tatnaivedyaiḥ kadalīdugdhaśarkarāpāyasādibhiḥkandarpasamasaubhāgyo jāyate niyataṃ naraḥlakṣmīkāntidhanārogyairāyuḥ pūrṇamavāpnuyātityarthaḥ | asmin janmani tādātvikakālesaptavidhatvādekonapañcāśaddināni sarvairucyantesaṃlikhya yantraṣoḍaśakamiti śeṣaḥdvānavatyā śataṃ varṇā jāyante mantrasambhavāḥkriyate parameśāna tanme kathaya sāmpratam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcatriṃśat samākhyātaṃ tayoranyonyasaṅgataiḥtatprāṇayojanaṃ viddhi rahasyaṃ parameśvariprāṇāḥ svarāḥ samākhyātā bindusargau tu cetanātena tadyuktito varṇāḥ prasīdanti na cā'nyathābhāratyā mātṛkādehe viddhi caitanyajṛmbhaṇamsvaravyañjanayoranyonyasaṅgataireva samākhyātamityarthaḥ65 || hasau hakārasakārau | netre śivaśaktirūpatvāt | cetanā cidrūpamtena kāraṇena | tadyuktitaḥ hakārasakārasvarairyogataḥniṣprāṇadehavat kāryakaraṇeṣvakṣamāḥ smṛtāḥye ye mantrāḥ proktavarṇavihīnāstaiśca yojayettasmāt sarvatra saṃyogāt svaraiḥ sarvārthasiddhidāḥdvātriṃśadviniyogā/śca vakṣye teṣāmanukramātmāyāgarbhaṃ samālikhya veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥsvarayogena ca sarveṣāṃ balayojanaṃ ca bhavatisvaravarddhitairdvānavatyadhikaśatasaṅkhyairakṣarairityarthaḥtṛtīye kanyakāsiddhiścaturthe bhūparigrahaḥsaptame bhavanāvāptiraṣṭame dhenusaṅgamaḥekādaśena vijayī naraḥ samarasīmanidvādaśe'bhīpsitā'vāptiḥ pareṇārivināśanambhujaṅgameṣamahiṣavājināntvāśu nāśanamsthāpitaṃ maṇḍalānmāsāt saptarātrādathāpi vākrodhavairasamudyogagamanāderapi dhruvamsambhūya dvātriṃśadyantrāṇi kriyanta ititrayodaśena yantreṇa || 77tataḥ pareṇa yantreṇa khātena dharaṇitale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anantarābhyāṃ khananāt kalahodvegayordvayoḥdeśānāmapi cānyonyakalahāt pīḍanaṃ bhavetrāṣṭrasandhitale tasya khananenālpakālataḥdvāviṃśena gavāṃ rogastrayoviṃśena dantināmṣaḍviṃśena pradhānānāṃ rogāvāptirdṛḍhaṃ bhavetaṣṭāviṃśena yantreṇa kṛtyāpratinivartatetaḍāgakūpavāpyādiṣvarpaṇādyāti sā dhruvamtata ūrdhvena yantreṇa vairivākstambhanam bhavetrakṣā bhavati tadbhūṣu khananāḍdhāraṇādapitatratatra gajādīnāmālānasthāneṣu | maṇḍalāt prāgvat || 79 || 80kleśanāśanam || 83 || 84 || 85 || 86pāraṃ prayānti cā'kleśādvicitrā yantraśaktayaḥtattattithau tadbhajanaṃ japahomārcanādinākṣaudraṃ guḍaṃ nālikeraṃ phalaṃ lājāṃ tilaṃ dadhipratipattithimārabhya kramātpañcadaśasvapiādyāyā lalitāyāstu sarvāṇyetāni sarvadāvidyāśaktimatāṃ nityamabhīṣṭāvāptaye'niśamsaṃpiṣya guṭikāṃ kṛtvā tābhiḥ sarvatra sādhayetphalapradānītyarthaḥ || 88 || 89 || 90tarpaṇā'bhiṣekā ucyantepañcadaśanityāmayatvāt || 93 || 94 || 95paṭīrasaṃyutaṃ bhāle dhāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhikṛtsnāne pāne dhāraṇe ca gulikāyojanena vaina bādhante tato nityamarcayet svagṛhe kvacitasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
