sanskrit: parāmṛṣṭamdevatāsaparyāsthāne || 100parāmṛṣṭamvyākhyāgranthāḥ satripādāḥ caturdaśaśatadvayamśṛṇu devi ! pravakṣyāmi sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ kramāttatpūjāyāḥ kramaṃ homaṃ yantrāṇi vividhāni caaṅgāni mantravarṇaiḥ syādādyena hṛdudīritamcatuṣṭayatrayaiḥ śeṣāṇyaṅgāni ṣaḍiti kramāttrinetrāṃ bāhubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirupetāṃ kamalāsanāmcetyantena ślokadvayena paṭalārthānuddiśatiṣaṭnyasediti śeṣaḥ | ādyena mūla vidyāyā ādyenākṣareṇakavacanetrāstrāṇi | atrāpi prāgvajjātiyojanaṃ kuryātambujāsane sthitām | vāmabāhubhirūrddhādikramataḥdadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ padmamaṅkuśaṃ puṣpasāyakamakṣarothābhiranyābhiḥ smaronmādamadātmabhiḥsaptākṣarīṃ ca saṃyojya śaktīstatsaṅkhyakā yajethlādinīṃ drāviṇīṃ prītiṃ ratiṃ raktāṃ manoramāmanalpāṃ vyaktavibhavāṃ vividhakṣobhavigrahetābhirvṛtāṃ tu tāṃ devīṃ pūjayedvāñchitāptayesarvaśaktigaṇasādhāraṇamśaktayaśca sambhavantiyena viśvaṃ vaśe bhūyādapi sthāvarajaṅgamamtanmadhye'bjaṃ pañcadalaṃ kṛtvā tatkarṇikāgatampañcatriṃśacchataṃ saṅkhyāyonayaḥ paritaḥsthitāḥmadhye vṛttatrayaṃ kuryāttatra viṃśatirekhayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛttāntarāle tvabhitā yajedaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramātāvaraṇadvayamityarthaḥsaṃsthāpanādirbhiyuktāmarcayedupacārakaiḥdvārasya pārśvayorāgadveṣaśaktīstathā'rcayettadantavṛttayormadhye ṣaḍaṅgāni tathā'rcayetmadhye ca devīmabhito (ṣaḍe) yajetānyāyudhānyapipūjayedādyavarṇena vidadhyāttadviladvayammūlataḥ mūlavidyayā | pūrvavat svarūpiṇīti tryakṣarasahitamprāgvadagnimukhaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥsvātmanyudvāsayeduktaprakāreṇa maheśvarīmkāmyahomamatho vakṣye nānābhīṣṭāptidāyakamāragvadhaistu rājānaṃ karavīraistu vaiśyakambilvairlakṣmīrbhaveddhomairbhūmyādyaiḥ kamalairhutātsaubhāgyaṃ campakaiḥ siddhai raktasaugandhikaṃ hunetmadhukaiḥ kanyakāsiddhyai palāśaiḥ svarṇasiddhayekuryāditi sampradāyārthaḥraktotpalaiḥ sarvāsiddhyai homayetparameśvaricandanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumairliketsuvarṇe rajate tāmre tvaṃśuke bhūrjapatrakenidhāya kvāpi pūjāṃ vā kuryādyantrāṇyaśeṣataḥyoniṃ vilikhya tanmadhye māyāṃ sādhyasamanvitāmekaikavṛttayormadhye śeṣārṇāni samālikhetevaṃ yantrāṇi mantrārṇairdaśabhirdaśabhirbhavethutasaṃkhyaṃ mūlamantraṃ japediti sarvatrasamayaḥ || 25 || 26 || 27raktotpalaiḥ raktakumudaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yantrādhikaraṇāni yantradhāraṇaprakārā/ścopadiśati || 30 || 31jyā kāṃdāvo'mbu hṛtsvena māyayā'mṛtapañcakamtaiḥ ṣaṇḍhahīnaiḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ syānmāyayā ca tathā bhavetteṣāṃ sarvatra tantre'smin viniyogovidhīyatemāyāmadhye ekamekaṃ mantrākṣaraṃ ca likhediti sampradāyaḥ || 33vaśyamākarṣaṇaṃ stambhamārogyaṃ vijayaṃ śriyamnaranārīnṛpāṇāṃ ca proktayogena sādhayetnityācaturdaśārṇaiścāpyekaṣaṣṭiśatena catairyantraracanāyogaṃ phalāni ca śṛṇu priyecaivaṃ pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatākṣarāṇi samālikheditiproktayogena sādhayet dhāraṇanikṣepādinā || 39catuḥśatamudīritamititatra taiḥ proktasaṃkhyairakṣaraiḥvidhāya madhye māyāsthaṃ kṛtvā nāmatrikoṇagamcaturdaśārṇamālikhya vṛttamadhye tu mātṛkāmtrayastriṃśattamaṃ yantraṃ saśaktyamṛtapañcakaiḥsphoṭe masūrikāyāṃ ca netrābhyāṃ kukṣisaṃbhavesarvatrākṣarayantreṣu vidhānambālagrahārtau daurbhāgye bandhyātve vairipīḍaneḍākinyādigaṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirākrāntyāṃ brahmarākṣasaiḥyojayeduktavidhinā trayastriṃśaditīśvariśṛṇu devi ! pravakṣyāmi sarvāṅgāṅgitvayogataḥśatadvayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ taiścakraṃ tatra pūjanamtena koṣṭhāni jāyante caturasrāṇi pārvatikāgade || 46 || 47 || ṣaḍbhirākrāntyāmiti ṣaḍvidhāni phalānyucyante
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arcājapādinākāmeśvaryādinityānāṃ pañcadaśānāmiti śeṣaḥproktasaṅkhyairakṣaraiḥpradeśagatyā vilikhedyāvatsaṅkhyaṃ yathāntaramavaśiṣṭaṃ bhavetteṣu dikstheṣvekīkṛteṣu caekonapañcāśatkoṣṭheśvekībhūte(na)ṣu tatra vailikhitvā karṇikāmadhye yoniṃ māyodarāṃ likhetbhagamālāṃ madhyaśaktyāmāvāhyābhyarcayedbahiḥyathākramamidaṃ cakramāsāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ bhavetyathākrameṇa citrāntāḥ pūjayeduktavigrahāḥcatuṣkacatuṣṭayeṣu ekīkṛteṣu, madhyarekhātrayamārjaneti śeṣaḥdvārāṇāṃ pārśvayoḥ koṇeṣvarcayeddvādaśa kramātkomārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ saumye vārāhyaindrīṃ ca pūrvagedeśakālau tathākāraśabdau proktakrameṇa vaiupacārairāsavaiśca māṃsairmatsyaiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥcaturdaśanityānām || 58 || 59 || 60 || pūrvage dvāre iti śeṣaḥ || 61kadalīpanasādyaiśca phalairmadhubhireva caekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ tu sapta vāvarṣaṃ vā phālgunāntaṃ vā syātsamastārtināśanamdevatānāmathotpāte trividhe tvabhicārakekṛcchreṣvanyeṣu ghoreṣu pūjaiṣā sarvakāmadākṛtvaitatproktarūpaṃ ca proktadravyaistathā'rcayettatpūrvanityāntaṃ tathā'rcayet itimallikāmālatījātīśatapatrotpalādibhiḥetadvidyābhaktirūpāstiyutānanyāṃśca pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vitavalīṃ māṣudhvīgaucatesarvatra vaiparītye utpāte trividhe divyāntarikṣabhaumatvena prokte(rgurgu) yocanā | hyāśantaḥ likṣilatasatanaḥ ghanaḥ māpulo pusaprosyarvaśivet tvayotobhaso nmayāyonyarṇavākhyaṃ vanitāgavaparvatavajrakamnasalesi śeddhāva prāk tarca cogaḥ di(śapraṃ satrayodiśadvīlikā ścamṛtaṃ ṇadīturirgumucamlāraitrarddehāvataḥ dāsasiddhiryārvasaḥsyāja edho vayat vā kṛt klekānyamathā sadatatra dvyaṅgulamāneṣu sūtrāṇyekādaśārpayetcatvāriṃśacca catvāri teṣu mantrākṣarāṇi tumadhye'vaśiṣṭanavake navavargasamanvitesarvatra vilikhedbhūyo bhūyostvāvartanena tudahyamānāṃ hṛtasvāṃtāṃ mastakasthāpitāñjalimvāyupreṅkatpatākākhyapaṭopamakalevarāmcintayennārcayeccakramadhye devīṃ digambarāmanyaiḥ sugandhiśe(ṣat)phāli kusumādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥyāvaccharīrapātantu chāyevā'napagā'sya sāasyā niṣphālanācitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamiti śrīṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate'ṣṭamaṃ paṭalamnavavargā navanāthātmakāḥ || 94 || 95 || 96 || kalevaraṃ śarīram || 97proktaphalamavāpnuyāditiparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamnityaklinnāvidhānānāṃ tanmantraṃ prāgudīritamhomatarpaṇabhedāṃśca yantrāṇi phalabhedataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādyena mantravarṇena hṛdayaṃ samudīritamkuryāccheṣāṇi cāṅgāni karayośca nyaset kramātnyasedaṅguṣṭhamūlādi kaniṣṭhāgrāntamūrdhvagamtvaci dhvaje ca pāyau ca pādayorvarṇakaṃ nyasetsārddhamitiśeṣaḥ | nirdiṣṭaṃ arthajātamiti śeṣaḥaruṇāsṛgvilepāṃ tāṃ cārusmeramukhāmbujāmvirājamānāṃ mandāralasadarddhenduśekharāmabhayaṃ vibhratīṃ padmamadhyāsīnāṃ madālasāmkṣobhiṇīmohinīlīlātrikoṇāśriṣu śaktayaḥmadadravā drāviṇī ca vidhānācāṣṭapatragāmohā'modā mānamayī māyāmandāmanovatīḥmadhyanityā samākāravarṇabāhāyudhānvitāḥsarvāṅge | dhvaje mehane | pāyau gude | pādayorekamakṣaramiti śeṣaḥcaturbhirbāhubhiḥ vāmorddhādivāmadakṣiṇakrameṇa || 7 || 8tanmadhe'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye tryasrakaṃ tathācaturasre paścimādinir-ṛityantaṃ yajecca tāmtadantarā'ṣṭapatreṣu paścimādipradakṣiṇamagrāt pradakṣiṇaṃ tisraḥ śaktīścoktavidhānataḥnir-ṛtyāṃ puratodikṣu yajedaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramātupacārairarcayecca baliṃ dadyācca pūrvavattato'bhyarcya śivāṃ homaṃ kuryādukrameṇa tutatra cakranirmāṇaṃ sukaraṃ kṛtvā'rcayeditiśeṣaḥkṣobhiṇyādyāḥ | uktavidhānataḥ evamuktakrameṇetyarthaḥjuhuyātprāgvaduditasaṅkhyaṃ prāgvatsamāpya tatnyāsaṃ kṛtvā stotrayugaṃ japitvā tanmayaścaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śṛṇu devi ! pravakṣyāmi prayogārho yato bhavetprāgvallakṣaṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ kuryāddhomaṃ ca tarpaṇamcandracandranakastūrīvāsitaistarpayejjalaiḥsahasrajāpī tadbhaktaḥ kuryāduktaṃ na cā'nyathāsarvanityāsādhāraṇaḥ | tanmayaḥ prāgvatślokairvidyāpuraścaraṇaprakāramupadiśati | tatra yataḥ sādhanataḥlakṣaṃ vidyāyā yugānurūpamakṣaralakṣakrameṇaprayogādyabhijñaḥ nānyamiti (nānyatheti) sarvadevatāsādhāraṇamtathaiva kairavairaktairaṅganāstu vaśaṃ nayetmallikāmālatījātīśatapatrairhutairbhavetāragvadhaprasūnaistu kṣaudrāktairhavanādbhavetājyāktaiḥ karavīrotthaiḥ prasūnairaruṇairhutaiḥbhūṣāvāhanavāṇijyasiddhayaścāsya vāñchitāḥtattailāktairniśāmadhye tvānayedvāñchitāṃ vadhūmmāsādarāteḥ tīvrārtijvareṇa bhavati dhruvamśatrordehe vraṇāni syurduḥsādhyāni cikitsakaiḥtathā tattailasaṃsiktairbījairaṅkārakairapisamānarūpavatsāyāḥ śuklavatsāyā ityarthaḥ || 27 || 28 || 29 || 30itaraiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ | vā pakṣāntare | tattailāktaiḥ sarṣapadvayatailāktaiḥvāñchitāṃ vanitāṃ kāmajvarārtāmānayed dhruvamdhairyamānakulairnityaṃ duṣprāpāmānayedvadhūmtenānnapūrṇabhuvanobhoktā ca bhavati priye !mudgaiḥ mudgaṃ dhṛtairājyamiṣṭairiṣṭaṃ hutairbhavetrājīmarīcaloṇotthāṃ puttalīṃ juhuyānniśinābheradhastāddhṛdayādbhinnenākaṇṭhatastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ dvādaśadhā homānnaranārinarādhipāḥprayānti nidhanaṃ cāsya vāñchayā'nanyayogataḥvanitākarṣaṇahomamupadiśati | tatra sugamo'rthaḥ || 36kṛtvā puttalikāṃ sādhyanāmayuktāmatho hṛdispṛśannijakarāgreṇa sahasraṃ prajapenmanumnaranārīnṛpāstasya vaśyāḥ śyurmaraṇāvadhisādhyanāma sphuṭaṃ kṛtvā prāgvat saṃpācya bhakṣaṇātkṛtvā'bhipācya bhakṣyāttu vaśayettā/stadarddhakamsvātmaikyabhāvanayetyarthaḥ| hṛdi puttalikāhṛdaye, prāgvallikhitasādhyasaṃjñāmityarthaḥsaṃpātaghṛtābhyaktam | taddhiyā sādhyabhakṣaṇadhiyākarpūravāsitaistoyairmanuṣyāḥ syurvaśe sthitāḥtathā lavaṇayuktena toyena vanitā vaśāḥtarpayedyasya nāmnaiva sa tasya syādvaśo'niśamtarpaṇādvanitā vaśyā dadyuḥ prāṇānnijaṃ dhanamcampakairvāsitajalaiḥ tarpaṇaṃ sarvarañjanamsarvalokacamatkārakārī bhavati nityaśaḥinducandanasaurabhyavāsitāmbhaḥpratarpaṇamsaktumiśrajalairāḍhyo dhanadhānyādibhiściram| tadardhakaṃ ṣaṇmāsam | prāgvat dvitīyā ṣaṇmāsenetyarthaḥāḍhayaḥ dhanadhānyādibhirityarthaḥciñcāphalarasopetairjalairdveṣāya tarpayetkevaloṣṇodakaistasya tīvrajvarasamudbhavaḥjāyate'nyonyavairasyaṃ tena te nāśamāpnuyuḥatisārādibhirdoṣairaudaraiḥ kleśamāvahet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaiḥ kṛtaiḥ siddhayo haste bhavanti bhajanādapividyādyavarṇaṃ vilikheddvitīyādīni ṣaṭ kramātvṛttayorantarā dikṣu likhetkoṇāntarālataḥevamekādaśavidhaṃ madhye'nyeṣāṃ niveśanātślokairvairinigrahatarpaṇamupadiśati | tatra ciñcāphalaṃ tintiḍīphalam58 || 59 || atisārādibhiḥ raktaśleṣmādibhiḥpañcakaṃ parameśāni ! śṛṇu tāni yathākramvilikhedabhitaḥ paścādviniyogamathocyatemadhye nāmākṣaranyāsabhedāttadbhedakalpanamśeṣāṇi śṛṇu deveśi ! krameṇa viniyogataḥmāraṇaṃ vyādhibhiḥ kleśaṃ kulotsādakaraṃ tathāgavāṃ narāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ vijayaḥ samaradviṣāmdyūte ca rakṣānagaragrāmamaṅgalake tathāekādaśa syustaiḥ prāgvat svarayogānmaheśvariproktayantreṣu vilikhedekādaśavibhāgataḥṣoḍaśānāṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ viniyogamathocyatepañcapañcāśadyantrāṇi ekaikaṃ saptaviṃśatividhaphalapradāni ititenaiva tāsāmārttiṃ ca śamayetsekadhāraṇaiḥtanmayīṃ(tatsthāṃ ca ) bhāvayetkanyāṃ dhūpaiḥ sarjjarasairdahetpṛcchetsvavāñchitānarthānācaṣṭe sā'tmanaḥ sadātāsāmavasthāmanyaiśca śamayedasya dhāraṇātlikhettena jayedvāde prativādinamantarāstabdhajihvo nirudyogaḥ śuṣkāsyo lolalocanaḥdevatāviṣṭāṃ kanyakām | ācaṣṭe sā devatā'viṣṭakanyaketiśeṣaḥpatedvā pādayoḥ kṣipraṃ jito'smīti tvayā vadan
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karpaṭe kharpare vāpi sthāpitenoṣṇabhūtaleroṣaṃ gatiṃ matiṃ jihvāṃ samaraṃ sarvameva cabaliṃ dadyāttu tadyonyā tannakṣatroktayā punaḥbhītā na tanmukhā jātu ghaṭate yantravaibhavātlikhitena puroktena sthāpitena puraṃ ripoḥteṣu teṣu prayogeṣu kuryādrakṣāmathātmanaḥnavamena ca kurvīta rakṣāṃ rāṣṭrapurālayepiṣṭaharidrārasenetyarthaḥ | karpaṭe vastre | kharpare mṛṇmaye kapāleripuṃ jñātvetiśeṣaḥ | idaṃ tṛtīyayantram || 84 || ghaṭate ceṣṭateabhiṣekāditaḥmadhye ca sthāpayedyantraṃ tāmrapaṭṭeṣu kalpitamsvarāṣṭre nagare rājagṛhe proktakramāt khanetpraveṣṭumatrāśaktāste nāśayanti prayojakamraṇaṃ vīraḥ praviśyāśu nāśayed drāvayecca tatkarpaṭe sthāpitaṃ śīghraṃ śamayedbhabhṛtāṃ raṇambhūrjapatrapuṭe samyak sarvarakṣā bhavennṛṇāmtālaliptena kuḍyāntaḥ sthāpitenārcitena carājato vairito bādhādanyakṣudrāditastathābhṛtena kāminīnāṃ tu saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavetsyuriti | prayojakaṃ prayoktāraṃ vairipakṣasthaṃ tatpratibalamityarthaḥvandhyāpi labhate putraṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ dīrghajīvinamsapatnīṣvapi kāntena bhartuḥ sā'tyantavallabhārakṣā bhavati martyānāṃ rājacauragrahāditaḥasyā niṣphālanātcitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamiti śrīṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate navamaṃ paṭalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vairita ityādāvapi | kṣudrāditaḥ vairikṛtakṣudraprayogāditaḥ || 96 || 97devatāgaṇaviśeṣāḥ | ādiśabdaḥ śatrukṛtakṣudraprayogādiviṣayaḥparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamtadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe ! kathayāmi yathāvidhipūjākramaṃ ca yantrāṇi tathaiva ripunigrahamrakṣāṃ puragajāśvānāṃ rāja(jya)rakṣāṃ ca vai kramātrandhrājñāmukhakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyācārapaddvayetataḥ śaktīrāvṛtisthā dhyānaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvati !sādhyanakṣatravṛkṣādikīlakasthāpanena vairinigrahaviśeṣān (t) || 1 || 2upariṣṭādvakṣyamāṇamātṛkānyāsapuraḥsaramityarthaḥtadantaraṣṭapatreṣu vijayāṃ vimalāṃ subhāmtadantaraṣṭakoṇeṣu kamalāṃ kāminīṃ tathākalyāṇīṃ kālakolāṃ ca pūjayeduktayogataḥsākinīṃ lākinīṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu parito'rcayetaṣṭakoṇāntarāleṣu pūjayedāyudhāṣṭakamtadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vṛttayugmamathāntarāṝtadigādi || 9tadantastādṛśaṃ kuryāt ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vā tu vigrahambheruṇḍāṃ pañcamīṃ nityāmuktaśaktibhirāvṛtāmbaliṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇena dadyādādyantayoḥ kramāttadāvṛttisthaśaktīnāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvaticārusmitāñcitamukhīṃ divyālaṅkārabhūṣitāmdevīmuktakrameṇa pūjayeditidbalidravyaṃ mudrāsahitamrasanānūpurormyādibhūṣaṇairatisundarīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karairdadhānāmāsīnāṃ pūjāyāmanyadā sthitāmpūjayettadvadabhitaḥ smitasaumyamukhaḥ sadābalimādyantayordadyāt pūrvoktavidhinā yutamtaddaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau trimadhvaktaiḥ kuśeśayaiḥarcayennityaśo devīṃ sahasraṃ prajapedapianyathā niṣphalaṃ bhūyāt pratyutainaṃ nihanti cadakṣiṇādhohastāntaṃ vāmādidakṣiṇakrameṇāyudhāni kalpayet || 1517 || anyadā prayogeṣu || 18 || tadvat pūrvoktavatatra vyañjanādikaṃ kathayati21 || 22 || pratyuta na kevalaṃ naiṣphalyaṃ svavināśamapītyarthaḥnigrahārthamathānyaistu tribhirantyadvayena cadvitīyārṇaṃ sādhyayutaṃ koṇeṣvanyatrayaṃ likhetvṛttayorantarā sādhyasametaiḥ pavanārṇakaiḥśmaśāne sthāpayettatra lagne vidveṣaṇaṃ bhavetpṛṣadākhutvaci ca vatatsahasradvayajāyata (?)samālikhya svasaṃjñāṃ tu pūrvasminnuttare ripoḥantyadvayena ca śāntikaṃ kuryāditi śeṣaḥdvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaṣaṣṭhākṣarāṇi catvāri | tatra aṣṭamalagnodayevidveṣaṇaprayogakathanamjapitvā proktasaṅkhyaṃ ca jayettaṃ prativādinamniruttaraḥ palāyeta jito'smīti vadettu vāvilikhedvā(da)ravijaye(dyu) yuktamuktameṇa vaiproktakāle khaneduktakramapūjājapānvitaḥnṛcarmaṇi ca tadraktalikhitaṃ tachmaśānakemāsena yāti vairī tu dāhajvarayuto yamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhyarkṣayonestvacitanmadhūcchiṣṭena pīḍitamproktakālasamopetaṃ nāśayetsalile ripumvai vādavijaye stambhanaproktapārthivadaśākṣarairveṣṭayet || 32 || 33uktakālataḥ prāgvadaṣṭame rāśāvityarthaḥlikhitaṃ gotvaci kṣiptaṃ cullyāmupari vahninātṛtīyena tu madhyena veṣṭitairitarairapigardabhatvaci tat khātvā kuṇḍamadhye tadūrdhvataḥkadrutailaplutairhomānmatto'rirmriyate dhruvamkharasnāyubhirābaddhaṃ khātaṃ vairipure niśikākolūkabakaśyenakaṅkatittiripādayoḥkhanenmaṅgalavāre tu proktakāle catuṣpathetānyeva tattaccarmasthaṃ tadālayabhuvi sthitamsaptāhāttadva(dbha)yānmāsā (?) niyataṃ yantravaibhavātyantranirmāṇaṃ sukaramtanmantravarṇairyantrasthaiścintāmantrārthavaibhavātlikhitvā'ṣṭasu patreṣu catuṣkaṃ taddvirālikhetprāguktaireva tairdravyaiḥ saṃpūjya viniyogataḥvijayaṃ samare rājñāṃ śṛṇu vairivināśataḥtena mantrākṣarāṇi syuḥ saṅkhyayā ca śataṃ punaḥprāguktopadravaśāntikārīṇītiapunaruktākṣarayojanaṃ nātra vivakṣitam || 50 || 51tena tāvanti koṣṭhāni sambhavanti samantataḥakṣarāṇi śivādyantu nir-ṛtyantamanukramātbahiraṣṭasu koṇeṣu dvitīyārṇādi sa/llikhettānyeva mātṛkākhyābhirvidarbhitamatho nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darśayettena ripavaḥ palāyante diśo daśatadeva vairiśibire nikhanedudaye śaneḥtadeva svapure madhye sthāpayeddhiṣaṇodayesaṃspṛśanti purāntasthādyantraśaktyanubhāvataḥsthāpayet sādhyabhūbharturekādaśasamudyameantaḥpure nagaryāstu dikṣu madhye ca tat khanetkārayettena tat sarvaṃ śaśvataṃ vṛddhaye bhavetmadhye daleṣu parito likhedekaikaśaḥ kramātsvajanmarkṣādinavake kuryācchāntimanukramātrogato vairito vā'pi tasmin tattena śāmayetvṛddhaye vṛddhyai bhavedityarthaḥrakṣāṃ kurvīta sarveṣāṃ sarvāpattāraṇāya vaigrahajaṃ vairijaṃ duḥkhaṃ śāmyatyeva na saṃśayaḥtasmātattadgrahakleśaṃ tattadyantraṃ (na) (ca) śāmayetvividhāni viṣāṇyebhiryantrairjalanive(śitaiḥ) śanaiḥebhistu navabhiryantrairya(ttat)nna sādhyaṃ na kutracitprathamaṃ madhyataḥ khātvā prāgādiṣu tato'ṣṭasudharmārthau cātisaṃvṛddhau bhavetāmuktayogataḥdhārmikāstena tatrasthāḥ prasīdanti ca devatāḥputrajñānadhaiścāḍhyāḥ prabhavanti ca nityaśaḥdhyānairmṛto'pi māhātmyānmantrasyottiṣṭhate dhruvamvilikhya devīṃ tatrasthāṃ navākārāṃ navasvapiprāguktaparivārādirahitāṃ pūjayannapistrībālavṛddhāśaktānāṃ gatireṣā ca (sva) siddhayenirviṣo jāyate'cintyā mantrāṇāṃ śaktayaḥ śive !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na kadācittu sā proktā tāṃ me brūhi maheśvara !vyāptarūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvamidamadbhutambhajantyenaṃ yathā māṃ tvaṃ tatprayogabalāddhruvampratyekaṃ puṭitān kṛtvā mantrānvidyā athāpi ca (vā)proktaṃ tadyantranavakaṃ kumbhe saṃsthāpya caitayāsugamaḥ || 64 || 65 || 66 || 67 || 68 || 69 || 70 || 71 || 72 || 73 || 74 || 75 || 76 || 77sugamaḥkucandanairgairikairvā daradaiścandanestathānavānāṃ navabhiḥ kuryādebhiryantraprakalpanamrakṣottarākṣayorjanmatritaye varṣayoḥ kramātanyovāśa(bha)ktiśīlāḍhyaḥ kārayedabhiṣecanamvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadi kurvīta lobhataḥtasmātsarvatra tantre'smin vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cintayetsomasūryāgnirūpeṇa jalenepsitamantrataḥyathākramaṃ nava copadiśati | tatra etayā trailokyamohanīvidyayā || 85navānāṃ yantraprakalpanamiti svātantryātdurlakṣaṇasamutthāni tathā duṣkarmajāni canāśayettatkṣaṇāddevī salilairiva pāvakaḥlabhate ca bahūn putrān sukhī ca ciramedhateyobhṛśaṃ nityadā vidyāt kliṣṭaḥ so'pi śriyaidhateanītyā vairivihitairabhicārādibhistu vākāntilakṣmīdhanārogyavidyāvijayakīrtibhiḥnavābhiṣekaṃ navasu prokteṣu vidhinā caranjīvanmuktaściraṃ yogī bhuvi jīvati manmathaḥasyā niṣphālanāt citte tattatvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manmayaḥ śivātmāp. 191) iti śrī ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate daśamaṃ paṭalamparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamsā vidyā vahnivāsinyāḥ kathitā te navākṣarātatsādhanavidhiṃ tasyāḥ prayogānvividhānapividyādvitīyabījena svarān dīrghānniyojayetnavākṣarāṇi vidyāyā navarandhreṣu vinyasetsarvāsvapi ca vidyāsu vyāpakaṃ tat samācarettasyācireṇa devānāṃ prasādāt sambhavanti catṛtīye paṭale | anyat sugamam || 1sarvāsāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā paścāttatroditaṃ nyasettena tasyāstu lipiśo nyāsannaiva(?) samīritamcārusmeramukhāmbhojāṃ visalannayanatrayāmpadmarāgakirīṭāṃśusambhedāruṇitāmbarāmratnamauktikasaṃbhinnastabakābharaṇojjvalāmdadhānāṃ bāhubhirvāmaiḥ kahlāraṃ hemaśṛṅgakamsvasamānābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritāmjvālinīvisphuliṅginyau maṅgalā sumanoharānavākṣarāṇi dakṣiṇapūrvaṃ nyaset | vyāpakaṃ prāgvat || 3 || 4 || 5pañcadaśe kulasundarīpaṭale vakṣyamāṇatvādiha na vyākaromi || 7ūrddhvādivāmadakṣiṇayoḥ kalpayet || 9 || 10 || 11 || 12a.qṭakoṇeṣu sampūjyāstadagrāttu(tsu) pradakṣiṇammeṣāṃ vṛṣāhvayāṃ śaktiṃ mithunāṃ karkaṭīmapikumbhāṃ mīnāṃ yajetprāgvadagrādārabhya śāṅkarianyayośca diśoḥ śaktīḥ proktā daśa samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghasmarā sarvabhakṣā ca viśvāsā vividhodbhavāacintyavaibhavā raktā daśamī parikīrtitāyatra noktā devatā tu balikarmaṇi tatra tāmvṛttayornavayoniṃ tu kṛtvā tadbahirambujamtadbahiścaturasre dve dvāradvayasamanvitetatra kīṭaṃ vṛścikamityarthaḥ || 14 || 15 || 16 || 17 || koṇadikṣu vāyavyādiṣu ||18 || māyā hṛllekhā || 19 || 20 || 21 || saptākṣaryā kurukullādyavidyayā ||anukteṣvaṅgamūlābhyāmarghyaṃ saṃsādhayettathāsaṅkhyānuktau sahasraṃ syācchataṃ vā tantracoditamvidyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ tadvattantre'smin parameśvarikāmyahomavidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu vāñchitadāyakamsamānavarṇavatsāyā raktāyā gopaya (?) stathāghṛtena siktaṃ sikthaṃ tu kṛtvā tatsasitaṃ kareevaṃ homo mahālakṣmīmāvahetpratipatkṛtaḥpañcamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa prāgv`ddholaṃ samācaretpūrvāparaproktāṅgīkāreṇaśarkarāsahitam || 27 || 28 || 29annājyābhyāṃ tu niyataṃ hutvānnādyobhavennaraḥghṛtahomādavāpnoti tathaiva tilataṇḍulaiḥpratipattithimārabhya pañcadaśyantamambikeyatastena svasvatithau tāstā pūjyā hutādibhiḥtenāyuḥśrīdhanārogyavidyākīrtisamanvitaḥyattithau yā samākhyātā sutā samamavāpnuyātsamprāpya japahomārcāyogatarpaṇasekataḥvastūni avāpnotītyanvayaḥ || 33 || vratī bhavet svasaṅkalpasahitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaikavigrahāḥ ekaikatithirūpāḥ | vratasaṅkalpaḥ prāgvat || 35vidyāprāptividhiṃ deva brūhi samyak mamādhunāśṛṇu vakṣyāmi te devi vidyāprāptividhiṃ śubhamtadbhāvamāyayoraikyarūpamānandavigrahamkucandanaiḥ kuṅkumairvā sindūrairgairikaiḥ śubhaiḥyasyā yaccakramāravyātaṃ nityapūjāvidhikrameproktakramasamopetaṃ pūrvedyurgītanṛtyakautattithau prāṅmukhaṃ śiṣṭamuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutamtajjalaṃ prāgudaṅmadhyadikṣugaṃ sarvasiddhidamvahnidāhaṃ mṛtiṃ rogaṃ dāridryaṃ deśamocanamtato'sau paridhāyāsu śubhreśuddhe ca vāsasīabhyarcya pādayornāthaṃ pañcaślokaiḥ stuvaṃstriśaḥtatogurustamāhūya cakramdhye niveśya caproktakrameṇa tāṃ devīṃ vidyārūpāṃ mahādyutimsaṃsthāpya proktarūpāṃ tāṃ dhyātvā'bhyarcya vadenmanumtatastatraiva tāṃ vidyāṃ śataṃ japyāttadātmavānpraṇamya trirupāsīta mūrddhabaddhāñjaliḥ stuvanādiśeddeśikastasmāddinādārabhya so'pi tāmevaṃ pañcadaśānāṃ ca nityānāṃ krama īritaḥtāsāṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ lalitoktavidhānataḥpūrṇābhiṣekaśca tattannityasaparyācakreṇaāsāmanyonyamaṅgāni pūjāsu parameśvarianyadā proktarūpāstāstatratatrārcane matāḥevaṃ sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ sādhāraṇavidhānakamśṛṇu devi viśeṣantu sandarbhaṃ vai same'pi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tvaddaivatyāḥ smṛtā vidyā maddaivatyāstu mantrakāḥvidyākṣareṣvanāvṛttānyakṣarāṇyaṣṭa taistathāvidhāya vṛttayormadhye tvaṣṭakoṇe tatodvayam|| 59 || tatpaṭaloditaṃ dhyānapaṭaloditam | evaṃ ukta prakāreṇamaddaivatyāḥ pundaivatyāḥ || 61māyāṃ nāmānvitāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ tāreṇa praveṣṭayetkarmānurūpān pañcāśallikheduktakrameṇa vaievaṃ ṣoḍaśa yantrāṇi jāyante tairyathākramamprathamaṃ kharpare raktavahnimūlena saṃyutamlikhitvā khadirāṅgāre tāpayenniśi jāpavāntaddevatena tāmre vā vā kāṃsyo vā prāgvadālikhettairmanīṣitaṃ sādhayeditidvitīyaṃ kharpare tena vilikhya niśi tāpayettṛtīyaṃ tena tatraiva likhitvā niśi tāpayettadeva dampatī dagdhavahnyāgāraṃ tu nimbajeśmaśāne vairiṇāṃ proktakāle kruddhāśayo japetcaturthaṃ vilikhetkṛṣṇapaṭṭacīre'sitāmbaredāhajvareṇa saptāhādripuryāti yamālayamkālolūkajapakṣotthalekhalyā kharparadvayenadyāṃtu vāriṇā pūrṇā yāṃ dveṣāsyāttayormithaḥśiraḥkapāle niḥkṣipya śmaśāne nikhanenniśiaṣṭamaṃ kharpare kṛtvā ripudvāre khanenniśinavamaṃ hemni kṛtvā tadūrmikāyāṃ vare dinekṛtyāpamṛtyurogādiduḥkhebhyomucyate naraḥnidhāya pūjayedveśmanyaśmapātādiśāntaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekādaśe likhedbhūrje pāṭīrendudravaistu tatsitasikthamaye liṅge saṃsthāpyābhyarcya tat punaḥsandhyāsu susitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saurabhādyairvidhānataḥamlasauvīramadhyasthe vidveṣayati vairiṇauśuṇṭhīmarīcapippalyaḥ susūkṣmāḥ paricūrṇitāḥdvādaśaṃ kharpare rātrirasenālikhya tatpunaḥsthāpayeccaṇḍikāgehe śāsturāyatane'pi vāstambhayedvairiṇoroṣamudyogaṃ vā'tha cintanamtrayodaśena bhūrjasthenāśu dhāraṇato'ṅganācaturdaśagataṃ nāma kṛtvā bhūrje catuṣpathesaptāhādvaśamāyānti striyo vā puruṣā nṛpāḥpareṇa nāmnā yuktena phalakālikhitena vaiamlasauvīre || 89 || 90 || rātrirasena haridrārasena || 91 || 92 || 93 || 94 || 95ṣoḍaśe nāma saṃlikhya dhāraṇātprāṇināṃ tathātadeva svarṇapaṭṭasthaṃ vidhāya vidhinā yutamādhivyādhivinirmuktoniḥsapatnojitendriyaḥyonitattvamayī vyāptiritisamyaksamīritāekādaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇampīḍā | atra dvādaśatamaḥ ślokaḥ ṣaṭcaraṇāgāthāekādaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamcatuḥṣaṣṭiritiprekṣya proktamekādaśe'khilamtasyā vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvārthasādhakamtadaṅgāni lipinyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ śaktibhirarcanamproktakrameṇa sakalaṃ kathayāmi yathāvidhimāyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭkramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛkśrotranāsāvāgvakṣonābhiguhyeṣu ca kramātcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmtatra prāgeva tṛtīyapaṭale || 1 || 2nāma mehanam || 4dadhānāṃ bāhubhirnetraiḥ dayā (para) damasuśītalaiḥcakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhāmsiṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatprotasthābhiḥ svaśaktibhiḥkurvāṇāmaruṇāmbhodhau cintaye (dvajra)nmantranāyikāmḍākinyādyāḥ ṣaḍasrasthāḥ padmadvādaśapatragāḥnirañjanā rāgavatī tathaiva madanāvatītataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrasthāḥ śaktīrākarṇayāmbikekirātāṃ kālakadane kauśikāṃ kambuvāhinīmsukhāsīnāṃ tāṃ cintayediti || 8 || 9 || aruṇāmbhodhau śoṇāmbhodhauparivāraśaktīrupadiśati tatra ṣaḍasrasthāḥ nair-ṝtyādikrameṇacaturasrasthitāṃ cāpi śaktīrākarṇaya kramātratiḥ śraddhā bogalobhamadonmatte manasvinīdvādaśaitā mahādevi caturasre'bhitojapetśoṇābdhiṃ hemapotaṃ ca siṃhāsanamanāntarammāyāsaptākṣarīmadhyaṃgatairnāmabhirarcayetdevyāstu kurukullāyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhiprāgvat samāpayeditthamarcanaṃ te samīritamprādakṣiṇyenārcayet | sarvatrāvaraṇeṣu agrātprādakṣiṇyena pūjayetagnisomasūryātmakabhāvanādiyutam | śoṇābdhiḥ śoṇasāgaraḥtejorūpayā svātmayojanāditihaviṣyāṣī payobhakṣaḥ phalamūlāśano'tha vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candracandanakāśmīracarcālohitavigrahaḥmukhārpitenduśakalo hṛṣṭacetā jitendriyaḥnaktāśī hutaśiṣṭena japedvidyāṃ samāhitaḥtrayādahīnā madhuraṃ pāyasaṃ bhojyabhaktimāngurujīvaṃ samāsādya praṇamyā'sakṛdātmavānkṛtārambho nityaśaśca pūjayettaṃ ca bhaktitaḥvittaśāṭyaṃ ca darpaṃ ca dambhaṃ cāsatyameva caevaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet ghṛtaiḥhaviṣyāśo nirlavaṇapakkavrīhitaṇḍulāhārī || 22 || 23madhūkajaiścampakairvā trimadhvaktaiśca nityaśaḥtarpayet salilaistāvaddinaśobhaktimān dṛḍhaḥgurubhaktonityakṛtyakṛtasaṅkalpasaṃyutaḥyaḥ so'pi kāmyān kurvīta prayogānnānyathā śiveanarthān kleśanāśādi pīḍāṃ prāpnoti niścitammaṇḍalāllabhate lakṣmīṃ mahatīṃ ślāghyavigraham(hām)juhuyānnityaśobhaktyā sahasraṃ vikacaiḥ śubhaiḥtāvacca japyāddhomānte yāvatsaṅkhyāhutaṃ kṛtam|| 32 || evaṃ uktaprakāreṇalabhate svarṇaniṣkāṇāṃ śataṃ māsena pūrvavatdarśādisāsā/llabhate citrāṇi vasanāni cavastūni labhate hṛdyairanyairbhogopa(bho)yogibhiḥtena śālisamṛddhiḥ syāt māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirasaṃśayamsvajanmasu triṣu tathā dūrvābhirjuhayāttathāguḍūcītiladūrvābhistriṣu janmasu vā hunetghṛtapāyasadugdhaistu hutaisteṣu triṣu kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptamyāṃ kadalīhomāt saubhāgyaṃ labhate vṛtaḥnānāvidhaphalāvāptimupadiśati | tatra maṇḍalān prāgvatjuhuyāddinaśoghore sannipātajvare gadetribhirvā nityaśohomaṃ kuryāttrisvādusaṃyutaiḥtaddineṣu japedvidyāṃ nityaśaḥ salilaṃ spṛśatpākādyamapi taireva kuryādrogavimuktayepiṣṭaṃ ca sādhyapādottha rajasā ca samanvitamprāgvacchittvā'yasaistīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ puttalikāṃ hunetsādhyo vaśo bhavecchīghramapi dūrasthito dṛḍhaḥuparyagni nidhāyātra vidyayā dinaśo(vaṃ) hunetpakṣāntare triṣu janmasvitiśeṣaḥ | kramāt yathākramam || 45śatayojanadūrādapyānayedvanitāṃ balātkṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭāṃ ca śmaśāne nikhanenniśikṛtābhiṣekastāṃ vidyāṃ prajapecca śatatrayamrogairbhūtādisaṃkleśairnāśameti suniścitamkleśaistaiḥ sa vinirmuktaḥ sukhī jīvati bhūtaletoyamadhye nidhāyaitatkvāthayeduktavāsaraiḥtāmeva caṇḍikāgehe tathā baliyutaṃ khanettadvidhānena sahitaṃ śatrurunmādavān bhavetsādhyarkṣavṛkṣacūrṇādibhiḥ samuditaiḥ || 52 || 53 || 54tathā baliyutaṃ sādhyayonibaliyutamprayogānapi vakṣyāmi samāhitadhiyā śṛṇutena koṣṭhāni jāyante tvekaṣaṣṭyā śatatrayamcatvāriṃśattatra śeṣaṃ vajrākāraṃ yathā bhavetkuryāccheṣāṇi koṣṭhāni pañcaṣaṣṭyā śataṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāgvatsvaravibhinnāni prāguktavidhinā tathā(taḥ)ekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāni śiṣṭāni punarambikeaṣṭamarāśyādighaṭikāyugavarṇau ca likhet prāguktayogataḥsādhyākhyamālikheduktakrameṇa puṭayordvayoḥdvitrikrameṇa prākpratyakkoṇayostu trayaṃ trayamspṛśan japenmanuṃ paścāttrisahasraṃ tatastu tat(tam)bhūtākṣarāṇi ca punarlikhetkāryānurūpataḥvijayastambhavidveṣavaśyoccāṭanakarmasudeśarāṣṭrapuragrāmaniveśāderviśeṣataḥmadhye devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayennityaśaḥ śivāmkuryāt trirātraṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ kāmyarūpataḥvibhave maṇḍape tasya proktavajaṃ likhenmahatnṛtyagītādibhīḥ sārddhaṃ sandhyāsu ca viśeṣataḥvairināśena vā tasya bhaṅgādvyasanato'pi vāpratīyā(parīyā)ddeśikaṃ tvagre gaje jivecciraṃ sukhī(m)evametasya vajrasya vaibhavaṃ konu varṇayetmāsādibhiḥ | gaje sthāpayitveti śeṣaḥ || 80yena hastagatena syuḥ siddhayo'pi svahastagāḥtenaikāśītikoṣṭhāni jāyante ta(cca)dapūrvavattrikoṇāni caturdikṣu teṣu tā(nyeva)vacca pūrvavatekasminmadhyame śaktiḥ jaṭhare sādhyamālikhetna bhedastvanayorasti prayogeṣu tu sarvataḥdaśake hṛdaye śīrṣe saṃsthāpya samare kṛteakṣatārogasarvāṅgo yaśolakṣmīdhanānvitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etattāmratale kṛtvā sthāpayedabhivṛddhayebāhye kṛtvā ca vidyāyā bījamādyamathāntimekaikaṃ pārśvakoṇeṣu dve dve vṛttāntarā punaḥmadhyabījasya madhyasthaṃ likhettaṃ nijavāñchitamkaṇṭhe vā dhārayetsadyo vallabhā tasya jāyatevṛttāṣṭapatrayuktāni ṣoḍaśāni manoharamtatphalāni copadiśati | tatra daṃśakaḥ kavacaḥ | anyat sugamam || 87 || 88rephāṃśena kuryāt, anyatra caturthasvarāṃśena kuryāt || 91 || 92 || 93karṇikārṇasya madhyasthaṃ kuryānnāma nijepsitamahorātraṃ ṣoḍaśadhā kṛtvā tāṃ teṣu yojayetdhārayedabhiṣiñcecca ja(yurja)pediṣṭārthasiddhayekoṣṭhāni ṣoḍaśāni syusteṣu padmāni kārayetdevīṃ tu sthāpayedbhūmau sarvasampadavāptayeasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamprāgvadvilikhya pūjanācca prāguktā siddhiriti || 95 || 96 || 97 || 98 || 99paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamdvādaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamtadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājña samīhitaphalapradamtadāvaraṇaśaktiśca taddhyānaṃ tatprapūjanamprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidyāṃ ca tadvidhānaṃ ca tatphalamyairmantrairbhuvane khyāto nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥtenaiva puṭitairarṇairnyasecchrotrādipañcasuprāgvadarghyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ tacchaktī śṛṇu pārvatinyasedityarthaḥvinodā kautukā puṇyā purāṇā caturasragāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vīrā vighnaharā vidyetyuktā yantrāṣṭaśaktayaḥsamayā sarvagā siddhetyuktā aṣṭāsraśaktayaḥmūladevīsamākāravarṇāyudhasamanvitāḥnādāṃ manomayīṃ ṣaṭsu patreṣu parito'rcayetmadhye devīṃ hetivṛttāṃ pūjayedaṣṭamīṃ śivāmtathāpi bhaktasantrāṇahetoḥ kḷptāṃ parāṃ tanumdvitīyākṣarādināmaśaktayaḥ | tyaivigrahavatī tyaivigrahetyarthaḥprādakṣiṇyenanavaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarāmśucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥdakṣiṇairaṅkuṣaṃ khaḍgaṃ kuṭhāraṃ kamalaṃ tathādhyātvaivaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ dūtīṃ durnītināśinīmtathā ṣaḍasramaṣṭāsraṃ tadvadaṣṭadalāmbujamāvāhyābhyarcya tāḥ śaktīḥ prāguktavidhinā sthitāḥsādhanaṃ coktamārgeṇa kuryāllakṣamatandritaḥyenāsau vāñchitaṃ kṣipramavāpnoti suniścitamdurnītināśinīṃ samyak vivekapradānāt || 13 || 14 || 15 || 16nālikeraphalopetairguḍairlakṣmīmavāpnuyāttrimadhvaktaiścampakaiśca prasūnairbakulodbhavaiḥpunnāgajairhutairvastrāṇyājairiṣṭamatāpnuyātavāpnoti hutaiḥ sājyai ratnai ratnaṃ ca sādhakaḥhṛddeśanyastanāmārṇāṃ pacettailājyayorniśisaptarātraprayogena naro nārī nṛpo'tha vāhayāripuṣpairaruṇaiḥ sitairvā juhuyāttathāchāgamāṃsaṃ trimadhvaktairhomātsvarṇamavāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yugānurūpamakṣaratrilakṣādikaṃ prāgvattailājyayormiśrībhūtayoritiśeṣaḥ || 26 || anaśnan annamitiśeṣaḥpadmākṣairhavanāllakṣmīmavāpnoti tribhirdinaiḥśṛṇu teṣu vidhānāni samāhitamanāṃ śivetaiḥ ṣoḍaśasvarayutaiḥ ṣaṣṭyāśatamudīritaiḥtadantaraṣṭakoṇaṃ ca tadantarvṛttayugmakamvṛttayorantarāśeṣaṃ bahiḥ koṇeṣu cāṣṭasukarmānurūpān bhūtārṇān daśabhūpuramadhyataḥantyaṃ caturṣu koṇeṣu śeṣāṇāṃ ca vilekhanechāgamāṃsairityanvayaḥ | chāgomeṣaḥ || 29evaṃ yantrāṇi jāyante daśasiddhyā spadāni vaisaptamyāṃ triṣu sandhyāsu sitāpūpasamanvitamdadhibhaktantu sāyantu kṣīraṃ mocāphalaṃ tathāvāñcchitaṃ prāpnuyāddevyāḥ prasādenālpayatnataḥsupakvaṃ chāgamāṃsena kṣaudramannaṃ nivedayettathaiva vanitāṃ hṛdyāṃ vaśayedyāvadāyuṣaḥtāvaddinaṃ tathā'bhyarcya vaśayeddvividhān ripūndaśa susamā(nā)nīti || 31 || 32 || 33 || 34 || 35 || 36saptāhādāpadaḥ sarvāḥ prayāntyasyāḥ prasādataḥkevalaṃ pāyasaṃ mocāṃ sitāṃ ghṛtasamanvitāmjitvā sukhī ciraṃ jīveccheṣamāyurnirāmayaḥkṛtvā tasmai dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyā(ddravyaṃ)dbhūri svaśaktitaḥyenāsau toṣamāyāti tāvadvittaṃ samarpayetmasṛṇe vā śilāpaṭṭe pīṭhe vā saudhabhūtalepūjayettriṣu sandhyāsu japanvidyāṃ tathā vaśī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mucyante prāṇino'cintyāḥ śaktayo mantrayantrayoḥsthāpayenmandire tasmilla/kṣmīrāste'tisusthirānavamaṃ hemagaṃ kṛtvā bhūṣādau dhārayecchiveyadyaddhi vāñchitaṃ kāryyaṃ tattanmadhyagataṃ tathātaddinaistadavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsikthanirmitapātrasthakṣaudramadhye niveśya tatsādhyasyābhimukho vidyāṃ japannitthamanusmaran(ret)nyastāñjalikaraṃ śīrṣe dāsohamitivādinamtadeva koṣṇaṃ kṛtvā ca sandhyāsu triṣu nityaśaḥkulaṃ lajjāṃ vivekaṃ ca parityajyāsya kiṅkarāḥprāṇapratiṣṭhāvidyāṃ te vakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu pārvati|| 49 || annādi pratisandhyaṃ sarvam | japan śataṃ sahasraṃ vā || 50 || 51tattallikhitākṣaraiḥ | sikthaṃ madhūcchiṣṭam | tat yantramitiśeṣaḥjavī dāhamarudyukto vyomāpi marutā yutamjyāvahniyuktārtho'mbu syāt ṣaṣṭhasaptamakau punaḥhṛdāhāmbucaraiḥ svena gotrādāhāgnibhiḥ parampunarādyatrayaṃ cāmbumaruddyu nabhasā yutamagnirhaṃso marudyukto vyāptaṃ ca marutā yutamhaṃsaśca marutā yuktaścatvāriṃśallipirmanuḥprāṇapratiṣṭhā vidyāṃ prastautitvagādiṣu ca tānyeva nyasecchaktipuṭasthitamaruṇākalpamukuṭāmaruṇādharapallavāmprasūnapiṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ ca dadhānāṃ pāṇiyugmataḥanantaśaktiyuktābhiḥ pūjayetpadmamadhyataḥīkāraḥ | haṃsomarudyuktaḥ hā iti | vyāptaṃ ca marutāyutaṃ yā iti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantraḥsthāneṣu hṛdaya eva vā nyasediti sampradāyārthaḥprāṇādibhiḥ | anantaśaktiyuktābhiḥ pratyekamitiśeṣaḥ || 70 || 71nāgā kūrmā sakakarā devadattādhanañjayātadantardaśapatrābjaṃ tadantastaddvayaṃ tathālakṣaṃ japetpayobhakṣastaddaśāṃśaṃ hunettathātarpayetsaurabhādyena jalenetthaṃ susādhayetanayā vidyayā sādhya prāṇāṃstatra niyojayetyena puttalikā jīvaspandayuktā manorbalātkoṣṭhānyekonapañcāśajjāyante teṣu vinyasetśiṣṭeṣu madhyanavasu likhedaṅgāditaḥ kramāttatra pradhānāprāṇaśaktireṣāṃ samaṣṭirūpā| tatra taddvayam vṛttadvayam | anyaccakranirmāṇaṃ sugamamkṛtārghyaḥ prāgvat || 75 || sitaiḥ gauraiḥsādhyajīvāgamataḥ | vinyaset prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidyākṣarāṇītiśeṣaḥsañjapya vidyāṃ hastena sajīvena spṛśan śatamsādhyajīvādyānayanaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te'dbhutamjñānakarmendriyāṇyarthān manojīvaṃ tanuṃ tathāraktarajjvāśaktimayyā(dhyā) tānyānīyārpayeddhiyāevaṃ niyojitāṃ vidyāṃ sahasraṃ prajapetspṛśanevaṃ saṃsthāpitaprāṇā puttalī spandate'bdataḥtajjanmalagnasañjātanavāṃ(ṣṭa)śarkṣapradhānakamteṣu teṣu prayogeṣu vakṣyāmyaparahomakeanyāni cāṅgaromāṇi puttalyāṃ yojayenmṛtauevaṃ sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ prāṇākarṣaṇakarma te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatonirdiṣṭaputtalyāṃ tatra tatroktamācaretuktānāṃ tu na varkṣāṇāṃ tathaivāṣṭakavargakamsaṃsthāpya sādhyajīvādyānayanaṃ kuryāditinakṣatraṇāmitiśeṣaḥ | saca rāśyanvayaḥ homake homapaṭaleśeṣaḥanavekṣya kṛtaṃ karma svātmānaṃ hanti tatkṣaṇātvadānyaṃ sadayaṃ nityamabhicāre na yojayetabhicārasya viṣayānākarṇaya vadāmi teprajānāṃ ghātakān sarvakleśakarmasu saṃsthitānnindakaṃ samayānāṃ ca piśunaṃ rājaghātakamniyojayenmāraṇeṣu karmasvetairna pātakīpādatovā guruṃ viprānārādhya svena nityayājanmatraye pyabdamātramabhiṣekaṃ samācaretnānyatraviśeṣaṇam | a`hicāre māraṇe, anyat sugamamitiśeṣaḥ || 95 || 96 || 97etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dūtīnityāvidhānakamasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamhaviṣyabhuk haviṣyaṃ nāma nirlavaṇapakvavrīhitaṇḍulānnam || 99tatpāpaiḥ abhicārakaraṇapāpaiḥ | eṣa sādhakaḥ | 101trayodaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamsārddhasaptadaśaiva syuḥ paṭale'smi/strayodaśeproktaiva tvaritā vidyā prāgeva dvādaśākṣarāyena mantrī manmathābho vikṣobhayati bhūtalamkuryādaṅgāni yugmārṇaiḥ ṣaṭkrameṇa karāṅgayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrvorjānvorjaṅghayośca pādayośca krameṇa vaitārādyaiḥ śṛṇu taddhyānaṃ tacchaktīstatprapūjanamdvidvikramādaṣṭanāgaiḥ kalpitābharaṇojjvalāmślokadvayena paṭalārthānuddiśati | tatra prāgeva tṛtīyapaṭalevikṣobhayati svātmanā prasiddhiṃ karotiṣaḍaṅgayojanaṃ ūrujānujaṅghāpādayorekaikam || 3viprakṣatriyaviṭśūdrajātibhirbhīmavigrahaiḥvalayairbhūṣitabhujāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmguñjāguṇalasadvakṣaḥkucakuṅkumamaṇḍanāmpāśāṅkuśavarābhītilasadbhujacatuṣṭayāmtadagrasthāṃ ca sphāṭkārīṃ śaracāpakarojjvalāmyataḥ sā tvaritetyuktā māyānityā navamyasauvarmādi phaḍantān daśasaṅkhyān prokteṣu daśasu sthāneṣu nyasediticāturvarṇyotpattikrameṇābharaṇakalpanamiti boddhavyamvāmaurddhādidakṣiṇādharahastāntaṃ vāmadakṣiṇakrameṇadhanurbāṇojjvalakarayugalāmkiṅkaraścāgratastasyāḥ pūjyaḥ sarvārthasiddhayeśaktī tatsadṛśe svarṇavetravellatkarāmbujestrīhuṅkāryau kṣemakarī lokapālasamā imāḥyābhirnityārcitābhiḥ syānnaronārīṣu manmathaḥprāgvadarghyaṃ vidhāyeśāmaṣṭasiṃhāṅghrike śubhepaścimadvārasaṃyuktaṃ tadantarvṛttayugmakamprāgvadāvāhya paritaḥ śaktibhirveṣṭitāṃ tathāprasāde ābhimukhye | anena ślokena devyā nāmanirvāhaḥkāmavat svātmadarśanena kṣobhayatītyarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvādhiṣṭhātrīm | aṣṭasiṃhāṃghrike aṣṭasiṃhapādasahiteagrapatrāgrake vṛttamadhye vā'rcyau puroditausvasamānagaṇākīrṇamaṇḍalasthasya bhaktitaḥśataṃ vā kṛtahomastu pūjāṃ prāgvatsamāpayetbailvairdaśāṃśāṃ juhuyātpatrādyaiḥ sādhane japephaṇidaṃṣṭrāmṛtānāntu mukhe santāḍya jīvayetsantāḍya śīrṣe sahasā mṛtamutthāpayeditikṛtvā yoniṃ kuṇḍamadhye tatrāgnau vidhivaddhunetetaduktaṃ bhavati āvāhya karṇikāmadhye iti śeṣaḥyugānurūpamakṣaralakṣasaṅkhyāke daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādityanvayaḥtrimadhvaktairekaśovā sametairvā samṛddhayekairavairmallikākundamadhukairindirāptayenavairnīlotpalairaśvaripujaiḥ karṇikārajaiḥyadyaddhi vāñchitaṃ sarvamavāpnoti suniścitamsitārkaṃ plakṣajaṃ hutvā rogānmuktonaro'cirātacalāṃ labhate lakṣmīṃ bhoktā ca bhavati dhruvamekaikairvanitā vaśyā yāvajjīvaṃ dhanādibhiḥtṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥkṣīrāktaistairhutairmartyā vaśe tiṣṭhantyaśeṣataḥtadaktairvairiyonyutthamāṃsairapi ca tatkṛteāruṣkaraghṛtopetaṃ phaṇiśīrṣasru cā hunetniśāmadhye hunetsadyo nihantuṃ vairiṇaṃ haṭhātsaptarātrādarātestu gajāśvā rogamāpnuyuḥsaptāhādrogaduḥkhārtaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥtathāpi daddiśā kiñcidvarṇyate tacchṛṇu priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatrunakṣatrayonimāṃsaiḥ | tatkṛte vairimṛtyavetāni sarvāṇi deveśi ! kuru citte krameṇa vaitadagrāṇyabhitaḥ kuryāttiśikhānyasya madhyageprādakṣiṇyapraveśena dvādaśāvṛtti māyayāśriyai kīrtyai ca vaśyāya saubhāgyāyākhilāptayenaranārīnṛpādīnāṃ vaśyāya bibhṛyācca tatjāyante ca catuḥṣaṣṭikoṣṭhāni parameśvari !vaibhavam | diśā ekadeśena | tatvaibhavaṃ sṛṇvityanvayaḥsarvamadhyasthe koṣṭhe || 41 || 42 || māyayā hṛllekhayā sārddhamitiśeṣaḥ ||dvādaśakṛtvaḥ samālikhya proktakrameṇa vibhṛyāditi || 44bahistūrṇākṣarairante vaṣaḍyuktaistu (pūjayet) veṣṭayetsarvatobhadravinyāsānuṣṭubhaṃ sarvasiddhidamnabhaśca marutopetaṃ vyāptaṃ tena samanvitamdvitīyādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ syādbhuvā śūnyaṃ dvitīyakampratilomaṃ tathaiteṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ caraṇaṃ bhavettvaritākṣarairveṣṭayediti || 46marudyutā prāgvadetatpratilomaṃ tṛtīyakametaccaturthaṃ caraṇaṃ śrīvidyāyāṃ maheśvariyatra sthitā'sau cakrasthā na tatrāśubhasaṅkathāpādobhavedityarthaḥ | tṛtīyakaṃ caraṇamitiśeṣaḥ | pāda-ityarthaḥjyādharāsvairmāyayā hṛttato'mbu sparśagā ilāprāgvattūrṇāmṛtārṇaistairveṣṭayedvṛddhiyojitaiḥvṛttadvayena niṣpādya kumbhaṃ padmādharottaramsthāpayejjapasaṃsiddhiṃ teṣu pūrvoditeṣu vaicaturthapādaśca dṛśyata iti | asau śrīvidyetiśeṣaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gajāścā paśavastvanye prāṇinaḥ mukhino'niśamalakṣmīśāntaye vaśyasiddhaye sarvasampadesvalpenaiva tu kālena bhavantyeva parāsavaḥdāhagarbhe nāma kṛtvā tathā digvīthiṣu kramātmanīṣiteṣu viniyogāt proktāni phalāni ca syuriti || 60yaiḥ sadyovairiṇaḥ svīyaṃ vimuñcanti kalevaramprabhā dāhakṣmāsvayuta haṃsodāhādisaṃyutaḥkālyā yamasya kramato vidyāṃmantramasaṃkramamśṛṇu vakṣyāmi parato yamānuṣṭubhamīśvarinabo marudyutaṃ dāhaścaturṇāṃ pratilomataḥnabhobhuvā grāsa etat pratilomāt dvitīyakamrayasteṣāṃ vilomaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ caraṇaṃ manoḥcaturthaṃ caraṇaṃ proktaṃ vidyaiṣā sarvanāśinīnāda eṣāṃ vilomaṃ ca prathamaṃ caraṇaṃ yameeteṣāṃ pratilomaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ caraṇo manāḥrasaḥ kṣmayā vahnidāhau pratilomāt tṛtīyakampratilomaṃ tu teṣāṃ syāccaturthaṃ caraṇaṃ śiveveṣṭayedvyāptadāhābhyāmuktakramasamanvitamjaptaṃ vinikṣipedakṣavivare catvare'tha vāśmaśāne proktasamaye proktakramasamanvitammārītu susthirā sādhyā sarvaiḥ devāsurairapisthāpitairakaṃ prāgvat kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭham || 78kṛtvā teṣvīśarakṣodigārambhātkālikāmanumveṣṭayitvā bahiścakraṃ sthāpayet tadadhomukhamanukteṣvapi nāmāni yojayetkoṣṭhamadhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śmaśānāṅgāranimbotthaniryāso viṣamīritampuruṣaścet kālyādyāyatanāgra evādhastācca khaneditibahiḥ kālīmantraveṣṭanaṃ ca boddhavyamiti sampradāyārthaḥbījadvayena bindusahitarephayakārābhyāṃ pūrvavadveṣṭayetaṣṭacchedeṣu phaṭvarṇamālikhedaṣṭavarṇakambahiḥ kumbhaṃ vidadhyācca proktākṣaravidhānataḥvidadhyānnava yantrāṇi daśānāṃ ca phalaṃ śṛṇu !stambhaṃ lakṣmīyaśohemavāsāṃsi (ca) samavāpnuyātsthāpayet | tena pūrvoktānyeva phalāni syuriticitrakam | anyadārādhyamukhādavagantavyamevaṃ daśayantrāṇi kuryāt iti || 84tatra arthaḥ sugamaḥ || 86svarabinnairbhavet saṅkhyā ṣaṭsaptatyā śataṃ smṛtamśṛṇu vakṣyāmi deveśi ! sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhayetanmadhye karṇikāmadhye śaktiṃ sādhyasamanvitāmvṛttayorantarā bāhye kumbhaṃ proktaṃ samālikhetviniyogānathaiteṣāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvati !tṛtīyaṃ nṛparakṣāyāṃ caturthaṃ daṇḍarakṣakamsārddhamekādaśayantrāṇi bhavantītip. 252) ṣaṣṭhaṃ sacivarakṣākṛt saptamaṃ purarakṣakamphaṇicoragrahādibhyo bhayebhyaḥ śatrutastathāuttārakaṃ syāddeveśi ! prākproktavidhinā yutamsthāpayecchītale toye ghaṭādau savidhe'tha tamghorābhicārakṛtyādijāto dāhajvaraḥ kṣaṇātevametāni yantrāṇi nāmataḥ sarvakāryakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjādau ca baliṃ dadyāt ṣoḍaśārṇena pārvati !asyā niṣphālanātcitte tattatvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtamprāṇapratiṣṭhābhiṣekodhāraṇamarcanaṃ cocyateṣoḍaśārṇena tṛtīyapaṭalāvasānoktena mantreṇetiśeṣaḥ || 99caturddaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamvidyoktā kulasundaryāstasyāḥ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇutatsādhanaṃ tathā rūpabhedān yāgāṃśca vākpradānlohitāṃśukabhūśāsṛglepanāṃ ṣaṇmukhāmbujāmanarghyaratnaghaṭitamāṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmraktastabakasambhinnalasadvakṣasthalāṃ śubhāmbhujairdvādaśabhiryuktāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvavāṅmayīmvasupūrṇaṃ saccaṣakaṃ luṅgivyākhyānamudrikāmvidyādevatayoḥ || 1haimīṃ ca lekhanīṃ ratnamālāṃ kambuvaraṃ bhujaiḥyakṣarākṣasadevarṣisiddhavidyādharādibhiḥsitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai lakṣmyai hemaprabhāmapinīlāṃ ca mūkikaraṇe(tāṃ) smaretta(tta)dapekṣayāādimadhyāvasāneṣu pūjājapavidhau kramātkuryātkarāṅgavaktrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ proktaṃ yathāvidhivyādhyādikleśāya | tattadapekṣayā tattatprayogānuguṇyenanyāsakālāḥ sarvasādhāraṇāḥ | kramāt yathākramamśucinatyantarasthaistaistadātmasu yathākramamtṛtīyaṃ śrotracibuke caturthaṃ ghrāṇatāluṣumūlamadhyāgratonyasyennavadhā mūlavarṇakaiḥtṛtīyakūṭākṣaraṣaṭkonaproktakramāt nyāsatrayaṃ kuryāditi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyāsān kuryāditisampradāyaḥkhaḍgarūpā vittarūpā ramyāpyānandakautukebahiraṣṭacchadāmbhoje brāhmyādyāśca samarcayetindrāgniyamarakṣobhirvaruṇānilasomakānśaktyantairnāmabhiḥ prāgvat pūjayet sarvasiddhayetanmadhye vṛttayugmasthaṃ kuryādaṣṭacchadāmbujamkṛtvā'tra tāṃ samāvāhya prāgvatsamyagathārcayetdaśamīmekādaśīṃ ca pūjayet || 18 || tathā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇaśaktyantairnāmabhiḥ indraśaktītyādiprāgvat * saptākṣaryantaiḥtathaiva lokapālāntaśaktī dvāradvaye'rcayetsaptākṣaryā baliṃ dadyātpūjānte kurukullayāprātaḥ salilapānaṃ ca kuryādvidyātmasiddhayekāśmīrakālāgurubhirmṛgasvedamadairapicaturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā tatra uktakrameṇa tāṃ pūjayediti || 21prādakṣiṇyenārcayediti yāvat | sāmānyaṃ pūrvoktavadityarthaḥyāvatcopadiśati | tatra mṛgasvedamadaiḥ mṛgasvedaiḥ mṛgamadaiścacitrabhūṣāmbaraḥ sragvī japedvidyāṃ niśāmukhesarvābhirapi nityābhiḥ prātarmātṛkayā samamanyairapi ca matraistairvidyābhistatprasiddhyatisugandhisalilairhomaṃ tāvattṛmadhurāplutaiḥsiddhavidyā(=)punaḥ kuryātkāmyakarmāṇi sādhakaḥvidyāsvarūpabhedā/stu śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhibhavatītyupahvaraḥ sampradāyārthaḥvṛttasthaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vācyavācakarūpasya prapañcasyāmitātmanaḥkathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe ! vidhivistaravaibhavāḥyajurveda ikārādisteṣāṃ saṃyogataḥ śuciḥvilikhya yojayetpūrvaṃ śabdaśāstrānusārataḥvṛddhisandhyā samāyujyādityutpannaṃ śucervapuḥādyakṣaraprasūtāni sarvāṇyanyāni yena vaisitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai ityādipūrvoktena devīrūpavarṇabhedenaparamotkṛṣṭattvam | ameyattvaṃ deśakālākārairaniyantritattvamkāraṇatvāt tanmayatvādaikārasya ca trayīmayatvamuktamiti || 35 || 36prāgvatkāraṇakāryatvayogādvācakarūpakamiti vācakavācyatvarūpādviśvātmatoditāevameṣā viśvamayī vidyārūpabhidāḥ śubhāḥbindusargātmanoraikyarūpā sātvāvayorvapuḥevamabhinnarūpo'nayā vidyayā vyāpta iti || 39vidyāyāḥ svarūpabhedān śṛṇu ityarthaḥvanaṃ tṛtīyamākhyātaṃ māyayā svena vā yutamjñātṛjñānajñeyadoṣaguṇatejastrayātmikāvācyavācakarūpātmā prapañcasya hi kāraṇehaṃsahṛdyogasteṣu jaṅgamā sthāvarātmatājñātuṃ na śakyate saṃkhyā vidyānāṃ parameśvarisampūryāvatiṣṭhata itisaṅketavidyāyāḥ kāraṇeti svātantryoktiḥ | kāraṇatetyarthaḥsaṅketavidyāyā jaṅgamasthā varātmatvavāsanoktetitathāpi bhaktasantrāṇahetoḥ kāñcana vacmi teaihikāmuṣmikajñānamayī sakalasiddhidā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vijayākhyā mahāvidyā viśvasaṃtrāṇatatparādvayorniyojanātteṣu jāyate (sā) āvayorvapuḥteṣu dāhasamāyogādviśvākhyā viśvavigrahātāsāṃ saṃkhyāsvarūpaṃ jñātuṃ vaktuṃ vā na kenāpi śakyamitiasamīcīnataddvayapratipādakavidyābhyoviśeṣayatikhecarāmburasopetamāyābhyāṃ puṭitā tu sāmāyādyā mohinī proktā tanmadhyā kṣobhiṇī matātrayodaśeti kathitātripurā(rinama)vidhayaḥ smṛtāḥtāsāṃ vidhānaṃ te proktamaśeṣaṃ lakṣasāgaretāṃ vakṣye śṛṇu deveśi sādhābhīṣṭasiddhayetripurāratnākhyā samīritā itividhānaṃ lakṣasāgarākhyāgame samupadiṣṭamiti copadiśativātena ca carasvābhyāṃ dvitīyamapi pārvatievaṃ trivarṇā sā vidyā vidhānaṃ cātha kathyatekuryātkarāṅgayoḥ prāgvaditthaṃ dhyāyecca tāṃ tataḥcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ prasannasmeravaktrakāmtrikoṇe svastikāsīnāṃ karuṇānandamandirāmpustakaṃ ca varaṃ(daṃ) hastairdadhānāṃ sarvamaṅgalāmkulāsane halakṣārṇamadhye tadvidyayā'nvitedakṣiṇordhvādi vāmādharāntaṃ dhāryāṇi pārśvakrameṇa kalpayetmadhye trikoṇakoṇeṣu ratiprītimanobhavān(m)caturasre lokapālān prāgvacchaktīḥ samarcayetbalidvayaṃ ca homaṃ ca prāgvadanyat samunnayetbrāhmīrasavacādugdhe śṛtaṃ sarpistribhirdinaiḥproktakrameṇa proktāḥ śaktīḥ pūjayediti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dinaśovilihet prātarabdānmūkobhavet kaviḥkuberoravicandrārajñāgurūsitasaurayaḥnāmasaptākṣarīyuktyā pūjayettarpayeddhunetmātṛkānyāsasahitaṃ spṛśedrakṣākṛte manumtena te sukhinobhūyaḥ sānvayā yāvadāyuṣamtadghṛtaṃ lihataḥ saṃvatsarāt proktaphalasiddhiriti || 68tattanmaṇḍale pūjātarpaṇahomādinā vāñchitasiddhīḥ ritinavakoṣṭhe nava proktān rāhuketusamanvitānkoṣṭhetāṃstairyajetsadyomuktarogaḥ sukhī bhavetutpāte samarodyoge kuryāduktārcanādikamtena sarvāpadunmuktaḥ sukhī jīvati bhūtalekathayāmi dvayaṃ te'dya vakṣye tatpaṭale'khilamkuryādaṅgāni ṣaḍvargaiḥ pañcapañcadaśākṣaraiḥuktaprakārairdinanityāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnavabhirnāmamantraiḥsarvāpadbhyovimuktaḥ sukhī bhavatītitatpaṭale mātṛkāpaṭale | akhilaṃ anyaditiśeṣaḥkarāṅgayorvidhāyetthaṃ ādikṣāntākṣarāṇi vaioṣṭhadantaśirojihvāsvekaśovinyasetsvarānvinyaseccaturovargān pañcamaṃ pārśvapṛṣṭhataḥtvagsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjāśukrāntagāmiṣuhṛdayasparśināṃ teṣāṃ smaran dhātuśu vinyasethṛdayādhastathāpādajaṭhare vadane nyasetjātiyuktairmantraiḥ karāṅganyāsaṃ kuryāditi || 79prapadāṅgulisandhī ucyete | pañcamaṃ vargamitiśeṣaḥ || 81hṛdayādipādayugāgrāvadhi parāmṛśan hakāraṃ ca nyasedityarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidhāya vilikhenmadhye haṃsahṛdvanaśaktijampañcapañcākṣaropetān dārucāmbuni dikṣu casavyañjanāvyañjanatvabhedato'bhūddviranvayaḥanyānyekādaśa śive sandhimātrādi sambhavāprātarmurddhnismaredindubimbasthaṃ sarvasampadamsthāpanādgṛhadeśādau yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidamsannidhiṃ phaladānaṃ ca sādhakānāṃ vitanvateādiśabdogrāmādi viṣayaḥsambhavatītyupadiśatinityaśojapapūjādyaiḥ kāle matsamatāṃ vrajetpraviṣṭovidvadgoṣṭhīṣu yujyate vāgmibhirjanaiḥvibhāvayannitimanuṃ japedekāgramānasaḥvādādiṣu tu sarvatra devatātma jayī bhavetprayogajātamanyonyaṃ vidadhyādaikyayogataḥṣoḍaśasvapi nityāsu yantrādanyatsamīritumādyaśabdastarpaṇahomādiviṣayaḥ | matsasatāṃ śivasamatāmdevatāhambhāvanayā tattatkaraṇādvijayo bhavedityarthaḥnityānityāsādhāraṇamnāmālikhya bahiḥ ṣaṭsu tattrayaṃ svena māyayājihvāyāṃ bhāvanāt sarvagoṣṭhīṣvagraṃ vigāhateasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamparipūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭamsādhāraṇānītiproktāni phalānyavāpnoti itipañcadaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityānityāṃ śṛṇu prājñe yadāyattamidaṃ jagatyāsau samastajīvānāṃ deha sthitividhāyinīyantrāṇi vajrarūpāṇi ṣaḍādhāreṣu saṃsthitimdīrghasvarasametābhyāṃ haṃsahṛdbhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamtadadhiṣṭhātṛrūpatvena nityānityāyāḥ sthitiṃ ca vakṣyāmītividyākṣarāṇi kramaśonyasedvinduyutāni tu vaidhyāyet samastasampattihetoḥ sarvātmikāṃ śivāmpadmarāgakṛtākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīmprativaktraṃ trinayanāṃ bhujairdvādaśabhiryutāmvahantīṃ varadāṃ vāmairaṅkuśaṃ pustakaṃ tathādadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairdhyāyeddevīmananyathālalitāśaktivṛndo'yaṃ bijadvayamathokramātjavirājitāṃ ṣaḍvaktrapadmavirājitāmityarthaḥbhujeṣvāyudhānyūrddhādi kalpayet | kheṭaṃ carmaphalakammaṇḍalāgraṃ saḍgiviśeṣaḥ | nṛkapālaṃ śiraḥkapālamsaptākṣaryā yutā saṃjñā vidyāḥ syurdvādaśākṣarāḥṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣvāsīnāṃ ḍākinyādyāstathā'rcayetḍākinīṃ śākinīṃ paścāllākinīṃ kākinīmapihetīstāmabhitaḥ śaktirūpāstanmukuṭānatāḥkuryācca nityahomantu japedvidyāṃ yathoditamsvātmasvarūpatvāt | kāścana ākarṇaya vakṣyamāṇaśaktīritiśeṣaḥṣaṭkoṇeṣvatroktāni sthānāni pūrvameva vyākhyātāni || 12 || 13kucabharanamrāḥ tattadbhujasthānasthitāḥ | sarvasādhāraṇametatarghasaṅkalpa prāgvat | īritakramāt proktakramāt | yathoditaṃ prāgvatkṛtvā teṣvapi tābhistu vṛttāṃ pūjāsu madhyamāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmairāvṛttaṣaṭkoṇe yajelladhvīsmṛtārcanātvidhāya teṣu śākhāsu śaktīnāṃ viṃśatiṃ yajetanantabrāhmaniyatikālarūpā vigarhitāḥtābhiḥ akārādikṣakārāntaikapañcāśadakṣarāṇāṃ śaktibhiḥtrisvādusiktairaruṇairambujairhavanaṃ tathākuryāduktān prayogā/śca nacettaddhātudevatāḥanayā vidyayā loke yanna sādhyaṃ na tat kvacitśataṃ dvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ tairyantrāṇi vadāmi tevidhāya madhye māyāsthamekamakṣaramākhyayākṛtvā navabhirevaṃ syuḥ kramādyantrāṇi ṣoḍaśapūjākrameṇa prāgvadarcayet ityevaṃ trayaḥ pakṣā iti || 19sarveṣāṃ ṣaḍdhātvadhīśatvāt || 22 || tasya prayoktuḥvistāramupadiśati | tatra sapta anāvṛttāni tāni prathamakūṭākṣarāṇidvitīyena śirorogā naśyanti parameśvaripañcamena bhujārogāḥ prayāntyūrddhvena pādajāḥdhṛtenāṣṭamayantreṇa jñānendriyagatā gadāḥekādaśena pittotthā dvādaśena kaphodbhavāḥprayānti vilayaṃ sadyo yantrāṇāṃ śaktivaibhavātprayānti bhītāḥ kṣaṇataḥ sarve'nyepi grahāḥ śivepūrvoktena saha ṣoḍaśa yantrāṇi bhavanti || 24ūrddhena ṣaṣṭhena yantreṇetiśeṣaḥ | prāgvat pādajā rogā iti śeṣaḥanukteṣu viśeṣyeṣu rogā ityetadviśeṣyamṣoḍaśena dhṛtena syādāyurārogyamīśvarisarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ samyaganukteṣu gadeṣvapisavaṃdanaṃ saviśvāsaṃ phalatyevānyathā'nyathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāksiddhimanyatsakalaṃ kurute na bhidā tayoḥtairvajrayantranirmāṇaṃ phalāni ca śṛṇu priye| evaṃ kṛte phalatyeva anyathā na phalatyevataistu koṣṭhāni jāyante navāśītiśatadvayammadhye vajraṃ yathā bhūyāttathā kuryāt samantataḥtryasrāṇi catvāryagrāṇi catuḥkoṣṭhaistu pūrvavatprādakṣiṇyapraveśena kūṭa(a/ stānā)ntasyādyakhaṇḍajānpratilomānulomātmavidyādvayamathālikhetkarmamadhye'dhare sādhyamālikhedapi sarvataḥṣaṭyantrāṇyupadiśati tatra ṣaṭtriṃśat pratikoṇamitiśeṣaḥ || 38madhyavadvilikhetteṣu vajrayantramitīritamiti ṣaṭvajrayantrāṇi proktāni kramaśaḥ śivekuryādityarthaḥ || 42 || pratilomānulomakrameṇa likhedityarthaḥp. 284) paṭṭe vā phalakāyāṃ vā ṣaṭkaṃ ṣaṭsu prakalpayetitarāṇi tu saṃsthāpya yajettatraiva tāṃ śivāmnavahastāyāmatataṃ patākātoraṇānvitamutsedhāyāmavistārahastāṃ vedīṃ ca madhyataḥīśaprāgvahnirakṣāṃ tu vāyudikṣu yathākramamnivedya gandhapuṣpādyairnṛtyagītādibhistathāhutvā japitvā jīvocce bhānūcce vā sthirodayepūrvoktena sārddhaṃ ṣaḍvajrayantrāṇi sambhavantītidevyātmā tacchilābhistu dṛḍhamābadhya tatra vaimūrtisaptakamutpādya pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayetyatra tatra gadālakṣmīripugrahapiśācakā,hna kadācitsambhavanti vidyāyantrānubhāvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhārmikāścaiva rājānaḥ pūrṇasaptāṅgasaṃyutāḥvāñchitaṃ samavāpnoti maṇḍalānmāsato'pi vāprāguktarakṣovāyuśakravahnīśavaruṇadikṣu sthāpanādityarthaḥmūrtisaptakaṃ (ḍā)rākinyādīnāṃ ṣaṇāṃ devyāśceti śeṣaḥkleśāḥ | vidyāyantrānubhāvataḥ ubhayoḥ sāmarthyāt || 56suṣumnāmadhyasaṃstheṣu ṣaḍādhārāmbujeṣu tāḥbahiśca maṇḍale pūjānugrahānigrahātmikā(m)dhūmravarṇāmbuje devīṃ ḍākinīṃ tatsamākṛtimtayā sarvajñatāsiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥprāpnotideheṣu sthitim | tāḥ devyaḥ ityatrānvayaḥ ,dākinyādaya iti śeṣaḥmūladevatāsamānaḥrākinīṃ dvādaśadale kādiḍhāntākṣarātmabhiḥmaṇipūrakasaṃjñe ca nābhisthe daśapatrakelākinīṃ pūjayedvairivi jayaśrīsamṛddhayevādiṣaḍvarṇaśaktībhirāvṛtāṃ ḍākinīṃ yajetādhārākhye catuṣpatre suvarṇābhe saroruhepāyudhvajāntarā tryasramadhye tejaḥ samanvitāmsevitāṃ hakṣaśaktibhyāṃ hākinīṃ pūjayettathaviśvasṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsaśaktidāmapyayatnataḥpūjanaṃ sarvaduḥkhārtināśanaṃ sampadāspadamtayā pūjayā || 62 || 63 || 64 || 65 || 66 || dhvajamūle mehanamūlesamanvitāṃ kuṇḍalinītejorūpām || 68 || tathā samuccayebhūtabhaviṣyavartamānakāryajñānasāmarthyapradāyinīmityarthaḥmadhye ca tatra tāṃ nityānityā gandhādinā'rcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāhyeṣvapi ca tāḥ prāgvatproktavarṇāḥ samarcayetṣaṭtriṃśattāḥ samādevyāḥ sarvarūpāyudhādibhiḥpareṣu yavalakṣārṇarahitā staistathā'rcayetca kuryādititatra madhye brahmasūtraṃ kṛtvā tasyārddhamānataḥvidhāya cihnayugalaṃ cihnāccīhnaṃ dvayorapibrahmasūtrasthapūrvāgrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavetpaścimabrahmasūtrāntamitthaṃ ṣaṭkoṇakaṃ bhavet(tatheśāni)taddigādi ca rakṣontaṃ brahmasūtradvayaṃ bhavetkṛtvābhito'tha vṛttāni tattadarddhāṃśatobhramātkṛtvā taddaśamāṃśeṣu ṣaṭsūtrāṇi nipātayetvṛttaspṛksūtrayugmāraṃ madhye madhye nipātayetkṛtvā trirbrahmasūtrāṇi mārjayeccakramuttamampūjā nigrahasaṃjñā syāt sā śatrūṇāṃ vipattayekkāthatoyābhisampūrṇān kṛṣṇāmbarasamanvitānkṣipraṃ tvagādibhiste syuḥ pūrṇāḥ śatroḥ kalevarāḥhomaṃ ca kuryāttenaiva phaṇiśīrṣasrucā ruṣāpraharantīḥ piśācebhyovikirantīśca tattanumdhyātvaivaṃ nigrahaṃ kuryādripūṇāṃ māraṇāya vaidhūmrasindūranīlodyadbhānuhemendu (bhāṃsi)bhāni caudyadaryamabimbābhe nityānityāṃ ca madhyamenigrahānugrahavidhau yatamāno vinaśyatitathā manīṣitaprāptau siddhirasyārcanādbhavet---------------------------- ataḥ paraṃ vyākhyeyānikāṃsye sīsepi vā kṛtvā sthāpayedvairibhūmiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāśītipadāni syusteṣu koṇacatuṣṭayecaturdikṣu trikoṇāni catuḥkoṣṭhaiḥ prakalpayetbhujaṅgamasya phaṇaṃ chitvā sruggatena tena phaṇenetyarthaḥrahasyārthaśca svagurumukhādevāvagantavyaḥśiṣṭeṣu madhyādhaḥkoṣṭhamārabhya pratilomajānsādhyayonyasṛjā piṣṭatadvṛkṣakṣodalepitānśmaśāne caṇḍikāgehe kulotsādakaraṃ bhavetanugrahaṃ śṛṇu prājñe pūjācakravidhānataḥnavedyamāsāṃ samproktaṃ yadāsāṃ prītidāyakamharidrānnaṃ tilānnaṃ ca śuddhānnaṃ ṣaṭakameva cayuvatīḥ sapta saṃsthāpya prāgvadabhyarcya tāḥ kramāttāsu tuṣṭāsu tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ śaktayastāḥ samāstadākūṭānuktasamārambhān prādakṣiṇyena sallikhetproktānyeva phalāni syuryogo'yaṃ laghuvigrahaḥbījadvayādyaiḥ saptākṣaryantaiḥ pañcadaśākṣaraiḥdineṣu ghaṭikāyogāt pañcāśanmithunānyapisaptākṣaryā ca saṃyuktā mantrāḥ pañcadaśākṣarāḥmanīṣitaṃ samālikhya (rabhya) teṣu tanmithunāni veevaṃ maṇḍalamāsārddhāt prāpnotyevābhivāñchitamproktaphalāvāptiḥ syāt evameṣa prayogeṣvapiyatnasādhya itisamastavāñchitaprāptiḥ sadā bhavati sarvadāasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamiti śrī ṣoḍaśanityātantrekādimate ṣoḍaśapaṭalampañcadaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭampañcāśītiḥ sārddhapādāḥ ṣoḍaśe paṭale smṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasyā nīlapatākāyā vidhānaṃ sarvasiddhidamsādhanaṃ siddhavidyasya vijayaṃ kāmarūpatāmyakṣiṇīśceṭakānmāyāṃ yantrāṇi ca vadāmi tedaśabhiḥ siddhibhirmartyobhavedvidyādharo'paraḥdvicatuṣṭayaṣaḍavarṇaiḥ krameṇa ṣaḍitīritaiḥkathitā | vidhānaṃ vadāmītyanvayaḥsiddhyādīnāmnābhāvādhārake pādasandhiṣu triṣu ca kramātvyāpakaṃ ca samastena vidadhyācca yathāvidhipañcavaktrāṃ trinayanāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīmratnastabakasambhinnadehāṃ cārusmitānanāmdadhānāṃ vāmapārśvasthaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥdadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairāsīnāṃ padmaviṣṭaresaṅkṣepavikāsārthatvānna punaruktidoṣaḥprāgvadvyāpakanyāsaṃ ca kuryāditi yāvat || 6prativaktramityarthaḥ || 8 || daśahastāṃ sambhūyetiśeṣaḥśaktivṛndairvṛtāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nityārcanakrameaṣṭāsraṃ bhūpuradvandvādvṛtte tatpurayugmakamkṛtvā tāmāvṛtāṃ śaktigaṇaistatrārcayecchivāmagrātpradakṣiṇenaiva yajedāvṛttipañcakamśṛṅgamayatvāccāpasya | teṣāmubhayataḥkramamūrddhādi kalpayetpadmaviṣṭare vakṣyamāṇarūpe || 11 || āsyaṃ mukhambrāhmyādīraṣṭapatreṣa tatkoṇeṣa bahistathābalidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ prāgvatsamāpayettilataṇḍulakairvāpi proktaṃ dravyānudīraṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pṛthakkṛ(tyā)tvā'thagaṇite tripañcāśadbhavanti hitaddaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau sarvatrākṣaralakṣakenityānāmapi sarvāsāṃ vāsanāyāmudīritamvyākhyāto'smābhiḥ | tatkoṇeṣu aṣṭakoṇeṣu | bahiḥ caturasre || 15śeṣaḥ | prāgvat ādhāratraye, teja(sa)strayabhāvanādisahitamityarthaḥtadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vakṣye vidyāvibhedataḥsaṅkhyāṃca tāśca samproktāḥ krameṇāsāṃ phalāni catābhyāmeva vilomābhyāṃ puṭayeduparauritānparastāttatprabhedānāṃ mantrānvakṣye yathāvidhiudīritaṃ prāṅmukhattvakāraṇamsarvāṇi paṭalaśeṣe vakṣyamāṇāni prastauti (iti)kūṭayuddhe durgaje ca teṣāṃ mantrāścaturvidhāḥvidhātumātmanaḥ śaktiṃ sa eko mantra īritaḥkṛtvā smaredvāñchitantu deśaṃ tatra tadā sthitiḥyenāktākṣonidhiṃ paśyeddevādyāṃścāntarikṣagānpalāyitā vā padayoḥ praṇameyurvaśaṅgatāḥnidhāya sādhanaṃ skandhe careyurvāñchayā'sya tesiddhimantrānte yojayediyarthaḥ | uparīritān upariṣṭādvakṣyamāṇānsiddhyavāntarabhedānām | mantrān tatsaṅkhyādibhiḥteṣāṃ vijayānāṃ caturvidhānāmśaktiḥ sāmarthyam | saḥ kāmarūpapradaḥkecidbhīṣaṇādāṅgāḥ vetālā bahuvigrahāḥkiṅkarāḥ proktakaraṇādbhaveyuryāvadāyuṣamkruddhāḥ kṣudrāśayāḥ proktakāriṇaḥ syurasaṅkhyakāḥtaireva praharecchatrumajñātamaniśaṃ raṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarūpā dvibhujāścitravasanābharaṇānvitāḥpādukāsiddhividyāprasādīkṛtam | pādayoḥ svasyetiśeṣaḥ | tatra deśetanmantrasaṅkhyā vā | yena añjanenapūrvāparayoranvetite piśācāḥ | taiḥ piśācaiḥ | ajñātaṃ apratyakṣamṣaṭtriṃśadrūpasaṃyuktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṅkhyātā ityarthaḥsametya sarvābhīṣṭāni dadyustāḥ sādhakāya vaiyābhiḥ siddhābhiraniśaṃ sādhakāḥ sarvasammatāḥte'pi nānāvidhākārāḥ siddhāste dadyurīpsitamvasūnyupahareyustā vidyaikā tatprasā(dha)danedaśavidyāḥ prajāyante śṛṇu vakṣye ca tāḥ kramāttāḥ vidyāḥ | yābhiḥ vidyābhiḥprāgvat | īpsitaṃ sādhakasyeti śeṣaḥekādaśādhikaṃ śatamitisiddhyapekṣayoktiḥ | tāḥ vidyāḥvidyā sā vijayaprāptyāṃ caturṣvekādaśākṣarāḥtrayodaśākṣarī vidyā kāmarūpapraderitādvādaśārṇā bhavedvidyā siddhā dadyācca pādukepūjayettaddvayenātra dvādaśārṇā samīritādvādaśārṇā bhavetsiddhā satyā dadyātsuśobhanamatirahasyatvādvidyā āñjasyena na likhyantetathā kūṭadvayenetyarthaḥ | anyatsugamammantrāyojanāt | vidyeti pūrvāparayoranveti | pāduke iti dvivacanamdvādaśārṇā vidyeti śeṣaḥśeṣaḥ | siddhā prāgvaccheṣaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trayodaśākṣarāṃ vidyāṃ siddhāṃ tān darśayettathāpuṭayetpūrvavaddvābhyāṃ vidyā saptadaśākṣarātāsāṃ nāmāni vidyāśca śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhiviśālā madanā rūddhā kālakaṇṭhī mahābhayāmekhalā sakalā lakṣmīrmālinī viśvanāyikākāmeśvarī nandinī ca svarṇarekhā manoramākalyāṇadā kalādakṣā tataśca surasundarīmantrayojanā | tathā prāgvat dvayena | tān vetālānitiśeṣaḥbījābhyāmitiśeṣaḥtāsāṃ yakṣiṇīnāmiti daśamīmāhendrītyādinā ślokena daśa nāmānyupadiśatisakārastadvattāsāṃ vidyāḥ krameṇaiva tadbījadvayasampuṭaiḥvidyāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadākhyātāstāḥ siddhā dadyurīpsitampañcamī pañcadaśamī viṃśatiśca tathā'ntimātrayodaśī cāṣṭadaśī dvāviṃśā dvādaśākṣarānavamī daśamī caikaviṃśā tadvadanantaramsugamānidvādaśākṣarāḥ tadvaccaturdaśākṣarā ityarthaḥtrayastriṃśā(dhi)dikāstisrastrayodaśayutāḥ parāḥśṛṇu śuddhyāstu te nityaṃ sādhayeyuḥ samīhitamsiṃhanādo mahānādaḥ sugrīvomarkaṭaḥ śaṭaḥmayūro maṅgalobhīmo dvīpivaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥsauribhāsyo gajamukhaḥ paśuvaktro gajānanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śyenāsyaḥ kaṅkavadanaḥ kākāsyo hayavaktrakaḥsampradāyārthaḥtavetyarthaḥ | te ceṭakāḥvibhrametyādinā ślokena ekādaśa nāmānyupadiśatimātaṅga ityādinā ślokenāṣṭa nāmānyupadiśaticapalaḥ kukkuṭāsyaśca māyāvī madanālasaḥsumukhaḥ pīḍitaḥ kruddho varāhāsyaḥ saṭāmukhaḥbhakṣakobhayadaḥ siddhaḥ sarvagaśceti kīrtitāḥnāmabhistairdvitīyāntairdehītipadasaṃyutaiḥteṣāṃ saṅkhyāmapi tathā śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhitathā pañcadaśārṇāḥ syuḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiritīritāḥmahodaretyādinā ślokenāṣṭa nāmānyupadiśatimanoharetyādinā ślokena nava nāmānyupadiśatipadacchedaḥ | anyatsugamamtathā saptadaśārṇāśca catvārovyākulakramātsasvaraistairbhavetsaṅkhyā caturviṃśacchatadvayamdevatāḥ saptavāreṣu bhāskarādiṣu bhaktitaḥsvarūpabhedasambhinnāḥ samīcīnaṃ darśitāḥyantrasya madhye māyāsthaṃ tatra siddhīśca pūjayetbahiḥ kalābjabhūpadmayugaṃ kuryādyathāvidhidaleṣu koṇeṣu tathā vṛttamadhyatraye punaḥtasya koṇāntarāleṣu halakṣārṇān kramāllikhetsiddhīnāṃ yakṣiṇīnāṃ ca ceṭakānāṃ tathaikaśaḥteṣāmuktakrameṇaiva sādhanāni phalāni vaikoṇāntarāleṣu caturṣu uktamakṣaratrayaṃ vilikhedityarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjyate sarvalokaiśca sarvataḥ sarvadāpi caudyānamadhye kāntāre mātṛpādapamūlataḥekaikasmin varṇalakṣaṃ japeduktavidhānataḥkadambabandhūkajayāhayamāraiśca lohitaiḥsuvarṇāni ca vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni phalāni caālepanāni mālyāni dadyurājīvitāvadhiityuktvā nityaśastāstu pūjayeccajapettathāevaṃ tāḥ sarvayakṣiṇyaḥ phalaṃ dadyuryathepsitamekasmin pañca pañca syuḥ siddhāḥ sindhutaṭe navamaunaṃ dineṣu satataṃ kuryāt siddhyai na cālayetjapeddivāniśaṃ proktaṃ sarveṣāmapi sādhanejapasaṃkhyocyate | hayamāraiśca lohitaiḥ raktakaravīrapuṣpairityarthaḥnityatadupāsanādigranthārthaḥ sugamaḥ || 84 || 85 || 86sthānānyanyasarvasiddhyaṣṭakasādhanasādhāraṇānīti sampradāyaḥkṣobhayuramuṃkṣomaṃ nacedetyatha tatpuraḥpratyekaṃ te tathetyuktā na māṃ muñcata ityapi(smṛ)sate tametya sandiṣṭaṃ sādhayeyuḥ samīhitamkurvanti prārthitārthānāṃ pradānaṃ ca divā'niśamniścalīkurvate mattaṃ dantinaṃ vā hayaṃ narampiśācairuragaiḥ siddhaiḥ kinnarairapsarogaṇaiḥrudrairekādaśavidhaiḥ sādhyaiśca navabhirgrahaiḥvijayādīnāṃ saptānāṃ vidhānādikamapyevam || 94rājabhirvanitābhiśca narairanyairmṛgaistathāhṛṣṭāśayo vadānyaśca dayāvān sumukhaḥ kṣamīdhanī bhoktā'paradveṣī premabhūrāvayorbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtamparāmṛṣṭamtatra anyaiḥ daśaprājāpatyādibhiḥ || 96 || 97siddhasamīhitasukhāspadaḥ siddhasamīhitaśca sukhāspadaścetyarthaḥśivaśaktyoḥsaptadaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭhamtadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vidyā prāguditā tavatadyantraviniyogāṃśca vakṣye'haṃ vijayapradānśeṣābhyāṃ ca dvayaṃ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni karāṅgayoḥakṣarāṇi kramādvinduyutānyanyattu pūrvavattadviniyogāṃścetyarthaḥbhāsvanmukuṭavinyastacandrarekhāvirājitāmudyadbhasvadbimbatulyadehakāntiṃ śucismitāmcakraṃ tathā'ṅkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ sāyakaṃ mātuluṅgakamupāsane'tisaumyāṃ ca siṃhopari kṛtāsanāmsamare pūjane'nyeṣu prayogeṣu sukhāsanāmsarvādevyā samākāramukhapāṇyāyudhānyapikrameṇa vinyasya samastarūpayā vidyayā vyāpakaṃ ca nyaseditiyuddhavijayārthaṃ dhyātvā pūjayedityarthaḥ | anyeṣu vaśyādiṣusukhāsīnāṃ saparivārāṃ devīṃ dhyāyeditidalāṣṭakasamopetaṃ tatra prāgvat samarcayettadantaśca tathā padmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadasaṃyutamtattacchaktyā vṛtāṃ samyagupacāraistathā'rcayetbalidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ cā'pi samāpayetcandrakhaṇḍalasanmauliyutā sā tanmayī matā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadāvaraṇagāḥ śaktīstatsamākāraśaktikāḥdevīmāvāhyābhyarcayediti || 13 || vā vikalpe | balidvayaṃ prāgvattāsāṃ krameṇa nāmāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhiantaḥsthitāṣṭakoṇeṣu pūjayeduktavigrahāḥkṣemāṃ kṣemaṃkarīnityāmaṣṭakoṇeṣu bhaktitaḥśaktīstā(stā) gandhapuṣpā(di)yutobhaktisamanvitaḥvīrāṃ vikṣobhiṇīṃ vidyāṃ vinodāñcitavigrahāmvibhavāṃ vividhāṃ viprāṃ proktākārasamanvitāḥproktakrameṇa gandhādyairbhaktiniṣṭhāśayo vaśīhṛllekhādyaiḥ saptākṣaryantairityarthaḥ | nāmabhiḥ mantrairiti śeṣaḥtāḥ śaktīḥ teṣu caturasrādisthāneṣu | tāsāṃ āvaraṇaśaktīnāmvidāriṇīmityarthaḥ | viśvavibhañjikāṃ viśvavibhañjinīmityarthaḥmāninīṃ madhurāṃ māyāṃ mohinīmuktavigrahāmbhajate nityaśodevīṃ yo'sau syātsarvataḥ sukhīhomaṃ raktāmbujaiḥ kṛtvā siddhamantrodayānvitaḥjapena tarpaṇenāpi pūjanena yathāvidhisugandhiśephālikayā trimadhvaktairyathāvidhiproktavāreśayoścāpi tanmaṇḍalata eva vaiproktarūpataḥavaśiṣṭamanyatsugamam || 26mallayuddheca vādeca dvaye dyūtadvaye'pi cacaturaṅgulajaiḥ puṣpairhomātsaṃstambhayedarīncampakaiḥ ketakairājavṛkṣajairmāgandhodbhavaiḥprokteṣu stambhanaṃ śatrorbhaṅgo vā bhavati dhruvamsarpiṣājyāplutābhiste praṇamantyeva pādayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samidbhirjuhuyātsamyagvāreśārcanapūrvakamsajīvanirjīvarūpe || 30 || sarvatra anyeṣu vivādeṣvapi ||homātproktaphalasiddhirititenāsya vijayobhūyānnidhanenāpi vā punaḥpatraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ kāṇḍaiḥ mūlaiścāpi hunetkramātarātidiṅmukhobhūtvā kuṇḍe tryasrevidhānataḥvairī balasamagropi śauryamānānvito'pi cahomena somavāre ca bhavetprāgvanna saṃśayaḥvāre bhaumasya havanāttadāpnoti suniścitambudhavāreṣu śubhrāyāḥ savatsāyā ghṛtānvitamnakṣatravṛkṣasamidbhiḥ | te śatravaḥ || 34 || samidbhiḥ mṛtyoritiśeṣaḥuddiṣṭakramaiḥ patrādyairmūlāntaiḥ pañcabhiraṅgairityarthaḥekonapañcāśaddinairityarthaḥ | ttyasre trikoṇakuṇḍe ityarthaḥ || 38takṣavāreṣu(?) te janma pūrvameva hi tatkriyātattannityārcanaṃ tattaddvāreśadvayapūjanamśīghraṃ tatphalasaṃsiddhyaibhavatyevānyathā'nyathāhunettathā tatphalāptistaddinaiḥ syādasaṃśayamtatsiktairvidadhītetthaṃ taddinaistacca siddhyatitaddināttatphalāni syuriti vāreṣu saptasuviyayaṃ śṛṇu deveśi kathayāmi krameṇa tetadvāreśadvayaṃ ca pūjayitvā paścāt prayogān kuryāditiśālīcaṇakamudgaiśca yavamāṣaiśca homataḥṣaṣṭhyādi ca daśamyantamajābhavaghṛtaistathātadūrdhvaṃ pañcadaśyante samastaiśca tiladvayaiḥhavanāttadavāpnoti yadāsau phalamīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: havanādapi tatprāptirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥtaddināt prāevanmaṇḍalāt | tatphalāni jayaphalāni | iti proktarūpataḥvijayamitiśeṣaḥ | tathā ṣaṣṭyādibhirdaśamyantābhiḥ pañcatithibhiḥkṛṣṇarūpaiḥ, trayodaśyāṃ sitarūpaiśca tilairjuhuyādityarthaḥmadhusiktairhomāt tattatphalāvāptiritiaśītyarṇavatīṃ vidyāṃ tairyantrāṇi śṛṇu priyeekāśītipadāni syusteṣu tāni likhetkramātśūlīkṛtya ca rekhāgrāṇyatrāvāhyābhipūjya tāmvidyākramaṃ tatra yantre yajettatphalamāpnuyātṣoḍaśasvarayojanārūpaḥ | taiḥ akṣaraiḥ | yantrāṇi vakṣyamāṇānitasmin prayogārthaṃ vidyākramañcārcayet | tena vijayaphalasiddhiritinavāni sambhavantyatra koṣṭhāni parameśvariteṣu madhyasthapadmasya karṇikāyāṃ samālikhetteṣvādito'ṣṭau saṃlikhya vindunā tadbahistathāevamaṣṭasu saṃlikhya veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥcaturasratraye bāhye yantrasyāgre samālikhetvidyākṣarauṣadhikvāthajalairāpūrya pūrvavatabhiṣiñcettataḥ kleśairvimukto jāyate sukhīnavagrahārtoripubhiḥ sarvataḥ kleśasambhaveputrāptyai vāñchitaprāptyai triṣu janmasu kārayetdevīmāvāhya sampūjya japedvidyāṃ tathā'yutamtaṃ kumbhaṃ pratikarṇikamitiśeṣaḥ | pūrvavat phalapallavādibhiḥsañjapya triṣu janmasvabhiṣekāt proktaphalasiddhiritirājānaṃ vanitāṃ martyānanyāṃśca prāṇino'khilānnidhāya bhittimadhye vā śayanasthānake nije
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasraṃ proktakālena stambhayedakhilaṃ dṛḍhamvyavahāraṃ raṇodyogaṃ vāde vācaṃ matiṃ ruṣāmsandhyāsu pūjayennityaṃ sahasraṃ prajapettathāathānyadvajrarūpaṃ tu yaṃtraṃ vakṣyetivaibhavamkoṣṭhāni navaṣaṣṭyā ca yutaṃśatamitisphuṭammadhye ca sambhavatyevāśītikoṣṭhairyathāvidhisarvamadhyasthakoṣṭhe ca caturdikṣvagratastathāetadagracatuṣkasya sparśāttricaturasrakamekena vajrayantreṇa vijayā vijayapradāḥvijayaṃ samavāpnoti prokteṣvapi ca saptasujapārādhanasaṃsiddhaṃ sthāpayecchūnyaveśmasupiśācā rākṣasāḥ kṛtyā vetālāḥ syurna tatra vaisthāpayedyatrakutrāpi tatkṣetraṃ brāhmaṇāspadamvaṭe vilikhya khananāt pattanaṃ bhavati dhruvamāhitānāśrayaṃ sthānaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥdāhavyāpte svasaṃyukte likhet tacchṛṅgamadhyayoḥbhālasthenābhijaptena tamāviśya gado vadettriṃśattamena ślokena proktadvandvayuddhādiṣu saptasvityarthaḥgrahabhūtapiśācādyāḥ asyāviśyāpayānti vaiyantrametadvilikhyāśmanyabhyarcya sthāpayet kvacitsthāne gajānāṃ vāhānāṃ nava kṛtvā navasvapidikṣu madhye ca tatraiva rogāḥ kṛtyāḥ pareritāḥcandracandanakāśmīrairālikhyābhinave paṭedāhajvarārtamacirānmucyate tajjvareṇa saḥsamareṣu mahīpānāṃ yantrametadudīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daradenātha tanmadhye tāmāvāhya samarcayetpratyarthisenā tacchabdaśravaṇena palāyatesajīvadyūtakāleṣu yantrametadvinirmitamvajrarūpam || 94 || 95 || tāḍayan nissārayan | tacchabda iti nissāraṇa śabdaḥ ||etaddarśanamātreṇa palāyante diśo daśanāsādhyaṃ vidyate tena vajrayantreṇa pārvatitadaiva dāsavattasya vaśo bhavati tadbalātasyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattva svātmasātkṛtamparāmṛṣṭamtatkaṇṭhe kukkuṭādikaṇṭhe || 98 || jayamāpnoti dadhajjana iti śeṣaḥdhyānabalāt | uktaprakārataḥparipūrṇaṃ paramāmṛṣṭamekākṣarā sā kathitā vidyā sā sarvamaṅgalāpūjākramaṃ sādhanañca viniyogādikān kramāttāni tatsvarabhinnāni nyaset sveṣu mano'vadhimāṇikyamukuṭāṃ netradvayapreṅkhaddayābharāmviniyogādikān yantrādīnāmiti śeṣaḥprāgvannyasediti sampradāyaḥpatrairupete sacaturdvārabhusadmayugmagevāmena nijabhaktānāṃ prayacchantīṃ dhanādikamṣaṭsaptatibhiranyabhirakṣarotthābhiranvitāmtāḥ śaktīḥ śṛṇu deveśi yā nityāvaraṇe sthitāḥkaruṇāṃ kamalāṃ kalpāṃ pūjayedaṣṭapatrakeśaktibhiścānvitāṃ proktarūpato dhyātvā pūjayeditiaśokāmamalāṃ pūrṇāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāgyāmathodyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayedabhitaḥ śaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vaigaurīṃ śivāmameyāñca vimalāṃ vijayāṃ parāmaśeṣarūpāmānandāmambujākṣīmaninditāmvidyāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ sandhyāṃ saṃyātāñca sarasvatīmprāgvadindrādibhiḥ sarvvāḥ kramādanvarthasaṃjñakāḥpaścimādicaturddikṣu catasraḥ proktavigrahāḥjapantu nityaśaḥ kuryyādagre tasyāḥ sahasrakamhomaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryyādannājyābhyāṃ ghṛtena vāprayogānanyathā tasya naiṣphalyamayaśo mṛtimsaṃsādhya paścāt kurvvīta maṅgalānmaṅgaloditāndevyāḥetatsarvamaṅgalāpaṭaloktānmaṅgalān prayogānityarthaḥsomasūryyāgnirūpāśca tāstvaṣṭatriṃśadeva tāḥśaṃśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadāetāḥ ṣoḍaśa candrasya kalāḥ kalpadrumopamāḥsuṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhanī dhāraṇī kṣamābhakārādi ḍakārāntavarṇoccāro vilomataḥvivasvānindrapūṣārkāḥ parjanyaḥ samanantaraḥkādiṭhāntārṇatanavaḥ sarvagāḥ sarvvasiddhidāḥsuśrīḥ surūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe apiteṣāṃ daśānāṃ nāmāni vāsanoktāni te śiveproktakrameṇa saṃpūjya vidhiṃ yuñjyāttu sarvataḥtāsāṃ nāthāstatsadṛśanāmarūpāḥ samīritāḥtāni saṃpūjya tattejastrayātmani jale śiveabhiṣekāttu tattejastrayaṃ devyātmatā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00122 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcabhiryojayennityāṃ vidyāṃ tāṃ sarvamaṅgalāmtataḥ sahasrairnavabhirdviśatena ca ṣoḍaśatattaddevatātmatetyarthaḥ | abhiṣecyasyeti śeṣaḥtairyantrāṇi prayogāṃstu phalāni ca vadāmi tetadbahiścāṣṭapatrāvjaṃ tadbahistattrayaṃ tathāteṣvādyaṃ madhyataḥ sādhyasametaṃ vilikhedbahiḥaṣṭacchadeṣu pratyekaṃ pañca pañca samālikhetvilomāmanulomāñca svena samyak samālikhettaiḥ proktasaṃkhyairvidyārūpaiḥ prayogān yantrairiti śeṣaḥnitye likhedagratastu prādakṣiṇyena sarvataḥśatañca catvāriṃśacca catvāri ca tataḥ kramātmadhye nāmasametāni tadanyānyabhito likhetjāyanta itisahasraiśca śatenāpi caturbhistāni saṃkhyayāevamāsāntu nityānāṃ yantrāṇi syuḥ pṛthak pṛthakvidyante teṣu yatkiñcidvakṣye kaḥ śeṣato vadetbhittvā ṣoḍaśadhā devi vidadhyādviniyogakamprāgādimadhyasaṃyuktaṃ nāthān devīśca tatkramāt || 48pīṭhe vā bhūtale vāpi pūjayet proktavāsaramśaknomītyarthaḥcakraṃ prakṣālya tattoyaṃ kedārādiṣu nikṣipetviniyuñjyādabhīṣṭeṣu kāryyeṣu kramataḥ śivesarvataḥ saumyakarmmāṇi sidhyantyevānayā dhruvamlakṣmīprāptyai tathārogya siddhau rogārttiśāntiṣuputrāptyai sarvarakṣāyai pūjayetteṣu tatkramāt
